items.title: Una capilla, un hombre piadoso y un matadero: el origen de uno de los barrios porteños más emblemáticos
items.author: Germán Wille
items.preview: Balvanera es un punto neurálgico de la ciudad de Buenos Aires pero en sus orígenes era un paraje rural atravesado por un camino llamado Real, la actual avenida Rivadavia
items.content: El barrio de Balvanera es uno de los más emblemáticos y poblados de Buenos Aires. También, uno de los más transitados. Por la Plaza Miserere , punto neurálgico de la barriada, pasan alrededor de 200.000 personas cada dia hábil (datos oficiales del gobierno de la ciudad), que se dirigen o vienen, en tren, subte, o colectivo, hacia y desde distintos puntos de la ciudad y alrededores. Pero este barrio y su punto de trasbordo tan activo no siempre ha sido así. Convergen en los tiempos de su origen la historia colonial de la ciudad, su estampa rural junto con su costado religioso. Fue sede de mataderos y ferias de frutos y campo de batalla durante las invasiones inglesas. También fue el lugar de alojamiento de misioneros franciscanos y allí se levantó una pequeña capilla que le dio su nombre al barrio. El matadero del oeste A comienzos del siglo XVIII el barrio conocido como ‘Once’ -en realidad es Balvanera- era una zona de quintas atravesada por el Camino Real del Oeste -la actual avenida Rivadavia- que era la más importante vía de conexión de la incipiente ciudad con los llamados “Reinos de Arriba”. Las caravanas de carretas con hombres y mercancías iban y venían por allí desde Córdoba, Salta o Mendoza. Cuando en la gobernación de Juan José de Vertiz (1770-1776) se reglamentaron los mataderos, se instaló el llamado Matadero del Oeste en la actual plaza Miserere y alrededores. El lugar, conocido como Hueco de Carcaburu , estaba limitado por las actuales calles Paso-Saavedra, Hipólito Yrigoyen, 24 de noviembre-Anchorena y Sarmiento. Además de ser un sitio de corrales y faenado de ganado vacuno, este extenso terreno servía también un punto para el estacionamiento de las carretas que venían hacia Buenos Aires. Allí se descargaban los productos que traían estos vehículos y se pasaban a mulas, para ingresar a la ciudad sin destruir, con las ruedas de los carretones, las precarias calles de la ciudad. En diciembre de 1797 , dos vecinos que poseían varios terrenos en la zona, Antonio González Varela y su esposa Josefa Ramírez donaron una parcela para misioneros franciscanos. Fray Damián Pérez y Juan Domínguez levantaron allí un hospedaje para los miembros de su orden que estuvieran de paso por la zona. Nuestra Señora de Valvanera y Miserere Con el tiempo, ellos levantarían allí una capilla. Lo harán en la actual equina de Bartolomé Mitre y Azcuénaga. Como ambos religiosos provenían de Logroño, en la provincia española de La Rioja, decidieron entronizar en el nuevo templo a una advocación mariana venerada en aquella región ibérica: Nuestra Señora de Valvanera . En 1823, con la reforma eclesiástica propulsada por Bernardino Rivadavia, se clausuró el reducto franciscano, pero la capilla continuó abierta. Diez años después se levantó allí una nueva iglesia, más imponente, que conservó el nombre de la anterior, pero esta vez con un pequeño cambio. Ahora era Nuestra Señora de Balvanera. Los vecinos, en algún momento habían cambiado la ve corta inicial por una be larga. El propio González Varela, que falleció en 1801, le dejaría al barrio otra de sus denominaciones identitarias. Este comerciante, que era dueño de una pulpería ubicada en las actuales Azuénaga y Rivadavia, era conocido por todos los pobladores cercanos por su apodo: “ Miserere” . Los historiadores aseveran que el término proviene del latín y que significa: “Ten misericordia” . Algunos afirman que el hombre tenía ese sobrenombre por la cantidad de gestos de caridad que había tenido en su vida, como el legado del terreno a los Franciscanos. Otros dicen que eso es lo que González Varela decía cada vez que veía cómo los matarifes ultimaban un animal en el matadero del Oeste. “¡Ten misericordia!“, exclamaba el ilustre vecino ante la feroz -pero cotidiana- escena. Lo cierto es que, con el tiempo, Miserere pasó a formar parte de la nomenclatura casi oficial de la zona. La quinta de Miserere, los corrales de Miserere, la capilla de Miserere, los mataderos de Miserere. Al día de hoy, la característica plaza del barrio lleva ese nombre, aunque muchos porteños suelen llamarla Plaza Once. Una confusión que tiene que ver con que ese es el nombre de la estación cabecera del tren Sarmiento ubicada allí. En rigor, el nombre completo de la estación es Once de septiembre y recuerda esa fecha del año 1852 cuando la entonces provincia de Buenos Aires se separó de la Confederación argentina que lideraba Justo José de Urquiza. El combate de Miserere Pero mucho antes de que se cree una plaza en los antiguos corrales de Miserere , otro acontecimiento histórico de relevancia pasó por ese predio. Ocurrió en 1807 , durante las segundas invasiones inglesas, cuando las tropas británicas acamparon allí antes de acometer contra la ciudad. Allí mismo, el 2 de julio de ese año , hubo una batalla a campo abierto entre las tropas criollas comandadas por Santiago de Linniers y el enemigo inglés. Los invasores vencieron en este enfrentamiento, que pasó a la historia como Combate de Miserere, aunque pronto resultarían derrotados por la resistencia que les contrapuso el mismo pueblo porteño para derrotarlos definitivamente. Hacia 1820 el lugar en el que se encontraba el matadero del Oeste se convirtió en el Mercado del Oeste . Hasta allí llegaban desde distintos puntos del país comerciantes que traían frutos y cueros para la venta. Para ese entonces, la llamada gran aldea porteña se encontraba en pleno crecimiento hacia el oeste. Mucho más cuando, en 1857 , se inauguró a la vera de esa plaza una estación de entonces llamado FC Oeste, que es el actual Sarmiento . Esa parada era entonces la segunda en el recorrido del tren desde el centro porteño hacia el oeste. La cabecera estaba entonces donde hoy se encuentra el Teatro Colón . El transporte sería un muy efectivo acelerador del desarrollo de la zona. En 1870 llegaron hasta allí los tranvías a caballo, con las empresas La Central y Once de Septiembre, y en diciembre de 1913, el moderno subte, primera línea inaugurada en Sudamérica. En 1853 el mercado de frutos pasó a llamarse Once de Septiembre . Según consta en el libro Buenos Aires tiene historia, de Leonel Contreras y Víctor Coviello, hacia 1882 y en el contexto de la Exposición Continental Sudamericana, el mercado pasó a ser la Plaza Once de Septiembre . El predio cambió su nombre por Miserere por un decreto municipal de 1947. Volvió a denominarse, así, como conocían el lugar los vecinos de fines del siglo XVIII. El mausoleo del primer presidente En 1932, cuando la “Plaza Once” era ya un punto neurálgico de trasbordo de transportes y uno de los centros de comercio más importantes de Buenos Aires, se inauguró en ella el mausoleo en el que se depositaron los restos de Bernardino Rivadavia . El primer presidente argentino fue trasladado allí desde el cementerio de la Recoleta, en una ceremonia multitudinaria, que contó con el entonces primer mandatario del país, Agustín P. Justo . La idea era levantar en un lugar público una “tumba cívica” para honrar a quien, según muchos, había impulsado instituciones básica para modernizar la nación. Este monumento, que fue diseñado por Rogelio Yrurtia , cuenta con dos particularidades. La primera, que el el único mausoleo de la Argentina que se encuentra en un espacio público, que no es ni un cementerio ni una iglesia. Y la segunda tiene que ver con la persona homenajeada. Rivadavia , que falleció exiliado en Cádiz en 1845, había dejado expresamente destacado en su testamento que no deseaba que sus restos terminaran en Buenos Aires o Montevideo. Pero los intereses políticos desoyeron esta última voluntad. Cuando cayó Juan Manuel de Rosas -enemigo político de Rivadavia-, quienes se alzaron con el poder pensaron que regresar al primer presidente al país era reivindicarlo. Y así, en 1857 lo trasladaron de Cádiz a la Recoleta. Esta es apenas una pequeña historia del origen de un barrio y de su nombre. Balvanera integra hoy, junto con San Cristóbal, la comuna porteña número tres. Y es mucho más grande que la zona de su plaza principal, que la gente conoce como Once. Al norte la limita Córdoba; al este, Callao y Entre Ríos; al sur, Independencia; y al oeste, Díaz Vélez, Sánchez de Bustamante y Gallo. Y ya nada queda de aquel paraje rural del siglo XVIII. Excepto, qiuzás, el nombre. Aunque con una letra cambiada.

items.title: Congresista demócrata que activó caso Epstein apuesta por juicio político a Trump
items.author: Agencia EFE
items.preview: Congresista demócrata apuesta por un juicio político a Trump en medio de la controversia por los archivos del caso Epstein.
items.content: Trump dice que Epstein era “amigo” de los demócratas ante nuevos señalamientos Demócratas piden un fiscal especial para investigar posibles vínculos de Trump con Epstein El congresista demócrata Ro Khanna , uno de los legisladores que activó la investigación sobre el caso Epstein en el Legislativo en 2025, defiende que la mayoría demócrata que llegará al Capitolio en enero puede compaginar los esfuerzos por mejorar la vida de los estadounidenses y lograr que el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump , rinda cuentas ante el Congreso. “Primero, necesitamos poner fin a la guerra en Irán. Si ponemos fin a la guerra en Irán, eso hará que bajen los precios de la gasolina y de los alimentos, pero también tenemos que hacer un juicio político a Trump para que rinda cuentas por toda la corrupción y por involucrarnos en todas estas guerras ilegales”, explicó Khanna (Filadelfia, 1976) a EFE en la sede del Partido Demócrata en Washington, una semana después de la aplastante victoria electoral de su formación el 3 de noviembre. Los demócratas se preparan para tomar el control del Congreso a partir del mes de enero y en sus filas conviven dos corrientes, una que apuesta por centrarse en resolver los problemas relacionados con el coste de la vida de los estadounidenses y otra que defiende la necesidad de endurecer el discurso y fiscalizar la gestión de Trump en la Casa Blanca. “Podemos hacer ambas cosas”, concluye Khanna. Khanna, que no pierde de vista la principal preocupación de los estadounidenses, la economía, explica que la máxima prioridad demócrata “es reducir los costos, poner fin a la guerra, bajar los precios de los alimentos, de la gasolina y de la atención médica” “El tema central es ayudar a la clase trabajadora y media de este país”, insiste. “Considerando” una candidatura para 2028 Después de las elecciones del 3 de noviembre, un grupo de afines puso en marcha una plataforma llamada “Run Ro” para impulsar su posible candidatura presidencial para 2028. “Lo estoy considerando”, confiesa Khanna a EFE, aunque enseguida devuelve la conversación a los objetivos de los demócratas: “ahora mismo el enfoque es ¿cómo terminamos la guerra en Irán?”. Con una larga trayectoria política (fue subsecretario adjunto de Comercio con el presidente Barack Obama y copresidente de la campaña presidencial de Bernie Sanders en 2020), Khanna apuesta por mantener la presión a la Administración Trump desde el Congreso e intentar activar de nuevo en enero un juicio político contra el secretario de Defensa, Pete Hegseth. “Con suerte podemos lograr que algunos republicanos cedan”, afirma el congresista, que fue uno de los legisladores que lideró la reciente campaña a favor de su destitución que no salió adelante la semana pasada porque once demócratas se ausentaron de la votación. “No fue un buen momento para nosotros”, reconoce Khanna sobre la falta de cuórum. Aunque durante la noche electoral Trump reconoció la victoria de los demócratas, días después y, a través de un mensaje en su red Truth Social, insinuó un fraude en las elecciones de medio mandato sin aportar ninguna prueba. Khanna no se mostró demasiado preocupado por estas acusaciones, argumentando que “la victoria es tan grande, tan masiva, que incluso las afirmaciones de Trump cayeron en saco roto”, antes de resaltar lo que significó para él el 3 de noviembre: “Fue una gran celebración de la democracia estadounidense. Este país está avanzando más allá de los capítulos oscuros de Donald Trump”. VIDEO RECOMENDADO

items.title: Plano de saúde é condenado a fornecer medicamento para paciente com esclerose múltipla no RN
items.author: g1
items.preview: Martelo Justiça Divulgação Um plano de saúde foi condenado pela Justiça do Rio Grande do Norte a fornecer o medicamento Kesimpta 20 mg a um paciente diagnosticado com esclerose múltipla remitente. A operadora havia negado a cobertura do tratamento, alegando que o pedido não atend
items.content: Martelo Justiça Divulgação Um plano de saúde foi condenado pela Justiça do Rio Grande do Norte a fornecer o medicamento Kesimpta 20 mg a um paciente diagnosticado com esclerose múltipla remitente. A operadora havia negado a cobertura do tratamento, alegando que o pedido não atendia aos critérios da Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar (ANS). A decisão foi proferida pela juíza Valéria Maria Lacerda, da 1ª Vara Cível da Comarca de Natal. Além de determinar o fornecimento integral e ininterrupto do medicamento, conforme a prescrição médica, a magistrada condenou o plano de saúde ao pagamento de R$ 6 mil por danos morais. 📳 Clique aqui para seguir o canal do g1 RN no WhatsApp De acordo com o processo, o paciente recebeu o diagnóstico em agosto do ano passado. Um relatório médico apontou que ele havia apresentado um surto medular grave, com lesão extensa, além de fatores associados a um prognóstico desfavorável. Diante do quadro, a médica responsável prescreveu o uso do Kesimpta 20 mg em caráter de urgência. O plano, no entanto, recusou a solicitação. A operadora argumentou que o medicamento não constava no rol de procedimentos da ANS e que havia outras terapias disponíveis, consideradas de primeira linha. A empresa também alegou que a negativa era necessária para preservar o equilíbrio econômico-financeiro e atuarial do contrato. Justiça considerou prescrição médica Ao analisar o caso, a juíza considerou que a relação entre o paciente e a operadora é de consumo e, portanto, deve observar as normas do Código de Defesa do Consumidor (CDC). A magistrada também entendeu que a ausência do medicamento no rol da ANS não justificava, por si só, a negativa de cobertura. Na sentença, considerou que havia relatório médico com justificativa técnica para a escolha do tratamento e indicação da urgência. O documento apontou ainda que o Natalizumabe, medicamento citado pelo plano como alternativa disponível, não seria adequado ao quadro clínico do paciente. A juíza ressaltou que o Kesimpta possui registro sanitário na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa) e indicação terapêutica respaldada cientificamente. “Não cabe à operadora de plano de saúde escolher a conduta terapêutica ou substituir a avaliação do médico assistente habilitado, que detém o contato direto com o paciente e a responsabilidade pelo seu prognóstico clínico”, escreveu a magistrada. Com a decisão, o plano deverá autorizar e fornecer o medicamento de forma integral e contínua, conforme a prescrição médica, além de pagar a indenização de R$ 6 mil por danos morais. Agora no g1

items.title: دافيدوفيتش ينسحب من تشكيلة إسبانيا في كأس ديفيز للتنس
items.author: hamza alshahma
items.preview: يغيب الإسباني أليخاندرو دافيدوفيتش عن منتخب بلاده في منافسات دور الثمانية من ‏بطولة كأس ديفيز للتنس المقررة هذا الشهر، بعد قراره إنهاء موسمه مبكراً، لمنح الأولوية ‏للتعافي بدنياً والاستعداد لموسم 2027، عقب موسم مرهق.‏
items.content: مدريد-سانا ‏ يغيب الإسباني أليخاندرو دافيدوفيتش عن منتخب بلاده في منافسات دور الثمانية من ‏بطولة كأس ديفيز للتنس المقررة هذا الشهر، بعد قراره إنهاء موسمه مبكراً، لمنح الأولوية ‏للتعافي بدنياً والاستعداد لموسم 2027، عقب موسم مرهق.‏ ‏ ‏ ونقلت وكالة رويترز عن دافيدوفيتش قوله: إن هذا الموسم كان صعباً من الناحية البدنية، ‏وأجبرتني الإصابات على التوقف عدة مرات، ولا يزال جسدي بحاجة إلى مزيد من الوقت ‏للتعافي قبل أن أتمكن من المنافسة مجدداً.‏ وكان دافيدوفيتش اختير ضمن تشكيلة إسبانيا المشاركة في دور الثمانية، إلى جانب ‏كارلوس ألكاراز، ورافائيل خودار، وبيدرو مارتينيز، ومارسيل غرانويرس، على أن يحل ‏دانييل ميريدا محله في القائمة.‏ وعانى دافيدوفيتش، المصنف السادس عشر عالمياً، من إصابة في الظهر أبعدته عن ‏الملاعب لمدة شهرين، قبل أن يعود ويتوج بلقب بطولة تشنغدو المفتوحة في أيلول ‏الماضي، كما فاز ببطولة شنغهاي للأساتذة الشهر الماضي.‏ وتُقام منافسات دور الثمانية لكأس ديفيز على الملاعب الصلبة المغلقة في مدينة بولونيا ‏الإيطالية، خلال الفترة من 24 إلى 29 تشرين الثاني الجاري، حيث يلتقي المنتخب ‏الإسباني نظيره النمساوي.‏

items.title: Lindsay Clancy will be retried in March for the killing of her 3 children

items.author: Bouthina Hassan
items.preview: ‏بدأت حركة الطيران تعود تدريجياً إلى طبيعتها في الولايات المتحدة اليوم الإثنين، بعد ‏اضطرابات واسعة شهدتها المطارات الأمريكية واستمرت ثلاثة أيام، إثر قرار طارئ ‏أصدرته سلطات الطيران بتعليق إقلاع الرحلات، بسبب عطل تقني مفاجئ.‏
items.content: ‏ ‏واشنطن-سانا ‏بدأت حركة الطيران تعود تدريجياً إلى طبيعتها في الولايات المتحدة اليوم الإثنين، بعد ‏اضطرابات واسعة شهدتها المطارات الأمريكية واستمرت ثلاثة أيام، إثر قرار طارئ ‏أصدرته سلطات الطيران بتعليق إقلاع الرحلات، بسبب عطل تقني مفاجئ.‏ ونقلت وكالة فرانس برس عن موقع “فلايت أوير” المتخصص في تتبع حركة الطيران، أن ‏أكثر من 250 رحلة، داخلية ودولية من الولايات المتحدة وإليها، أُلغيت اليوم الإثنين، في ‏تراجع ملحوظ مقارنة بأكثر من 2300 رحلة أُلغيت أمس الأحد.‏ كما سُجّلت تأخيرات في أكثر من 700 رحلة على صلة بالولايات المتحدة مقررة الإثنين، ‏مقارنة مع أكثر من 10 آلاف أمس.‏ ويمثل قرار تعليق إقلاع الرحلات الذي صدر يوم الجمعة ثاني إجراء شامل من نوعه ‏تشهده البلاد منذ إغلاق الأجواء الأمريكية بعد هجمات 11 أيلول 2001.‏ ‏وبحسب الجهات المعنية، فإن الفوضى الجوية غير المسبوقة نجمت عن خلل فني طرأ ‏أثناء تحديث شبكة كابلات الاتصال التابعة لمراقبة الملاحة الجوية، وحمّل ترامب إدارة جو ‏بايدن السابقة مسؤولية الأزمة، داعياً الكونغرس إلى تمرير مخصصات مالية لتحديث ‏أنظمة المراقبة الجوية المتهالكة في البلاد

items.content: Robert Pattinson no tapete vermelho de The Batman em Londres Reuters/Tom Nicholson Robert Pattinson será o novo James Bond. O anúncio foi feito nesta segunda-feira (16), nas redes sociais da franquia. "James Bond é um dos personagens mais lendários do cinema, e ser incumbido de interpretar o 007 é a honra de uma vida (...). Dizer que este papel é um sonho realizado é pouco. Não poderia estar mais entusiasmado com esta parceria e com o trabalho que temos pela frente com esta equipe fantástica", disse o ator em um comunicado. A produção do novo longa está sob nova direção, com Denis Villeneuve no comando e roteiro assinado por Steven Knight. Robert Pattinson se transformou em um ídolo adolescente ao estrelar a franquia “Crepúsculo”. Depois disso, estrelou filmes como “Bom Comportamento”, “O Farol”, “Mickey 17” e “Morra, Amor”. O ator britânico ainda brilhou em “Batman”, embora diga que prefere não ser o “protagonista heroico” dos projetos. Robert Pattinson como James Bond Reprodução/Instagram

items.author: g1

items.content: Pais surpreendem filhos na despedida do Ensino Médio em escola do AC 🥺💖 O último dia de aula no ensino médio foi marcado por abraços apertados, presentes, homenagens e lágrimas para 160 alunos da Escola Henrique Lima, em Rio Branco, na última sexta-feira (13). É que em vez de simplesmente se despedirem dos colegas e professores, os estudantes foram surpreendidos pelos pais e familiares, que chegaram com flores, cestas de doces, balões, cartazes e fotos para celebrar o fim de uma etapa importante da vida escolar. (Veja vídeo acima) ✅ Clique aqui para seguir o canal do g1 AC no WhatsApp A atividade faz parte da chamada Aula da Saudade, que chegou a segunda edição neste ano. Ao g1, o diretor da escola, Roberval Rodrigues de Lima, contou que a ideia surgiu em 2025, a partir do pedido de um pai que queria proporcionar um momento especial ao filho. Após o pedido, a escola decidiu ampliar a homenagem e preparar uma surpresa para os alunos. A proposta era que eles tivessem uma aula diferente e, ao final, encontrassem os pais e familiares. "Nós pensamos em fazer uma aula diferente e encerrá-la com uma surpresa: os pais viriam buscar seus filhos com cartazes, flores e presentes. A atividade foi organizada pela escola, com a participação das famílias", contou Roberval. Estudantes se emocionaram ao encontrar os familiares à espera na saída das salas de aula Arquivo pessoal Nas imagens, os alunos começam a sair das salas de aula e encontram os familiares à espera no corredor. Entre abraços, declarações de carinho e mensagens de incentivo, a emoção toma conta do encontro. Alguns estudantes não conseguem segurar as lágrimas diante da surpresa preparada por quem acompanhou de perto a trajetória escolar deles. LEIA MAIS: Alunos apresentam trabalhos sobre protagonismo feminino em feira literária no AC: 'Influenciar gerações' Primeiros participantes deixam locais de prova no 2º dia de Enem no Acre e avaliam exame: 'Nível adequado' Enem 2026: Estudante é barrado de entrar com boletim de ocorrência e mãe acha RG antes de fechar portão no Acre Depois da recepção nas salas de aula, estudantes e familiares foram encaminhados ao pátio da escola, onde havia uma mesa com comidas e um espaço preparado para tirar fotos. O momento também foi de homenagens: com um microfone, pais e familiares fizeram declarações aos estudantes, relembrando a caminhada até a conclusão dessa etapa. Após a surpresa, alunos e familiares se reuniram no pátio da escola para um momento de confraternização Arquivo pessoal 'Emocionante' Ainda de acordo com o diretor, a participação dos familiares dos estudantes foi marcada pelo carinho e pela emoção. "Os pais gostaram muito da ideia e participaram com bastante carinho. O encontro foi muito emocionante para as famílias e para os alunos. Depois, compartilhamos um lanche", relatou. Para Roberval, a atividade vai além de uma comemoração de fim de ano. A proposta é reconhecer o caminho percorrido pelos estudantes, valorizar a conclusão do Ensino Médio e aproximar ainda mais as famílias da comunidade escolar. "A Aula da Saudade celebra a conclusão de uma etapa importante da vida escolar e valoriza a trajetória dos estudantes. Também aproxima a escola das famílias e cria uma lembrança afetuosa para os alunos que estão encerrando o Ensino Médio", destacou. Ainda conforme o diretor, a atividade passou a integrar oficialmente o calendário escolar e deverá acontecer todos os anos. VÍDEOS: g1

items.title: Ladrões invadem loja com veículo em marcha a ré em Ribeirão Preto, SP, mas fogem após alarme de fumaça disparar
items.author: g1
items.preview: Ladrões invadem loja com o furgão em marcha a ré em Ribeirão Preto, SP Uma loja de motos foi alvo de criminosos na madrugada desta segunda-feira (16), em Ribeirão Preto (SP). Eles invadiram o local utilizando um furgão em marcha a ré, mas desistiram da ação menos de um minuto dep
items.content: Ladrões invadem loja com o furgão em marcha a ré em Ribeirão Preto, SP Uma loja de motos foi alvo de criminosos na madrugada desta segunda-feira (16), em Ribeirão Preto (SP). Eles invadiram o local utilizando um furgão em marcha a ré, mas desistiram da ação menos de um minuto depois, quando o alarme de fumaça no interior do estabelecimento disparou. O caso aconteceu por volta das 4h50 em uma loja na Avenida Professor João Fiúsa, na Zona Sul, e foi flagrado por câmeras de segurança. (veja vídeo acima) O veículo utilizado no crime foi furtado momentos antes, da frente de uma casa no Ribeirão Verde, do outro lado da cidade. ✅Clique aqui para seguir o canal do g1 Ribeirão e Franca no WhatsApp Pelo menos cinco pessoas aparecem nas imagens do sistema de monitoramento externo da loja. Os suspeitos chegaram em uma kombi e no furgão furtado e, enquanto um deles se preparava para dar a ré com o veículo e arrombar o portão do estabelecimento, os outros quatro aguardavam ao lado. O furgão chegou a invadir o interior da loja, mas o alarme disparou e a fumaça tomou conta do local. Os suspeitos fugiram na kombi sem levar nada e abandonaram o segundo veículo. Ladrões fugiram depois de alarme de fumaça de loja disparar em Ribeirão Preto, SP Reprodução/Câmeras de segurança A dona do furgão, que pediu para não ser identificada, foi informada pela polícia que o veículo dela foi usado em uma tentativa de furto. Como ele fica estacionado do lado de fora da casa dela, a mulher não sabia que tinha sido levado. "A polícia chegou na minha casa por volta das 5h40 e informou que a Fiorino tinha sido roubada e tinham feito um furto e ela estava dentro da loja". A ação dos criminosos deixou a traseira do furgão danificada e o veículo, que tinha sido vendido e seria entregue ao novo comprador nesta manhã, precisará passar por conserto. O valor do prejuízo ainda não foi contabilizado. items.title: Eduarda Campopiano: Câmara do Rio rejeita pedido para cancelar homenagem
items.author: g1
items.preview: Eduarda Campopiano, do PL, foi a deputada estadual mais votada de São Paulo Reprodução/Instagram A presidência da Câmara Municipal do Rio rejeitou o pedido da vereadora Mônica Benício (PSOL) para suspender a concessão da Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga a Eduarda Campopiano (PL), deputa
items.content: Eduarda Campopiano, do PL, foi a deputada estadual mais votada de São Paulo Reprodução/Instagram A presidência da Câmara Municipal do Rio rejeitou o pedido da vereadora Mônica Benício (PSOL) para suspender a concessão da Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga a Eduarda Campopiano (PL), deputada estadual eleita por São Paulo. A decisão foi assinada pela presidente em exercício da Casa, Tânia Bastos, na sexta-feira (13), e publicada nesta segunda-feira (16) no Diário Oficial da Câmara. No despacho, Tânia afirmou que o requerimento não se enquadrava nas condições previstas pelo Regimento Interno para suspender uma honraria já concedida. Segundo a presidência, o pedido não apontou a existência de processo criminal ou por improbidade administrativa contra a homenageada. A presidente em exercício também entendeu que os critérios para a concessão deveriam ter sido questionados antes da votação, realizada em 10 de novembro. Para Tânia, levar o pedido ao plenário equivaleria a submeter a homenagem a uma segunda votação. A Lei Orgânica do Município prevê votação única para requerimentos. Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga a Eduarda Campopiano gera polêmica Entenda o caso A Câmara Municipal do Rio de Janeiro aprovou, na última terça-feira (10), conceder a Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga a Eduarda Campopiano (PL), eleita deputada estadual de SP. Um abaixo-assinado contra a honraria somava cerca de 529 mil adesões até a última atualização dessa reportagem. A petição foi criada pela advogada Jessica Acocella. O texto critica a escolha de Campopiano, que durante a campanha declarou oposição ao feminismo e se apresenta nas redes sociais como a “maior inimiga das feministas de São Paulo”. ✅Clique aqui para seguir o canal do g1 RJ no WhatsApp “Conceder essa medalha a alguém que se posiciona publicamente como ‘inimiga das feministas’ é uma ofensa à memória de Chiquinha e ao legado que ela deixou”, afirma um trecho do abaixo-assinado. 🔍Criada em 1999, a Medalha Chiquinha Gonzaga leva o nome da compositora, pianista e maestrina carioca considerada pioneira da música popular brasileira. A honraria é destinada a mulheres que se destacaram em causas democráticas, humanitárias, artísticas e culturais e já foi entregue a nomes como Maria Bethânia e Tia Surica. No dia 12 de novembro, a vereadora Monica Benicio (PSOL) apresentou à Presidência da Casa um requerimento para suspender imediatamente a entrega da medalha. A vereadora sustentou que a atuação pública de Campopiano é incompatível com a finalidade da medalha, concedida a mulheres que se destacam em causas democráticas, humanitárias, artísticas e culturais. No requerimento, Mônica citou declarações em que a deputada eleita se apresenta como adversária das feministas e questiona a tipificação do feminicídio. A Câmara também aprovou entregar a Medalha Pedro Ernesto, a maior honraria do Legislativo carioca, a Lucas Pavanato, deputado federal eleito pelo PL por SP. Quem é Eduarda Campopiano Eduarda Campopiano (PL), eleita como deputada estadual mais votada de São Paulo com 1,9 milhão de votos Yasmin Braga/TV Tribuna Campopiano tem 23 anos e foi a mais votada nestas eleições, com quase 2 milhões de votos. Em uma publicação nas redes sociais, afirmou: “Se antes eu já suspeitava, agora tenho plena certeza. Não devo nada ao feminismo. Nenhuma mulher deve.” A posição também aparece em vídeos publicados por ela. Em um deles, Campopiano diz que sua “intenção é combater o feminismo que está na política”. A deputada estadual eleita também contesta o conceito de feminicídio. “Feminicídio é uma armadilha semântica. Nenhuma mulher morre por ser mulher”, afirmou. 🔎Segundo o Fórum Brasileiro de Segurança Pública, 13.703 mulheres foram mortas entre 2015 e 2025 no país, vítimas desse crime. Quem propôs a homenagem A proposta de concessão da medalha foi apresentada pelos vereadores Fernando Armelau, Marcos Dias e Alana Passos, todos do PL, e Leniel Borel, do PP. Na justificativa, os vereadores afirmaram que a homenagem representa um “reconhecimento à trajetória pública de Eduarda Campopiano, à sua atuação política e à sua contribuição para a representatividade feminina nos espaços de decisão”. Os autores também disseram que a medalha “constitui uma honraria destinada a reconhecer mulheres que se destacam por sua atuação e contribuição à sociedade”. Durante a votação, a vereadora Joyce Trindade (PSD) e os vereadores Rick Azevedo e William Siri (PSOL) registraram manifestações contrárias em ata. Pedro Duarte (PSD) se absteve. A proposta passou por aclamação, quando não se contabilizam votos. A concessão da medalha a Campopiano também provocou reação da OAB Mulher. A entidade pediu à presidência da Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil no Rio de Janeiro o envio de um ofício à Câmara Municipal cobrando esclarecimentos. No documento, a OAB Mulher questiona os critérios para a concessão e pede informações sobre a votação e a data prevista para a entrega da comenda.

items.title: Pakistan to host next Makkah alliance summit later this month: DPM Dar
items.author: none@none.com (News Desk)
items.preview: Pakistan will host the next meeting of the Makkah Defence Alliance’s apex committee, likely later this month, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar said on Monday. He made the remarks while answering a query during a press briefing regarding a ministerial meeting o
items.content: Pakistan will host the next meeting of the Makkah Defence Alliance’s apex committee, likely later this month, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar said on Monday. He made the remarks while answering a query during a press briefing regarding a ministerial meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organisation (ECO) held in Islamabad. Asked about regional security architecture, Dar recalled the Aug 7 signing of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye. The pact empowers the three states to treat an attack on any one of them as an attack on all. Providing details on the alliance’s progress, Dar noted that its apex committee, called the Strategic Political and Defence Committee (SPDC), “will actually be meeting, hopefully [at the] end of this month, in Islamabad”. “We offered in our inaugural meeting that our next formal meeting will be held in Islamabad and everybody accepted,” he said, noting that an emergency meeting of the SPDC was held in Riyadh last month amid Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. The SPDC comprises the foreign and defence ministers of the three countries, as well as their top military officials. In response to the question about a possible new security architecture for the region, Dar said: “Well, let me be very honest with you. I think time and again, different regions, including this region, have witnessed that the need and the best way to have regional security is to have some sort of security at the local or domestic architecture. “In other words, this region should have its own security architecture. Maybe this is a beginning.” He remarked that the “global institutions who claim to be masters of having the security arrangement globally were not created in one day”, adding that the Makkah pact was signed for self-defence. ECO Secretary General Asad Majeed Khan and Information Minister Attaullah Tarar were also present at the media briefing. Islamabad has ‘not given up’ on US-Iran peace efforts DPM Dar also reaffirmed that Islamabad has not given up on its diplomatic efforts for a peaceful resolution to the US-Iran war. Replying to a query, Dar said he had “very candid, very frank, very brotherly, very comprehensive discussions” with Iran’s FM Abbas Araghchi on the sidelines of the ECO meeting, which they both attended. Noting that the two discussed the latest regional situation, the deputy premier said Iran had “fast-tracked” its seven-day proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to a two-day plan . “So, the response from the United States is pending. We have not given up hope or efforts. We are still doing our best [so] that the situation gets sorted out,” DPM Dar stated. He also expressed hope that, now that Washington was no longer busy with its midterm elections, it would respond to the proposal “very soon”. Asked how ECO planned to navigate the US sanctions on Iran, considering that the organisation’s secretariat was based in Tehran , Dar said, “Sanctions are not going to be there forever. “And once sanctions are over, the whole world will just land there; I can guarantee,” he maintained, recalling that a British prime minister was the first person to visit Tripoli when sanctions against Libya were withdrawn. More to follow

items.title: Papa Leão XIV se despede do Peru e encerra viagem de 12 dias pela América do Sul
items.author: g1
items.preview: O papa Leão XIV deixa encontro com fiéis e representantes de manifestações de religiosidade popular no Parque Arqueológico Nacional de Saqsaywaman, em Cusco, no Peru, no décimo dia de sua viagem apostólica de 12 dias pela América do Sul. Andrew Medichini / AP Photo/Andrew Medichi
items.content: O papa Leão XIV deixa encontro com fiéis e representantes de manifestações de religiosidade popular no Parque Arqueológico Nacional de Saqsaywaman, em Cusco, no Peru, no décimo dia de sua viagem apostólica de 12 dias pela América do Sul. Andrew Medichini / AP Photo/Andrew Medichini O papa Leão XIV se despediu nesta segunda-feira (16) do Peru, país onde viveu por duas décadas como padre missionário e bispo. O pontífice encerrou uma viagem de 12 dias pela América do Sul, que incluiu visitas ao Uruguai, à Argentina e ao Peru. Ao deixar a residência do Vaticano em Lima, Leão XIV agradeceu aos peruanos por acompanhá-lo durante a visita. Em seguida, disse, em espanhol, “até mais”. O último dia da viagem começou com uma visita a um lar de idosos na região de Callao. O local foi acompanhado pelo então padre Robert Prevost durante a pandemia de Covid-19. Depois, o papa celebrou uma missa em uma base aérea da capital peruana. A expectativa era de que até 1 milhão de pessoas participassem da cerimônia. Papa Leão XIV celebra última missa no Peru antes de retornar ao Vaticano Viagem foi marcada por reencontro com o Peru Nascido em Chicago, nos Estados Unidos, Leão XIV passou cerca de 20 anos no Peru como missionário e bispo. O país é considerado por ele sua segunda pátria. O pontífice também tem cidadania peruana. Durante a chegada ao país, ele afirmou que o Peru era sua “patria”, palavra em espanhol que significa pátria, e cantou o hino nacional ao lado da presidente Keiko Fujimori. Ao longo da viagem, o papa percorreu diferentes regiões do país, incluindo áreas dos Andes e da floresta amazônica. No domingo (15), último dia completo da visita, ele passou por Chiclayo, cidade onde atuou como bispo, Cusco, nos Andes, e Pucallpa, na Amazônia, antes de retornar a Lima. O deslocamento foi marcado por mudanças bruscas de clima e altitude. Em Cusco, por exemplo, o pontífice esteve a cerca de 3.400 metros acima do nível do mar, em uma região de temperaturas mais baixas e menor concentração de oxigênio. LEIA TAMBÉM Papa Leão XIV coroa imagem da Virgem Imaculada, padroeira de Chiclayo, no Peru 'Nenhuma autoridade do Peru fez o que ele fez por nós': como Leão XIV ajudou a população durante enchentes e a pandemia Terremoto atinge a costa do Peru durante visita do papa Leão XIV Papa se inspira em santo missionário A atuação de Leão XIV no Peru e à frente da Igreja Católica tem sido comparada à trajetória de São Toríbio de Mogrovejo, primeiro arcebispo de Lima. Toríbio viveu entre 1538 e 1606 e é lembrado por denunciar abusos cometidos por colonizadores espanhóis contra indígenas e pessoas escravizadas. Ele também percorreu a pé e a cavalo o território de sua arquidiocese para atender fiéis. O religioso aprendeu quéchua e aimará para se comunicar com comunidades indígenas e supervisionou a tradução de ensinamentos da Igreja para essas línguas. A viagem de Leão XIV pela América do Sul começou em 6 de novembro, no Uruguai, e passou pela Argentina, país de origem de seu antecessor, o papa Francisco. Francisco não chegou a visitar a Argentina durante seu pontificado. A realização da viagem chegou a ser colocada em dúvida depois que Leão XIV passou por uma cirurgia relacionada a um câncer no pulmão, em 13 de outubro, em Roma. No início da visita, porém, o pontífice afirmou que não tinha dúvidas de que conseguiria cumprir a agenda.

items.title: A wartime hack becomes an educational tool: meet Yuvi, the AI platform that encourages children to think
items.author: Deborah Danan
items.preview: Created by an army reservist, YuviLab has grown into a platform reaching tens of thousands of children and bringing personalized AI learning into Israeli classrooms. -- The post A wartime hack becomes an educational tool: meet Yuvi, the AI platform that encourages children to thi
items.content: Moti Malka was away on reserve duty when his wife hit the very ordinary wartime wall of trying to help their 10-year-old study for an English test while schools were shut and screens had become the fallback. Malka, a father of four who jokes that he has spent more time in uniform than at his day job as an AI architect at a high-tech firm, used AI to build a game in which his son had to form English sentences correctly to advance in a race. “It took me two minutes to build and my son was captivated, both by the game and how it was made,” he told the Jewish Telegraphic Agency. That experiment turned into YuviLab , an educational AI platform Malka launched in March to encourage children toward a different kind of screen use, one based on “building, experimenting, and thinking creatively,” he said. Earlier this month, YuviLab announced that the Education Ministry had selected Spark, its AI-powered personalized learning platform, for the English-language component of Project 720 , a government-led initiative to bring personalized learning into Israeli schools. He worked on the first version whenever the war left him time, during downtime as a commander in a Home Front Command search-and-rescue unit focused on evacuating people from missile impact sites, and while sheltering with his own family and their newborn. Moti Malka, founder of Israeli AI education startup YuviLab, during his IDF reserve service in 2024. (Courtesy Moti Malka) With the war forcing parents back into remote-learning routines they had hoped had ended with the pandemic, Malka wanted to offer an alternative to Zoom classes where “no child I know learned anything” and days of “far too many hours spent playing Roblox,” watching television or scrolling. Even before the Israel-Hamas war, Israeli children were already spending long hours online. A 2022 Israel Internet Association survey found that about a quarter of Israeli youth spent six to eight hours a day on screens, while 11% spent more than eight hours. The war made those habits harder to contain. A study by Israel’s National Institute for Health Policy Research found that nearly half of parents reported an increase in young children’s screen time, with families of reservists and evacuees reporting bigger increases. Nearly a quarter said ordinary screen-use rules were “infeasible” under wartime conditions. A study by Sharon Cayzer-Haller, a Hebrew University researcher studying screen time in war, followed 318 Israeli adolescents during the first months after the deadly Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas attack that launched the war, and found that the impact of screens depended heavily on how they were used. “Not all screen time is the same,” Cayzer-Haller told JTA. “The key question is not how many hours adolescents spend online, but how they use digital media.” Nearly half of the adolescents – 46% – in the study belonged to what Cayzer-Haller called the balanced-user group, combining communication, learning and social interaction rather than passive scrolling and content consumption. That group reported the highest levels of well-being during the war, while adolescents whose use was mostly passive were more exposed to harmful online content and reported lower well-being. Greater parental involvement and clearer boundaries around screen use were also associated with healthier digital habits. Malka’s initial goal was to move children from consuming content to creating it. Yuvi’s launch coincided with the rise of vibe coding, shorthand for using plain-language AI prompts to build games, apps and other digital tools. Malka, a software developer who admitted he hasn’t written “a single line of code” in nearly two years, said children quickly learn to work with the platform by describing what they want, testing the result and refining the prompt. Yuvi was developed with support from Microsoft and is hosted on Microsoft Azure, where AI-generated content is filtered and personally identifiable information is not stored. In its latest education report in 2025, Microsoft said that 86% of global education organizations are now using generative AI. While Spark is a paid platform for schools, Yuvi’s student-facing platform is free, and lets children build games, apps and learning projects, with tools for parents and teachers to connect that work to school material and track progress. Available in Hebrew, English, Russian and Arabic, the game-building platform is straightforward. A child enters the platform and chooses whether to create a game, a lesson or another project. One student asked Yuvi to build an escape room for learning English, in which the player can leave the room only by solving language questions. In another, more germane example, a student modeled his game on the Iron Dome air defense system, with the player intercepting incoming missiles by answering arithmetic questions correctly. Others have built projects inspired by Minecraft or Roblox, adopting the kind of gaming language they already know for school. As children build games through prompts, Yuvi displays the code being generated in real time. Malka said the feature was encouraged by Microsoft education specialists, who argued that children are naturally curious about how things work and should be able to look under the hood rather than interact only with the finished product. Yuvi has since expanded beyond its original focus on gamifying learning, with the company now concentrating on personalized learning in schools. Its platforms reach tens of thousands of children and are used by thousands of teachers, according to Malka. It uses several AI models rather than a single chatbot, so a coding request, a math explanation and a creative prompt are not all handled the same way. The platform routes each task to the model that designers have determined is best suited for it, while also adapting to the child’s language and level. Malka described Yuvi as “a way for kids to enter STEM,” shorthand for science, technology, engineering and math, fields where Israel has been struggling. The latest results from PISA, an international assessment of 15-year-olds released in September, showed Israeli students scoring well below the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) average in mathematics, science and reading, with scores in all three subjects falling to an all-time low. Last year, the Education Ministry announced a national plan to bring AI into classrooms from fourth through 12th grade, with teacher training, new curricula and tools developed with major technology companies including Google, Microsoft, Apple, and Nvidia. Spark is already in use in Israeli schools through Project 720’s mathematics and science pilot, with Yuvi working across dozens of local authorities, including Jerusalem, Rishon LeZion, and Netanya. The expansion into English follows an announcement by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Education Minister Yoav Kisch of plans to expand AI-assisted English instruction, after just 22% of Israeli ninth-graders met national English curriculum requirements last year. Spark allows students to practice spoken English through conversations with AI at their own level. At an education conference in Jerusalem last week, Israeli-Arab content creator Nuseir Yassin, known as Nas Daily, mused that if he ran the Education Ministry, he would teach only English during the first two years of school. Yassin also predicted that within five years, classrooms of 40 students could have five AI agents providing personalized instruction, with teachers acting as supervisors rather than delivering every lesson themselves. A survey presented at the same conference found that 87% of Israeli teenagers felt schools were failing to prepare them for the future. Nearly 80% expected AI to replace much of teachers’ work, while only 50% of teachers agreed with that assessment. In its education report, Microsoft said AI training has not kept pace with adoption, with 45% of educators globally and 52% of U.S. students saying they had received no AI training. An Israeli survey of more than 27,000 teachers, published in November by the Education Ministry, found that while 76% had received AI training, only about half felt equipped to help students use it. But not everyone is convinced that teaching children to use AI should become a classroom priority. A report by the Brookings Institution released earlier this year, drawing on more than 400 studies and consultations across 50 countries, concluded that the risks of generative AI in children’s education currently outweigh its benefits, particularly because of its potential to undermine foundational learning. Lea Shahar, who left her job as a programmer in high tech as generative AI took off and now teaches coding to high-school students, has a more basic objection. She sees the rush into AI as a poor use of limited school time. The tools are changing too quickly to build a curriculum around them, Shahar said, and part of the appeal of AI is that it is meant to be intuitive. Schools would do better, she argued, to spend more time on skills children are less likely to develop alone on a screen, including interpersonal communication and languages. “Nobody has stopped to ask if we need to embrace AI blindly in schools,” she said. “We’re thinking about the future through our own brains and not through our children’s brains.” Malka said he agrees with part of that critique. Schools should focus on the principles behind AI, he said, not the tools that are constantly evolving. Yuvi’s early users also showed him that fluency does not come automatically. Children were building games and learning modules, but some treated the process as “magic,” he said, giving vague instructions and accepting outputs that looked complete even when they did not match what they had asked for. That prompted the launch of Yuvi Academy earlier this year, a training program meant to teach children how to work with AI before they start building with it. About 1,000 students have since participated in the company’s AI learning activities, including games and hands-on projects, Malka said. “We don’t teach a specific platform,” Malka said. “We teach the principles. How models think, how to ask the right questions, how to build a work process with AI, how to identify mistakes, how to critique answers and how to work with AI agents and complex tasks.” The educator-facing side of Yuvi is meant less as another subject to teach than as a “co-pilot for teachers,” he said, reducing the administrative work around teaching. Teachers can use it to create assignments, presentations, tests and interactive learning units, send them to students and identify where each child struggled. Parents can also follow a child’s progress through their own dashboard. The platform can then generate a personalized exercise for the same student, instead of forcing the teacher to manually build different tasks for every child. “What we’re actually doing is taking the weight off the teacher and giving them more time to be actually teaching and less with the operational side of things,” Malka said. Yuvi also tries to curb one of the main risks of using AI in schools: hallucination. “AI models do not really ‘know’ facts, they only predict what word is most likely to come next,” he said, often producing answers that sound convincing but are wrong. Yuvi’s teacher-facing platform is designed to operate in a closed loop, working from Education Ministry textbooks and other approved classroom materials already uploaded to the system, so its learning units are generated from defined sources rather than the open-ended knowledge of a general chatbot. The system “doesn’t invent beyond the material it was trained on,” Malka said, and teachers can still edit and approve the material before sending it to students. Used properly, Malka said, AI should make users more discerning, not less. “Literacy and critical thinking around artificial intelligence is no longer a ‘nice to have,’” he said, “but a fundamental skill that every child will need in the world we are entering.” -- The post A wartime hack becomes an educational tool: meet Yuvi, the AI platform that encourages children to think appeared first on Jewish Telegraphic Agency .

items.author: hamza alshahma
items.preview: ضبطت الأجهزة الأمنية في محافظة تعز اليمنية، امرأتين يشتبه في عملهما لمصلحة ‏ميليشيا الحوثي.‏
items.content: عدن-سانا‏ ضبطت الأجهزة الأمنية في محافظة تعز اليمنية، امرأتين يشتبه في عملهما لمصلحة ‏ميليشيا الحوثي.‏ ونقلت وكالة الأنباء اليمنية “سبأ” اليوم الإثنين عن الإعلام الأمني التابع لوزارة الداخلية، ‏قوله في بيان: إن عملية الضبط جاءت بعد عمليات رصد ومتابعة نفذتها الأجهزة الأمنية ‏المختصة، وأسفرت عن إلقاء القبض عليهما في إحدى النقاط التابعة لشرطة الدوريات ‏وأمن الطرق بالمحافظة.‏ وأضاف البيان: حسب التحقيقات الأولية، كانت المرأتان تسعيان إلى تنفيذ أعمال إجرامية ‏داخل مدينة تعز، في إطار مخططات تستهدف زعزعة الأمن والاستقرار والإخلال ‏بالسكينة العامة، وخدمة أجندة ميليشيا الحوثي. ‏ وأشار إلى إحالتهما إلى الجهات المختصة لاستكمال الإجراءات القانونية والتحقيقات ‏اللازمة بشأن القضية.‏ وأكدت الأجهزة الأمنية استمرار جهودها في رصد وملاحقة العناصر المتورطة في أنشطة ‏من شأنها المساس بأمن المحافظة وسلامة مواطنيها، واتخاذ الإجراءات القانونية اللازمة ‏بحق كل من يثبت تورطه.‏ وكانت الشبكة اليمنية للحقوق والحريات وثقت في تقرير نشرته في وقت سابق اليوم، ‏ارتكاب ميليشيا الحوثي 574 جريمة وانتهاكاً ‏بحق المدنيين والأعيان المدنية في محافظتَي ‏تعز ولحج خلال الساعات الـ(73) ‏الماضية، بالتزامن مع إطلاق نحو 185 مقذوفاً ‏عشوائياً على أحياء وقرى مأهولة ‏بالسكان.‏

items.author: g1
items.preview: Jovem passa na OAB e homenageia a mãe no cemitério 'Realizei nosso sonho' O objetivo de ser aprovado na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB) é o sonho de muitos estudantes de direito. Entre eles está o amapaense André Araújow que viralizou nas redes sociais com um vídeo após passa
items.content: Jovem passa na OAB e homenageia a mãe no cemitério 'Realizei nosso sonho' O objetivo de ser aprovado na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB) é o sonho de muitos estudantes de direito. Entre eles está o amapaense André Araújow que viralizou nas redes sociais com um vídeo após passar na segunda fase da prova da OAB. O vídeo mostra o advogado indo até o túmulo da sua mãe, Cristina Araújow homenagear ela após a divulgação do resultado. O primeiro vídeo que mostra o depoimento postado pelo advogado já tem quase 2 milhões de visualizações. Ele perdeu a sua mãe, Cristina Araujow, no ano passado em novembro, ela também era formada em direito. ✅ Clique aqui para seguir o canal do g1 AP no WhatsApp "Minha mãe era formada em Direito e também carregava o sonho de ser aprovada na OAB. Mas a vida exigiu muito dela. Entre tantas responsabilidades, dificuldades e os cuidados com os quatro filhos, ela acabou deixando os próprios sonhos para depois. Minha mãe abriu mão de si mesma para que nunca faltasse nada a nós. Ela tinha um sonho, mas escolheu dedicar a vida inteira à realização dos nossos", contou André. Mãe e filho eram formados em Direito e carregavam o sonho de passarem na OAB Acervo pessoal LEIA MAIS: VÍDEO: Macapá amanhece sob fumaça de incêndios e registra qualidade do ar moderada Projeto prepara gratuitamente estudantes de baixa renda para concursos públicos em Macapá André relatou que chegou a pensar em desistir da prova, mas a mãe sempre o incentivou para seguir. Foi quando ele decidiu voltar a estudar, e conseguiu passar na primeira fase e comemorar com a mãe em vida "Minha mãe não conseguiu realizar o sonho dela, mas me ensinou a nunca desistir do meu. E, quando finalmente consegui, a única coisa que faltou foi o abraço dela", disse o advogado. Jovem passa na OAB e homenageia a mãe no cemitério 'Realizei nosso sonho' Repercussão nas redes sociais Segundo André a repercussão do vídeo foi além do que ele imaginava. O advogado tem recebido comentários de vários lugares, com afeto e carinho, e até recebeu uma visita do presidente da OAB no Amapá, Israel Gonçalves, na festa de comemoração da aprovação. "E todo esse acolhimento tem sido algo que jamais conseguirei agradecer suficientemente. Pessoas de diferentes estados, famílias inteiras, páginas gigantes compartilhando nossa história, milhares de mensagens de carinho e até a presença do presidente da OAB na minha comemoração? Tudo isso tem sido muito maior do que eu poderia imaginar", disse André. items.title: Homem morre após ser atropelado por carro na Via Dutra, em Piraí
items.author: g1
items.preview: Um homem morreu após ser atropelado por um carro na noite de domingo (15) na Via Dutra, em Piraí (RJ). O caso aconteceu próximo aos bairros Jaqueira e Varjão, na pista sentido Rio de Janeiro. Segundo a Polícia Rodoviária Federal, dois irmãos, que estavam consumindo bebidas alcoól
items.content: Um homem morreu após ser atropelado por um carro na noite de domingo (15) na Via Dutra, em Piraí (RJ). O caso aconteceu próximo aos bairros Jaqueira e Varjão, na pista sentido Rio de Janeiro. Segundo a Polícia Rodoviária Federal, dois irmãos, que estavam consumindo bebidas alcoólicas em um estabelecimento comercial às margens da rodovia, saíram a pé pela rodovia. Um deles acabou entrando na faixa de rolamento e acabou sendo atropelado por um veiculo. Ainda de acordo com a PRF, os integrantes do carro não ficaram feridos. Já a vítima chegou a ser socorrida em estado crítico por uma equipe de resgate. Ele não resistiu aos ferimentos e morreu no hospital. items.title: ICC judges order end to investigation into alleged crimes by US forces in Afghanistan
items.author: Sondos Asem
items.preview: ICC judges order end to investigation into alleged crimes by US forces in Afghanistan Submitted by Sondos Asem on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 10:56 The decision, signalled in an order first reported by MEE in August, raises questions over whether the court is seeking to ease US pressure fo
items.content: ICC judges order end to investigation into alleged crimes by US forces in Afghanistan Submitted by Sondos Asem on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 10:56 The decision, signalled in an order first reported by MEE in August, raises questions over whether the court is seeking to ease US pressure following sanctions Rosario Salvatore Aitala, now presiding judge of the ICC’s Pre-Trial Chamber II, at his swearing-in ceremony in The Hague on 9 March 2018 (ICC/Flikr) Off Judges at the International Criminal Court (ICC) have ordered the closure of the court’s Afghanistan investigation that covered alleged war crimes by US forces, despite ongoing attempts by prosecutors to appeal the decision. Ending the investigation into alleged US crimes addresses one of Washington ’s longstanding objections to the ICC and one of the reasons behind the sanctions on the court and its officials. The move is therefore likely to raise questions about whether the court is seeking to ease tensions with Washington by signalling that it will no longer pursue allegations against US forces and their allies. The Afghanistan situation at the ICC dates back to November 2017, when then-prosecutor Fatou Bensouda first requested authorisation to investigate alleged crimes committed since 2003, including by Afghan and US forces as well as the Taliban and the IS-K group. That request was initially rejected by a differently composed pre-trial chamber in 2019, before the appeals chamber overturned the decision in March 2020 and authorised the investigation to proceed. Bensouda was sanctioned by the US government a few months later over alleged attempts to subject Americans to the court's jurisdiction. Members of the appeals chamber that authorised the decision were also later sanctioned. Afghanistan II launched In November 2024, six states - Chile, Costa Rica, Spain, France, Luxembourg and Mexico - jointly referred allegations of crimes against women and girls committed since the Taliban's return to power in August 2021, asking prosecutors to fold them into the existing Afghanistan investigation. The latest decision , dated 12 November, closes the strand of the Afghanistan probe that covered the conduct of US forces and the Islamic State-Khorasan Province group, known as IS-K. However, it leaves open the part of the inquiry that prosecutes the Taliban for crimes against humanity allegedly committed against women and other groups while acting as the de facto government of Afghanistan. ICC confirms Middle East Eye reporting on Afghanistan arrest warrants Read More » The Taliban inquiry is now part of a situation titled Afghanistan II, launched by judges on 20 October. Judges have also ordered relevant records, including four Taliban arrest warrants , transferred to that investigation. The move echoes previous reporting by Middle East Eye, which exclusively reported over three months ago that judges had ordered prosecutors to separate the Taliban investigation from the broader Afghanistan inquiry. The judges argued that the post-2021 conduct by the Taliban is "materially different" from the armed conflict-related violence that defined the original investigation authorised in 2020. MEE also reported at the time that judges pointed prosecutors towards a newly introduced procedure for closing the original investigation, the one that nominally covers alleged crimes by all parties, because it sat dormant for years. Sources familiar with the Afghanistan inquiry previously told MEE that the Office of the Prosecutor (OTP) had appealed two of the chamber’s previous decisions: the order to open a separate Taliban investigation and the order transferring court records to it. Those appeals are still pending before the appeals chamber. The OTP has also appealed the latest closure decision. Dialogue with the US MEE reported in December that diplomats at the ICC's annual Assembly of States Parties (ASP) meeting in The Hague said the Trump administration had pressed the court to drop its investigations into Afghanistan and Palestine as a condition for lifting sanctions. It also demanded that states amend the ICC’s founding treaty - the Rome Statute - to prevent the prosecution of nationals from countries that aren’t members of the court, such as the US and Israel . Netherlands denies active talks with US over curbing ICC powers to lift sanctions Read More » Last week, Dutch Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen declined to rule out the suggestion that discussions were taking place with Washington over sweeping restrictions on the ICC. A Dutch foreign ministry spokesperson subsequently told MEE there were “no direct negotiations with the US” on amending the Rome Statute or closing any investigations. The spokesperson said the government was exploring the scope for dialogue with non-member states, but that a US-states parties dialogue had yet to take shape. The idea of dialogue with the US was floated in last year’s ASP in December after an EU diplomat presented the US demands for discussion. MEE revealed at the time that member states disagreed on what such a dialogue would entail, and by the end of the conference agreed that any dialogue should aim at ensuring the independence and effectiveness of the court. The court’s member states are due to meet in The Hague from 30 November to 7 December. Grace period for new sanctions Washington on 9 October imposed institutional sanctions on the ICC, while granting the court a six-month grace period to take measures that would address US demands. Once fully in effect, the measures could stop the court from transacting in US dollars and potentially cripple its operations. The pre-trial chamber's decision in July to split the Afghanistan investigation came days after US Secretary of State Marco Rubio threatened to “dismantle the ICC, brick by brick”, in remarks referencing the court's 2020 decision authorising an investigation into alleged crimes committed in Afghanistan. Since February 2025, the US has imposed retaliatory financial and visa sanctions on court officials in connection with the Afghanistan and Palestine investigations, citing efforts to prosecute nationals or allies of the US, in particular Israel. ​​The first target was Karim Khan , the former prosecutor of the ICC, who was controversially removed by member states in July after an 18-month-long misconduct probe. Also targeted were nine judges, three of whom - Kimberly Prost, Solomy Bossa and Luz Ibanez - were members of the 2020 Appeals Chamber that authorised the Afghanistan investigation. The sanctions came despite the decision by Khan in 2021 to deprioritise the probe concerning US military and CIA personnel, as well as former Afghan government forces, in order to focus the investigation on the Taliban and the Islamic State-Khorasan Province. items.author: النهار
items.preview: أكد الرئيس الأميركي دونالد ترامب اليوم الاثنين أنه سيجري محادثات وصفها بالمهمة خلال القمة الثلاثية التي ستجمعه بنظيريه الروسي فلاديمير بوتين والصيني شي جينبينغ في مدينة شنجن الصينية.وقال قبيل مغادرته الى مانيلا للمشاركة في قمة رابطة دول جنوب شرق آسيا (آسيان) للصحافيين: ستُعقد محا
items.content: أكد الرئيس الأميركي دونالد ترامب اليوم الاثنين أنه سيجري محادثات وصفها بالمهمة خلال القمة الثلاثية التي ستجمعه بنظيريه الروسي فلاديمير بوتين والصيني شي جينبينغ في مدينة شنجن الصينية. وقال قبيل مغادرته الى مانيلا للمشاركة في قمة رابطة دول جنوب شرق آسيا (آسيان) للصحافيين: "ستُعقد محادثات مهمة خلال زيارتي إلى الصين مع بوتين وشي"، معتبراً أن هناك فرصة لتحقيق إنجازات كثيرة، ومشيراً إلى أن جدول الزيارة يتضمن اجتماعات بالغة الأهمية، وأن العلاقات مع الصين جيدة. وأوضح ترامب أن المباحثات ستتناول ملف نزع السلاح النووي، إلى جانب قضايا إيران و أوكرانيا و روسيا . كما أعرب عن اعتقاده بأن بوتين يبدي استعداداً لتقديم تنازلات في الحرب الأوكرانية، لكنه يستطيع اتخاذ موقف أكثر تشدداً. لقاء مع زعيم كوريا الشمالية وأشار إلى أن الجزء الأكبر من الاجتماعات الرئيسية خلال جولته الآسيوية سيركز على الملفات الاقتصادية، لافتاً إلى احتمال عقد لقاء مع الزعيم الكوري الشمالي كيم جونغ أون خلال زيارته إلى الصين. في سياق آخر، أكد ترامب أنه لا يمانع عودة الرئيس التنفيذي السابق لشركة " إنفيديا " جنسن هوانغ إلى منصبه، مشدداً على أن هوانغ لم يشكّل تهديداً للأمن القومي الأميركي. كما وصف ترامب قرار مصر تصنيف جماعة " الإخوان المسلمين " المحظورة منظمة إرهابية بأنه "رائع". وأضاف: "قد أصنف جماعة الإخوان بجميع فروعها كمنظمات إرهابية". عن الهجرة... وفي ما يتعلق بملف الهجرة ، قال ترامب إنَّ المكسيك لن تسمح لقوافل المهاجرين بمواصلة طريقها نحو الولايات المتحدة، محذراً من فرض رسوم جمركية عليها في حال لم توقف هذه القوافل. وقال: "إذا لم توقف المكسيك قوافل المهاجرين المتجهة إلينا فسنفرض عليها رسوماً جمركية".

items.title: قورتولموش يؤكد وقوف تركيا إلى جانب ليبيا ومواصلة دعمها
items.author: Bouthina Hassan
items.preview: أكد رئيس البرلمان التركي نعمان قورتولموش، اليوم الإثنين، استمرار مواصلة دعم بلاده ليبيا، ووقوفها إلى جانبها على المستويين الحكومي والبرلماني.
items.content: أنقرة-سانا أكد رئيس البرلمان التركي نعمان قورتولموش، اليوم الإثنين، استمرار مواصلة دعم بلاده ليبيا، ووقوفها إلى جانبها على المستويين الحكومي والبرلماني. وذكرت وكالة “الأناضول” أن قورتولموش، التقى النائب الأول لرئيس مجلس النواب الليبي طارق الأشتر، على هامش الاجتماع البرلماني المنعقد ضمن أعمال الدورة 31 لمؤتمر الأطراف في اتفاقية الأمم المتحدة الإطارية بشأن تغير المناخ “كوب31″، بولاية أنطاليا التركية. وقال قورتولموش: إن تركيا ستواصل الوقوف إلى جانب ليبيا وشعبها، على المستويين الحكومي والبرلماني، مع استمرار جهودها الرامية إلى دعم استقرارها، مضيفاً أن بلاده تنظر إلى التعاون الوثيق والتضامن مع ليبيا باعتبارهما من مقتضيات العلاقات المتجذرة بين البلدين. كما رحب رئيس البرلمان التركي بموافقة مجلس النواب الليبي بالإجماع على مذكرة التفاهم المتعلقة بتحديد مناطق الصلاحية البحرية بين تركيا وليبيا، معتبراً أن اتخاذ القرار يحمي المصالح الوطنية للبلدين، كما شدد على رغبة تركيا في تعزيز علاقاتها وتعاونها مع مجلس النواب الليبي. وكان مجلس النواب الليبي صوّت بالإجماع في 20 الشهر الماضي، على إلغاء قراره لسنة ‌‏2020 القاضي بقطع العلاقات السياسية مع تركيا، وعلى اعتماد مذكرة التفاهم ‏الموقعة بين حكومة الوفاق الوطني وحكومة الجمهورية التركية بشأن تحديد مجالات ‏الصلاحية البحرية في البحر الأبيض المتوسط.‏ وتهدف مذكرة التفاهم إلى تحديد مناطق الصلاحية البحرية بين ليبيا وتركيا في البحر ‏المتوسط، إذ ترسم خطاً بحرياً يربط بين السواحل الجنوبية التركية والسواحل الشرقية ‏الليبية.‏

items.title: أبرز الأرقام قبل مباراة سوريا والإمارات ودياً
items.author: مضر محفوظ
items.preview: يستعد عشاق كرة القدم لمتابعة قمة عربية حين يتواجه منتخب سوريا الأول مع الإمارات، الثلاثاء 17 تشرين الثاني-نوفمبر 2026 في استاد هزاع بن زايد.ولا تقتصر أهمية هذا اللقاء على كونه محطة تنافسية لكلا المنتخبين لترتيب الأوراق وتجربة الخطط التكتيكية، بل هو استمرار طبيعي لسلسلة تاريخية من
items.content: يستعد عشاق كرة القدم لمتابعة قمة عربية حين يتواجه منتخب سوريا الأول مع الإمارات ، الثلاثاء 17 تشرين الثاني/نوفمبر 2026 في استاد هزاع بن زايد. ولا تقتصر أهمية هذا اللقاء على كونه محطة تنافسية لكلا المنتخبين لترتيب الأوراق وتجربة الخطط التكتيكية، بل هو استمرار طبيعي لسلسلة تاريخية من اللقاءات التي جمعت بين "نسور قاسيون" و"الأبيض" الإماراتي، والتي طالما اتسمت بالندية والإثارة. وتنطلق المباراة عند الساعة 18:10 بتوقيت أبوظبي. مواجهات الإمارات وسوريا بالنسبة إلى الأرقام، تتفوق الإمارات على سوريا لناحية المواجهات المباشرة، حيث التقى الثنائي 19 مرة، فاز "الأبيض" الإماراتي 9 مرات، مقابل 3 لـ"نسور قاسيون"، بينما انتهت 7 مواجهات بالتعادل. على الصعيد التهديفي، سجل هجوم المنتخب الإماراتي 29 هدفاً، مقابل 18 هدفاً للمنتخب السوري. أبرز المواجهات التاريخية بين سوريا والإمارات تصفيات كأس العالم 2010: تعد واحدة من أهم المواجهات الملحمية التي لا تُنسى بين الطرفين، وشهدت تألقاً سورياً لافتاً حسم من خلاله "نسور قاسيون" اللقاء بفوز تاريخي (3 - 1). كأس العرب 2021: لقاء قوي اتسم بالندية في بطولة كبرى، واستطاع المنتخب الإماراتي أن يحسمه لصالحه بنتيجة (2 - 1). آخر انتصار سوري (حزيران/يونيو 2016) بنتيجة 1-0. آخر انتصار إماراتي (سبتمبر 2025) بنتيجة 3-1.

items.title: COAS, Tinubu seek technology-driven security cooperation
items.author: Nwafor
items.preview: The Chief of Army Staff (COAS), Lieutenant General Waidi Shaibu, on Monday joined President Bola Ahmed Tinubu at the opening of the Chief of Defence Intelligence Annual Conference in Abuja, where participants called for stronger intelligence collaboration and technology-driven se
items.content: The Chief of Army Staff (COAS), Lieutenant General Waidi Shaibu, on Monday joined President Bola Ahmed Tinubu at the opening of the Chief of Defence Intelligence Annual Conference in Abuja, where participants called for stronger intelligence collaboration and technology-driven security operations. The conference, held on November 16, 2026, at the Armed Forces Officers’ Mess, Asokoro, was themed, “Optimizing Intelligence Through Technological Innovations and Strategic Partnerships in a Complex Security Environment.” President Tinubu, who was represented by the National Security Adviser (NSA), Mallam Nuhu Ribadu, emphasised the need for stronger intelligence sharing, technological innovation and operational cooperation among security agencies to address emerging security threats. The President also urged security agencies to deepen partnerships with global technology companies and research institutions to strengthen the country’s intelligence-gathering and security capabilities. He further charged Nigerian Defence Advisers serving abroad to maximise bilateral and multilateral engagements to advance the country’s national security interests. The conference attracted top government and military officials, including the Minister of Defence, General Christopher Musa (retd.); the Chief of Defence Staff, General Olufemi Oluyede; Service Chiefs; senior government officials and Defence Advisers. The gathering focused on the role of emerging technologies, intelligence sharing and strategic partnerships in improving the country’s response to evolving security challenges. The participation of the COAS and other military leaders reaffirmed the Armed Forces’ commitment to strengthening a technology-enabled and intelligence-driven security architecture through inter-agency collaboration and strategic partnerships. The initiative is aimed at enhancing operational effectiveness and safeguarding Nigeria’s national security. The post COAS, Tinubu seek technology-driven security cooperation appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: SPONSORED EPISODE: Europe’s ambition to stop cancer
items.author: POLITICO Studio
items.preview: Europe is a leader in cancer research. But turning that science into treatments that reach patients is another matter. Every minute, five people in Europe are diagnosed with cancer, and the disease costs the European economy more than €100 billion a year. Five years after its lau
items.content: Listen on Spotify Apple Music Amazon Music Europe is a leader in cancer research. But turning that science into treatments that reach patients is another matter. Every minute, five people in Europe are diagnosed with cancer, and the disease costs the European economy more than €100 billion a year. Five years after its launch, Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan has been scrutinized by the European Court of Auditors and the European Parliament. Both back its ambitions but find delivery falling short, with national cancer plans often lacking the resources to succeed and access to care varying widely among member countries. Meanwhile, Europe’s share of global commercial clinical trials has almost halved in a decade. With the EU’s proposed Biotech Act under negotiation and talks on the bloc’s next long-term budget under way, Europe has a chance to close the gap between innovation and access. In the second of two special podcast episodes produced by POLITICO Studio, experts in cancer policy explore what Europe must do to ensure every patient benefits from innovations in cancer care, from speeding up clinical trials to giving patients a real voice in policymaking. Hear from Elisabetta Zanon, chief executive of the European Cancer Organisation, which brings together cancer professionals and patients from across Europe; and Jennifer Young, VP and head of International Commercial Policy and Communications for Pfizer. items.content: مرحباً من "النهار" إليكم أبرز 5 أخبار بارزة حتى الساعة الخامسة بتوقيت بيروت. 1- والتز يلتقي الرؤساء الثلاثة: نأمل أن يسلم "حزب الله" سلاحه طوعاً (صور) جال السفير الأميركي لدى الأمم المتحدة مايك والتز على الرؤساء الثلاثة، في زياة بالغة الأهمية لما يحمله معه من طرح بشأن مستقبل جنوب لبنان ومرحلة ما بعد اليونيفيل. من قصر بعبدا، استهل والتز زيارته اليوم الإثنين بلقاء الرئيس اللبناني جوزف عون بحضور السفير الأميركي في بيروت ميشال عيسى ورئيس الوفد اللبناني المفاوض السفير سيمون كرم. 2- جمعية المصارف في لبنان تعلن إضراباً تحذيرياً كل أربعاء أعلنت جمعية مصارف لبنان إضراباً تحذيرياً يوم الأربعاء من كل أسبوع خلال الأسابيع المقبلة، اعتباراً من الأربعاء 18 تشرين الثاني 2026، احتجاجاً على المعالجة الضريبية المقترحة للمصارف، والمطالبة باتخاذ الإجراءات التشريعية اللازمة، ولا سيما في إطار مناقشة مشروع قانون الموازنة. 3- الأردن والعراق يحجبان "تلغرام" في يوم واحد... ما الأسباب وماذا نعرف عن التطبيق؟ أعلنت السلطات الأردنية والعراقية، الاثنين 16 تشرين الثاني 2026، حجب تطبيق المراسلة "تلغرام"، في قرارين استندا إلى اعتبارات أمنية وتنظيمية، وسط تشديد البلدين على ضرورة الحد من استخدام المنصات الرقمية في نشر المحتوى المخالف للقانون والتهديدات والجرائم الإلكترونية. 4- القوات العراقية تستعد لدخول جرف الصخر... ومهلة لخروج "حزب الله" أكد المتحدث باسم الحكومة العراقية حيدر العبودي، اليوم الاثنين، أن القائد العام للقوات المسلحة علي الزيدي وجه القوات المسلحة بالدخول إلى منطقة جرف الصخر. وكشف عن تحديد مهلة لخروج كتائب "حزب الله" من جرف الصخر، مشيراً إلى أن لجنة تحقيقية عليا رصدت تلاعباً في أنابيب النفط ووجود مصافٍ وخزانات وصهاريج داخل المنطقة. 5- تحذير دولي من خطر حادث نووي في أوكرانيا هذا الشتاء حذّرت هيئات معنية بتنظيم السلامة النووية تمثل 38 دولة، اليوم الإثنين، من تزايد خطر وقوع حادث نووي في أوكرانيا خلال فصل الشتاء، داعيةً روسيا إلى وقف هجماتها على البنية التحتية للطاقة في البلاد، والتي تعتمد عليها المحطات النووية لتشغيل أنظمتها بأمان.
