items.title: Everyone wants to be Sephardic. I discovered I already was.
items.author: Rebecca Ucuzoglu Guberman
items.preview: A teen's journey into family history opened a window onto the diversity of Jewish identities in America. -- The post Everyone wants to be Sephardic. I discovered I already was. appeared first on Jewish Telegraphic Agency .
items.content: This article was produced as part of JTA’s Teen Journalism Fellowship , a program that works with Jewish teens around the world to report on issues that affect their lives. I thought I knew my family’s story. One conversation during Passover made me realize how much I had never asked. I had always understood myself as Ashkenazi, never realizing that my last name, Ucuzoglu, also carried a Sephardic history. It was Passover 2026, and I was aboard a cruise ship in the Pacific Ocean, nestled around the seder table with my family. My family started to discuss Passover customs, including why many Sephardic Jews , with roots in Iberia, North Africa and the Middle East, eat rice and beans during Passover, while Ashkenazi tradition , a product of Central and Eastern Europe, generally prohibits them. The debate over “ kitniyot ,” the category of foods that includes rice and beans, has been a light-hearted topic in Ashkenazi circles for years. On a more serious note, Ashkenazi institutions have been making room for Sephardi customs — not just out of “Sephardi envy,” but in order to explore new varieties of Jewish ritual and culture. In 2022, the independent B’nai Jeshurun synagogue in New York offered Homeward Bound: An Experience of Sephardic Selichot , bringing Sephardic penitential prayers into its preparations for High Holidays. At Valley Beth Shalom in Encino, California, its T’marim Sephardic Shabbat Service draws on musical traditions from several Jewish communities. Communities with large Israeli American populations are also expanding their programming to welcome Sephardim and Mizrachi, or Middle Eastern, Jews, who often share customs distinct from Ashkenazim. Little did I know that I’d be joining this trend in a way that extended far beyond what we eat on Passover. What began as a conversation about other Jews’ customs made me realize how much of my own family’s history I had yet to understand. After the conversation died down, my family returned to our cabin. Hoping to revive the conversation, I showed my parents the comedy sketch “The Differences Between Ashkenazi & Sephardic Jews” by Modi. My family erupted with laughter, then continued the conversation we started at dinner. We spoke first about my mother’s Ashkenazi side of the family, whose stories of survival inspired awe in me. According to these family stories, my great-great-grandfather was the leader of his community in Bessarabia, a province in the Russian Empire from 1812 till 1918. In our family’s telling, Guberman meant “leader of the town.” He also traced his ancestry back to the Levi tribe. The author, right, and her mother, Cristiane Guberman, celebrate Passover aboard a cruise ship in the Pacific Ocean, April 2026.(Courtesy of the Guberman family) With waves of pogroms launched against the Jews, my great-grandfather, Moyses, fled on a boat by himself, leaving behind his siblings and parents and escaping to Brazil. All of his siblings, with the exception of one, eventually did the same, departing on different boats, not knowing if they would ever see their family again. My great-grandfather was able to reunite with one of his sisters five years later in Rio de Janeiro. One of his other siblings ended up in Argentina, which we discovered only decades later when we met a family there with the same last name as ours, Guberman. My great-great-grandparents did not have the money necessary to emigrate. They stayed behind. They were ultimately imprisoned and presumably killed during the Kishinev pogrom circa 1903. The one sibling who did not escape chose to help them. According to my family’s account, he was later sent to a detention camp with his wife and survived by bribing an officer. That story of survival made me proud of my Ashkenazi ancestry. I had barely thought to ask about the other half, my father’s side. My paternal grandfather passed away from cancer when I was 9 years old. I remember his curly white hair and his deep obsession with “Star Wars,” but I never asked him where his parents came from. I inherited two last names, Ucuzoglu and Guberman. Ucuzoglu is a last name from my father’s side, and I could not pronounce it nor understand its significance. My father had assumed that my grandfather was Ashkenazi and that my grandmother was Sephardic. During that Passover conversation, we learned from my aunts that the labels were actually the opposite. My paternal grandfather was Sephardic. I had spent 15 years telling my family’s story without knowing half of it. Learning that my grandfather was Sephardic led me to explore how my family came to carry the name Ucuzoglu, and how that name helped them survive. My great-grandfather was born in Turkey, and his wife was born in Rhodes, Greece. According to my family’s account, he decided to move to Italy circa 1930 because he saw heightened antisemitic rhetoric taking hold in Turkey. But the place he hoped would offer safety became another place to flee. Mussolini’s government began enacting antisemitic laws in 1938. In desperation, my great-grandfather rushed to the Turkish embassy in Italy to change his last name, Salmon, and conceal his Jewish identity. As the story was passed down to me, he spent all of his life savings on a name that would grant him protection and hide their Judaism. They gave him the uncommon name “Ucuzoglu,” the prefix “ucuz” meaning cheap or inexpensive and the suffix “oglu” meaning “son of.” With a new identity they set off on a treacherous journey to the U.S., stopping in Cuba before crossing the waters to reach America’s promised freedom. While this was a miracle for my great-grandparents, they were forced to leave the rest of their relatives behind.Those who could not afford the name change were sent to concentration camps and never seen again. I now understand that the name I had struggled to pronounce helped my great-grandparents survive. Learning more about my own family’s history has made me aware of how many other Jews are discovering parts of their identities that have been lost or forgotten, and finding ways to reclaim them. In Hadassah Magazine , journalist Sue Fishkoff describes some Ashkenazi Jews embracing Mizrachi music and post-Passover celebrations. “They’re missing part of their own history and culture,” Rabbi Marc Angel told the magazine, referring to Jews unfamiliar with Sephardic and Middle Eastern traditions. “Judaism belongs to all of us.” Seeing these congregations embrace Sephardic prayers and melodies reminds me how much there is to discover beyond the Passover customs that first sparked our conversation. In her recent Sapir essay, “The Future is Sephardic,” Mijal Bitton argues that American Jewry, so long dominated by Ashkenazi culture, needs to learn from the traditions and communal outlook of Sephardic Jews, particularly those whose families came from the Middle East and North Africa. When she writes about “Sephardic envy,” it’s not just about eating rice and beans on Passover, but creating Jewish identities that do not depend on the approval of others. “Sephardic Jews from the Muslim world, those whose American identities were never tied to elite validation, embody a different orientation,” she writes. “Their confidence comes more from within: from family continuity, communal life, economic stability, and ancestral memory.” For me, that connection between family and belonging became tangible through my surname. What had once felt like an arbitrary collection of letters now stood for a word I could easily pronounce and spell: survival. Each letter connected me to the people who made my life possible. I think about the questions I never asked my grandfather. I cannot recover every answer, but I can preserve the stories we still have. Discovering my Sephardic ancestry does not erase the Ashkenazi history that first made me proud to be Jewish. It gives me more of my family to remember, more to learn, and more to pass on. Those prayers, melodies and customs endure because each generation finds its own connection to what it has received. Bitton told me in an email that belonging is at the heart of that continuity. “What others can borrow is the habit of not treating Jewish belonging as a decision you have to keep re-justifying,” she wrote. “You show up in the way you’d do for your family.” What changed that Passover was my understanding of an inheritance that had been mine all along, and my responsibility to carry it forward. -- The post Everyone wants to be Sephardic. I discovered I already was. appeared first on Jewish Telegraphic Agency .

items.title: Baghdad launches crackdown against Kataib Hezbollah
items.author: Amr Salem
items.preview: Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has launched a major crackdown against the Iran-backed militia Kataib Hezbollah over an illicit oil-smuggling network operating in its stronghold of Jurf […] The post Baghdad launches crackdown against Kataib Hezbollah a
items.content: Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has launched a major crackdown against the Iran-backed militia Kataib Hezbollah over an illicit oil-smuggling network operating in its stronghold of Jurf al-Sakhr. Iraqi officials estimate the scheme has stolen hundreds of millions of dollars from the state since 2021, with monthly illicit revenues reaching up to $30 million. Investigators uncovered concealed pumping equipment inside hangars and a hidden oil refinery in Jurf al-Sakhr, located about 50 kilometers south of Baghdad. The network illegally tapped into strategic pipelines—including a 26-inch pipeline carrying at least 200,000 barrels per day—to siphon crude oil onto tanker trucks. Following the investigation, al-Zaidi dismissed nine senior security and oil-sector officials and referred suspects to the judiciary. Those removed include the Babil provincial police chief, local intelligence and security commanders, and the director of the state-run Oil Pipelines Company. According to Reuters, al-Zaidi has ordered senior military and security commanders to deploy additional forces around Jurf al-Sakhr. Troops are preparing to enter the militia-controlled town, raising the risk of direct armed confrontation. Kataib Hezbollah has denied the smuggling allegations, claiming the storage tanks and workshops found by investigators were used to fuel military equipment. The group characterized the government probe as a campaign of “blackmail” designed to force it to surrender its weapons. The crackdown comes amid heightened US pressure on Baghdad to curb Iranian influence and illicit oil networks in Iraq, following US sanctions imposed earlier this year on Iraqi officials and militia-linked entities. The post Baghdad launches crackdown against Kataib Hezbollah appeared first on Iraqi News .

items.title: Buju, Shaggy, Chronixx, Protoje, Runkus and Ziggy vie for Grammy Best Reggae Album
items.author: BY KEVIN JACKSON Observer Writer
items.content: Buju Banton’s Too Too Bad , Shaggy’s Lottery , Chronixx’s Exile , Protoje’s Art of Acceptance , Supernova by Runkus and Brightside by Ziggy Marley are the nominees for Best Reggae Album for the 69th annual Grammy Awards. The nominations were announced Monday morning. Too Too Bad is Buju Banton’s eight nomination. He was previously nominated in 1999 for Inna Heights , 2004 for Friends for Life , Too Bad in 2007, Upside Down in 2020, Rasta Got Soul in 2010, Born for Greatness in 2024 and Before the Dawn (which won in 2011). Exile has given Chronixx his second nomination. He got a nod in 2018 for Chronology . Brightside gives Marley his seventh solo nomination in the reggae category. He won in 2014 for In Concert , the self-titled Ziggy Marley in 2017, Love is My Religion in 2007 and Fly Rasta in 2015. His other nominations were for Rebellion Rises (2019), and Wild and Free in 2012. As the lead singer for Ziggy Marley and the Melody Makers outfit, the group was nominated seven times but only won three times: Conscious Party (1989), One Bright Day (1990) and Fallen is Babylon (1998). The Art of Acceptance , the latest effort by Protoje, gives the St Elizabeth-born artiste his third nomination. He earned nods for 2019’s A Matter of Time and 2023’s Third Time’s The Charm . Supernova is the first nomination for Runkus, while Lottery is the eighth nomination for Shaggy. Shaggy won in 1996 for the platinum-selling Boombastic and again in 2019 for 44/876 , a collaborative effort with Sting. The 69th Grammy Awards ceremony is scheduled for February 7 at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles.

items.title: تخفيضٍ احترازي لمنسوب سد بلّوران في ريف اللاذقية لاستيعاب الفيضانات القادمة
items.author: hamza alshahma
items.preview: بدأت مديرية الموارد المائية في اللاذقية اليوم الإثنين تخفيض منسوب بحيرة سد ‏بلّوران في الريف الشمالي في إجراءٍ احترازي، وذلك بعد بلوغ السد طاقته التخزينية ‏القصوى البالغة 15.5 مليون متر مكعب، وبهدف استيعاب الفيضانات المطرية ‏القادمة خلال الموسم الشتوي المقبل.‏
items.content: ‏ اللاذقية-سانا بدأت مديرية الموارد المائية في اللاذقية اليوم الإثنين تخفيض منسوب بحيرة سد ‏بلّوران في الريف الشمالي في إجراءٍ احترازي، وذلك بعد بلوغ السد طاقته التخزينية ‏القصوى البالغة 15.5 مليون متر مكعب، وبهدف استيعاب الفيضانات المطرية ‏القادمة خلال الموسم الشتوي المقبل.‏ ‏ ‏ وأوضح رئيس مجموعة سد بلّوران فراس علان في تصريحٍ لمراسل سانا أن ‏الهطلات المطرية الغزيرة والمبكرة التي شهدها هذا العام أدت إلى امتلاء سد بلّوران ‏بكامل طاقته التخزينية الأعظمية، إذ إن فيضان السد يحدث عادةً في فصل الربيع، ‏وفي بعض السنوات خلال شهر كانون الثاني.‏ ‏ ‏ ‏ وبيّن علان أن مديرية الموارد المائية في اللاذقية اتخذت نتيجةً لهذه الظروف ‏الاستثنائية، قراراً بتخفيض منسوب البحيرة لاستيعاب الفيضانات المطرية القادمة ‏خلال الموسم الشتوي المقبل، حيث تم اليوم فتح السكر المفرغ باتجاه النهر لتصريف ‌‏0.6 متر مكعب في الثانية، مرجِّحاً احتمال زيادة الغزارة خلال الأيام القادمة لتخفيض ‏المنسوب بشكلٍ أكبر تبعاً للفيضانات المطرية المقبلة.‏ تعزيل مجرى النهر المغذي للسد وفي السياق ذاته، لفت علان إلى أن المديرية قامت بتعزيل مجرى النهر المغذي للسد ‏بمسافة 3 كيلومترات لضمان عدم حدوث فيضانات على الأراضي الزراعية والمنازل ‏على طول المجرى.‏ وكان سد بلّوران سجّل امتلاءً كاملاً أيضاً في شهر شباط الماضي ليصل حجم ‏التخزين إلى طاقته القصوى، وذلك مع الهطلات المطرية الغزيرة التي شهدتها ‏المنطقة حينها.‏ ‏ ‏ ويُعد سد بلّوران من أبرز السدود الحيوية في ريف اللاذقية الشمالي، سواءً لأغراض ‏الري أو الشرب أو لأهميته السياحية والبيئية، حيث يروي ما يقارب 1370 هكتاراً ‏من الأراضي الزراعية الخصبة أسفل السد، إضافةً إلى تأمين مياه الشرب لعشرات ‏القرى في الريف الشمالي بالمحافظة، فهو يسهم بدورٍ مزدوج في دعم الأمن المائي ‏والغذائي للمنطقة.‏

items.title: AI fuels 8,400% surge in child sex abuse reports – study
items.author: RT
items.preview: Reports of AI-generated child sexual abuse material have surged more than 8,400% in two years, Edinburgh University researchers say Read Full Article at RT.com
items.content: Increasingly powerful tools have generated an unprecedented rise in fake sexual imagery, exposing victims to blackmail and exploitation Artificial intelligence has fueled an explosion in child sexual abuse imagery, with reports of AI-generated material soaring by more than 8,400% in just two years, according to a major international study. Researchers warn that increasingly powerful AI tools are being used to create sexually explicit deepfakes of real children, exposing victims to blackmail and exploitation. The Childlight Global Child Safety Institute at the University of Edinburgh found that reports linked to AI-generated child sexual abuse material submitted by technology companies to the US-based National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) jumped from around 4,700 in 2023 to more than 400,000 in 2025. AI-powered 'nudify' apps can turn ordinary photographs into realistic sexually explicit images within seconds, which can then be used for blackmail and extortion. NCMEC identified more than 275 children directly victimized through AI-generated sexual abuse material in 2024 and 2025. Some perpetrators were people the children knew personally. Read more Elon Musk’s X facing new EU probes “The speed at which artificial intelligence is changing the threat to children is deeply concerning,” said Professor Debi Fry, Childlight’s global director of data. She acknowledged that improved detection and reporting may partly explain the surge. Childlight estimates that more than 300 million children worldwide experience technology-facilitated sexual exploitation or abuse annually, while one in four face online abuse before adulthood. The UK-based Internet Watch Foundation (IWF) identified 3,443 AI-generated child sexual abuse videos in 2025, compared with just 13 a year earlier. Nearly two-thirds fell into the most severe category under British law. In June, Canada's privacy watchdog found that Elon Musk's X and xAI had violated privacy laws by launching Grok's image-generation tool without adequate safeguards against sexualized deepfakes. The Center for Countering Digital Hate estimated that Grok generated around 3 million sexualized deepfakes over 11 days, including more than 23,000 depicting children. Read more US court halts AI nude-image ban challenged by Musk The European Commission launched an investigation into X in January over Grok's generation of illegal sexualized deepfakes, including child sexual abuse material. British regulators opened separate probes into X and xAI over concerns about inadequate safeguards. Regulators are struggling to keep pace with rapidly advancing AI technology, which has exposed gaps in laws designed to combat online abuse. Britain's Ofcom has acknowledged that existing legislation does not fully cover standalone AI chatbots, allowing some image-generation tools to operate beyond the reach of current online safety rules. Britain's AI Security Institute has warned that even testing AI models before release cannot fully prevent misuse, particularly when software can be downloaded, modified, and run independently. It has proposed stricter safety testing, access controls, and monitoring throughout the development and deployment of AI systems. The findings come as AI systems increasingly breach security boundaries or are weaponized for cyberattacks. In September, Australia confirmed that an OpenAI agent bypassed government security controls and accessed restricted Medicare files. The following month, researchers linked AI-assisted hacking to cyberattacks targeting at least nine South Korean banks.

items.title: مسؤول أممي يؤكد تعرض آلاف الفلسطينيين للتعذيب في السجون الإسرائيلية
items.author: Maher Faraj
items.preview: أكد المتحدث باسم مفوضية الأمم المتحدة لحقوق الإنسان ثمين الخيطان، أن المفوضية وثّقت تعرض معتقلين فلسطينيين للتعذيب وسوء المعاملة على نطاق واسع وبشكل ممنهج في السجون الإسرائيلية، داعياً إلى "الإفراج عن جميع المعتقلين الفلسطينيين تعسفياً".
items.content: جنيف-سانا أكد المتحدث باسم مفوضية الأمم المتحدة لحقوق الإنسان ثمين الخيطان، أن المفوضية وثّقت تعرض معتقلين فلسطينيين للتعذيب وسوء المعاملة على نطاق واسع وبشكل ممنهج في السجون الإسرائيلية، داعياً إلى “الإفراج عن جميع المعتقلين الفلسطينيين تعسفياً”. ونقلت وكالة الأنباء الفلسطينية وفا عن الخيطان قوله في تصريحات صحفية، اليوم الإثنين: إن “إدارة السجون الإسرائيلية أكدت احتجاز أكثر من 9 آلاف و200 فلسطيني حتى شهر تشرين الأول الماضي”. وذكر المتحدث الأممي أن بيانات سجون الاحتلال حتى حزيران الماضي أظهرت احتجاز أكثر من 370 طفلاً فلسطينياً، مشيراً إلى أن “الوثائق المتوافرة لدى المفوضية تظهر تعرض المعتقلين الفلسطينيين للتعذيب وسوء المعاملة على نطاق واسع وبشكل ممنهج داخل معتقلات الاحتلال، كما تؤكد وقوع حالات عنف بحقهم. وفي السياق، دعا الخيطان إلى الوقف الفوري لجميع الممارسات التي قد تشكل اعتقالاً تعسفياً أو اختفاءً قسرياً أو تعذيباً أو غير ذلك من أشكال سوء المعاملة، مشدداً على أن مكتب الأمم المتحدة لحقوق الإنسان أكد مقتل ما لا يقل عن 93 فلسطينياً أثناء اعتقالهم منذ تشرين الأول عام 2023. وجدد الخيطان دعوته إلى إجراء تحقيقات مستقلة وسريعة وشفافة، ومحاسبة المسؤولين عن مقتل المعتقلين، مؤكداً أن الاحتلال يتحمل المسؤولية عن أي وفاة تقع خلال فترة الاعتقال لحين استكمال التحقيقات. في وقت سابق من اليوم قُتل فلسطيني وأصيب ثلاثة آخرون برصاصٍ إسرائيلي في قطاع غزة، بينما ‏اعتُقل 18 فلسطينياً في حملة مداهمات بالضفة الغربية.‏

items.title: تربية الحسكة توقف الدوام في ثلاث مدارس بسبب انتشار الحشرات
items.author: Batol Albasha
items.preview: أعلنت مديرية التربية والتعليم في محافظة الحسكة اليوم الإثنين، إيقاف الدوام المدرسي ‏مؤقتاً في ثلاث قرى بمنطقة الشدادي جنوب المحافظة، نتيجة الانتشار الكثيف للحشرات ‏في المنطقة.‏
items.content: الحسكة-سانا أعلنت مديرية التربية والتعليم في محافظة الحسكة اليوم الإثنين، إيقاف الدوام المدرسي ‏مؤقتاً في ثلاث قرى بمنطقة الشدادي جنوب المحافظة، نتيجة الانتشار الكثيف للحشرات ‏في المنطقة.‏ وأوضحت المديرية، في بيان نشرته عبر صفحتها على فيسبوك، أنها تابعت تأثر عدد ‏من المدارس في قرى جرمز وعدلة والنعامة بانتشار أعداد كبيرة من الحشرات في مواقع ‏عدة، وقررت بناءً على ذلك تعليق الدوام في المدارس المتضررة، إلى حين استكمال ‏الجهات المختصة الإجراءات اللازمة وإزالة أسباب الخطر.‏ وأضافت المديرية أنها ستعلن موعد استئناف الدوام بعد التأكد من تهيئة الظروف المناسبة ‏لعودة الطلاب إلى مدارسهم بأمان.‏ من جهته، أوضح المشرف الإداري في المجمع التربوي بمدينة الشدادي حمد العبد أن ‏المدارس والقرى المذكورة تشهد انتشاراً كثيفاً لحشرة “صرصور الحقل الأسود”، ما أدى إلى ‏تغطية الجدران والأرضيات داخل المدارس، وتسبب بحالة من الخوف والإزعاج بين ‏التلاميذ.‏ ودعا العبد الجهات المعنية إلى تكثيف جهودها لمكافحة هذه الحشرة في أسرع وقت ‏ممكن، بما يضمن احتواء انتشارها وعودة الحياة إلى طبيعتها، تمهيداً لإعادة فتح المدارس ‏واستئناف العملية التعليمية.‏ وكانت مديرية الزراعة في محافظة الحسكة أكدت مطلع الشهر الجاري أن انتشار ‏صرصور الحقل الأسود في قرى الريف الجنوبي ظاهرة حشرية موسمية ترتبط بالتقلبات ‏الجوية، مشيرةً إلى أن هذه الحشرات آمنة ولا تنقل الأمراض الفتاكة، وداعيةً إلى اتباع ‏الإرشادات الوقائية واتخاذ الإجراءات الحقلية اللازمة للحد من انتشارها.‏

items.title: Twee massale schietpartijen in Zuid-Afrika; 17 doden
items.author: NOS Nieuws
items.preview: Bij twee afzonderlijke schietpartijen in Zuid-Afrika zijn gisteren zeventien mensen om het leven gekomen. Een van de twee schietpartijen was in een buitenwijk van de bestuurlijke hoofdstad van het land, Pretoria. Daar kwamen negen mensen om het leven, zes mannen en drie vrouwen.
items.content: Bij twee afzonderlijke schietpartijen in Zuid-Afrika zijn gisteren zeventien mensen om het leven gekomen. Een van de twee schietpartijen was in een buitenwijk van de bestuurlijke hoofdstad van het land, Pretoria. Daar kwamen negen mensen om het leven, zes mannen en drie vrouwen. De politie werd vanochtend vroeg gealarmeerd over een schietpartij die de avond ervoor rond 22.00 uur had plaatsgevonden. Eenmaal aangekomen in de wijk Jeffsville in het township Atteridgeville troffen de hulpdiensten de negen dodelijke slachtoffers aan in een met golfplaten opgebouwde woning. Mogelijk sprake van wraak Zuid-Afrikaanse media schrijven dat de slachtoffers om het leven kwamen nadat schutters in de vierkamerwoning het vuur hadden geopend. De lichamen werden vanochtend ontdekt nadat een kind naar de hut was gegaan om een familielid te zoeken. De lokale autoriteiten houden er rekening mee dat er sprake was van een wraakactie. Een van de slachtoffers zou betrokken zijn geweest bij een schietpartij in december 2025, in hetzelfde township, waarbij twaalf mensen werden gedood. "We kunnen niet uitsluiten dat ze met elkaar verband houden en het mogelijk een vergeldingsaanval was", aldus een politiecommissaris, die ook wist te melden dat er nog geen arrestaties zijn verricht. De tweede schietpartij, waarbij acht doden vielen, was in het oosten van het land, in de stad Pietermaritzburg. Daar werd zondagavond een wit busje met kogels doorzeefd. Acht mannen kwamen om het leven. Vermoedelijk was het voertuig waarin zij zaten een taxi die besteld was via een app, aldus de Zuid-Afrikaanse nieuwssite IOL . De site laat ook een vrouw aan het woord die getuige was van de schietpartij. Zij vertelt dat ze met haar twee kleinkinderen onder de tafel dook toen ze de schoten hoorde. Een kogel raakte haar huis. De acht mannen werden door de politie ter plaatse doodverklaard. Ook in deze zaak zijn er nog geen arrestaties verricht, al zegt de politie bezig te zijn met een klopjacht. Dodelijk geweld is een groot probleem in het land. Volgens de cijfers van de Zuid-Afrikaanse politie werden dit jaar in de maanden mei tot en met juni per dag gemiddeld 60 mensen vermoord, wat wel een daling is van tien procent ten opzichte van een jaar eerder.

items.title: MP seeks probe into UK parliamentary group’s funding links to Israeli firm
items.author: Imran Mulla
items.preview: MP seeks probe into UK parliamentary group’s funding links to Israeli firm Submitted by Imran Mulla on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 10:45 APPG on Israel’s UK funder was owed reimbursements by an Israeli firm seeking to shape debate in parliament A gull flies by the River Thames, near Westmi
items.content: MP seeks probe into UK parliamentary group’s funding links to Israeli firm Submitted by Imran Mulla on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 10:45 APPG on Israel’s UK funder was owed reimbursements by an Israeli firm seeking to shape debate in parliament A gull flies by the River Thames, near Westminster Bridge and the Elizabeth Tower, commonly known as Big Ben, at the Houses of Parliament in central London on 12 November 2026. (AFP) Off The UK parliament’s standards commissioner has been urged to investigate the All-Party Parliamentary Group (APPG) on Israel following reports linking its funding to an Israeli organisation that says it helps shape debate in the British parliament. The APPG is funded by Cedarsoak Ltd, a British company in which Lord Mendelsohn, the former chair of Labour Friends of Israel, and Lord Polak, the former director of the Conservative Friends of Israel, are the sole directors . But Byline Times reported earlier this month that the Tel Aviv-based firm Cedars Oak Israel Ltd owed the UK firm Cedarsoak £147,687 in reimbursements in 2024. Cedars Oak Israel describes itself as taking "an active part in shaping the narrative in the British Parliament" to "serve national objectives". Its 2024 report to the Israeli charity registrar said it worked to influence British opinion and policy on Hamas, antisemitism, sanctions, Iran and other issues. The firm's donor in 2024 was Line Trust Corporation Limited, a Gibraltar-based trust company owned by Hassans, the territory's biggest law firm. APPGs, which are informal groups of MPs and peers, are required to name any party that "ultimately funded" a benefit according to parliamentary rules. According to Byline Times, the APPG also retroactively registered a benefit-in-kind, valued at between £85,501 and £87,000, from Cedarsoak Ltd in early 2025. Independent MP Iqbal Mohamed has written to the parliamentary standards commissioner requesting "an immediate and comprehensive investigation into alleged systemic breaches of the Rules for All-Party Parliamentary Groups", concerning the APPG on Israel and its "financial arrangements with Cedarsoak Ltd". 'The public deserves complete transparency' Mohamed told Middle East Eye on Monday: "I have asked the standards commissioner to investigate what appear to be serious questions about transparency and compliance with APPG funding rules. "Regardless of the country or cause involved, foreign money and opaque funding arrangements should have no place in British politics." Mohamed added: "The public deserves complete transparency about who is funding activity connected to Parliament, and any credible allegations of wrongdoing must be independently investigated." UK: Charity regulator opens case into community centre for promoting illegal Israeli settlements Read More » In his letter , Mohamed said there were strong indications that "the true, ultimate sources of funding for this APPG are being systematically obscured" from the parliamentary register. He cited "past cooperation between Cedarsoak Ltd, the Israeli Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA), and the APPG". His letter also asserted: "By failing to look past Cedarsoak Ltd to declare the Line Trust Corporation or its underlying clients, the APPG seems to be in direct breach of parliamentary transparency requirements regarding ultimate beneficial funding." MEE has contacted the APPG on Israel for comment. In 2024 the APPG published a report on the Hamas-led attacks on 7 October 2023 which was lauded by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as “independent and brutally honest”. At its launch, Israeli ambassador Tzipi Hotovely told Lord Roberts, the historian and peer who chaired the report, it was a historic reference work that would help remind everyone why Israel is fighting in Gaza. "This report is such an important evidence to stop the historic distortion and all of this horrible fake news that is disturbing the truth," Hotovely said. items.author: Nwafor

items.content: Former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar has thanked the people of Potiskum and Yobe State for the warm reception accorded him and his campaign team during the African Democratic Congress (ADC) campaign rally in the state. Atiku also commended Yobe State Governor for providing what he described as a level playing field for the party to present its campaign message to the electorate. The former vice-president’s appreciation was contained in a statement issued on Monday by his Director of Strategic Communication, Phrank Shaibu, who personally signed and posted it on his X account. Atiku said the reception he received from the moment his entourage arrived in Potiskum from Azare, Bauchi State, was a testament to the people’s support for the ADC’s campaign promise of an affordable life. “The welcome from the moment we entered Potiskum from Azare was simply breathtaking. The sea of heads, the joyful faces, the chants and the warmth of the people will remain in my heart. “To the people of Potiskum and to the good people of Yobe State, I say thank you. You opened your doors and your hearts to us, and we are deeply grateful,” he said. He also thanked the state governor for allowing the ADC to campaign freely, saying democracy was strengthened when political parties were given the opportunity to engage voters and present their programmes. Atiku, however, used the statement to take a swipe at the Presidency over allegations of the use of artificial intelligence to portray large crowds at political events. “The Presidency may need artificial intelligence to conjure a crowd, but in Potiskum the people came out in flesh and blood, unfiltered, unedited and impossible to fabricate,” he said. He added that the ADC’s campaign did not need artificial crowds, insisting that the turnout and chants at its rallies reflected the people’s desire for political change. Atiku also referred to chants of “Tinubu Must Go” at ADC rallies, describing them as a call for change and a reminder of the responsibility that would accompany a popular mandate. He pledged that, if elected president in the January 16, 2027 election, he would take immediate steps to make life more affordable for Nigerians. “When President Tinubu leaves office on 29 May 2027, good governance and an affordable life must follow. I solemnly pledge to take immediate steps to make life affordable again when elected president,” he said. Atiku said the reception in Yobe had reinforced his campaign’s belief that messages addressing the people’s everyday struggles and aspirations would attract widespread support. “Yobe has reminded us that when a message speaks to people’s struggles and aspirations, they will come out in their numbers to be heard,” he added. The post Atiku thanks Yobe people for warm campaign reception appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: استثمارات ترامب في إنفيديا تقفز إلى 62 مليون دولار
items.author: النهار
items.preview: أظهرت مراجعة لبيانات الإفصاح المالي للرئيس الأميركي دونالد ترامب أن قيمة الأسهم التي امتلكها في شركة إنفيديا تراوحت بين 13 مليوندولار و62 مليوناً حتى نهاية آب-أغسطس الماضي، في ارتفاع كبير مقارنة بحصّته المعلنة في نهاية عام 2024، وفقاً لما أوردته صحيفة واشنطن بوست.وتأتي هذه المعلو
items.content: أظهرت مراجعة لبيانات الإفصاح المالي للرئيس الأميركي دونالد ترامب أن قيمة الأسهم التي امتلكها في شركة " إنفيديا " تراوحت بين 13 مليون دولار و62 مليوناً حتى نهاية آب/أغسطس الماضي، في ارتفاع كبير مقارنة بحصّته المعلنة في نهاية عام 2024، وفقاً لما أوردته صحيفة "واشنطن بوست". وتأتي هذه المعلومات في وقت تواجه فيه الشركة تدقيقاً متزايداً بشأن علاقاتها بإدارة ترامب، ولا سيما في ظل التقارب بين الرئيس الأميركي و جنسن هوانغ ، المؤسِّس المشارك للشركة ورئيسها التنفيذي السابق، والتطورات المرتبطة بسياسة واشنطن تجاه صادرات رقائق الذكاء الاصطناعي إلى الصين . وقال الرئيس الأمبركي إنه لا يمانع عودة جنسن هوانغ إلى منصب الرئيس التنفيذي لشركة إنفيديا، مضيفاً أن الرجل قد تعلم الدرس. وبحسب تقرير الصحيفة، الذي استند إلى مراجعة إقرارات ترمب المالية، فإن تداولاته خلال العام الجاري تشير إلى امتلاكه أسهماً في "إنفيديا" تراوح قيمتها بين 13 مليون دولار و62 مليوناً حتى نهاية آب/أغسطس. ولم تتمكن "رويترز" من التحقق بصورة مستقلة من صحة هذه التقديرات. ارتفاع كبير مقارنة بحصّته في 2024 تُظهر المقارنة بين الإفصاحات المالية أن قيمة حصة ترامب في أسهم "إنفيديا" ارتفعت بصورة ملحوظة، بعدما راوحت بين 615 ألف دولار و1.3 مليون دولار في نهاية عام 2024، وفقاً للأرقام التي أوردتها "واشنطن بوست". لكن الصحيفة لفتت إلى أن الإقرارات المتاحة لا تشمل الصفقات التي أُجريت خلال الشهرين الأخيرين، بسبب التأخر في الإبلاغ عنها، ما يعني أن البيانات لا تعكس بالضرورة حجم استثماراته الأحدث في الشركة. وفي المقابل، نقلت الصحيفة عن البيت الأبيض تأكيده أن ترامب لا يختار الأسهم الفردية ولا يتداول بها بنفسه، وأن مؤسسات مالية مستقلة تتولى إدارة محفظته الاستثمارية. وكانت الإدارة قد أشارت سابقاً إلى أن أصول الرئيس موضوعة في صندوق ائتماني تديره عائلته. استقالة جنسن هوانغ تزيد التدقيق في الشركة وتزامن الكشف عن استثمارات ترامب مع أزمة داخل "إنفيديا"، بعدما استقال مؤسسها المشارك جنسن هوانغ من منصبه رئيساً تنفيذياً في 12 تشرين الثاني/نوفمبر، وسط تقارير عن علاقات شخصية خارج إطار الزواج، من بينها علاقته بسيدة أعمال صينية تُدعى أليس هوانغ ، تشتبه السلطات الأميركية في ارتباطها بأجهزة استخبارات صينية. وأعلنت الشركة أن مجلس إدارتها عيّن المديرة المالية كوليت كريس رئيسة تنفيذية مؤقتة، فيما بدأ البحث عن رئيس تنفيذي دائم خلفاً لهوانغ. وكانت العلاقة بين ترمب وهوانغ قد حظيت باهتمام إعلامي في الفترة الماضية، في ظلّ التواصل بينهما والملفات المتعلقة بمستقبل صادرات الرقائق الأميركية إلى الصين.

items.title: أسهم التكنولوجيا تحت الضغط والذهب يتراجع… أسبوع لاختبار الثقة
items.author: النهار
items.preview: يواجه المستثمرون هذا الأسبوع اختبارين متزامنين: هل تستطيع شركات الذكاء الاصطناعي الحفاظ على الثقة بنموها؟ وهل تتجه تكلفة الاقتراض إلى مزيد من الارتفاع؟ وبين السؤالين، بدت الأسواق في تعاملات الاثنين 16 تشرين الثاني (نوفمبر) أقل استعداداً للمجازفة، خصوصاً في أسهم التكنولوجيا.التكنو
items.content: يواجه المستثمرون هذا الأسبوع اختبارين متزامنين: هل تستطيع شركات الذكاء الاصطناعي الحفاظ على الثقة بنموها؟ وهل تتجه تكلفة الاقتراض إلى مزيد من الارتفاع؟ وبين السؤالين، بدت الأسواق في تعاملات الاثنين 16 تشرين الثاني (نوفمبر) أقل استعداداً للمجازفة، خصوصاً في أسهم التكنولوجيا. التكنولوجيا تنتظر أرقاماً تطمئنها تراجعت العقود الآجلة للأسهم الأميركية قبل افتتاح وول ستريت، مع انخفاض عقود "ستاندرد أند بورز 500" بنحو 0.6% و"ناسداك" 1.4%، في مقابل تراجع محدود لعقود "داو جونز". وتتجه الأنظار إلى نتائج "إنفيديا" المقررة الثلاثاء، والطرح المرتقب لشركة "أنثروبيك"، المطورة للأداة المساعدة "كلود"، في اختبار لشهية المستثمرين تجاه الذكاء الاصطناعي بعد اضطرابات القطاع الأخيرة. لا تقتصر أهمية النتائج على إيرادات الفصل الماضي من العام. فالمستثمر يريد معرفة ما إذا كان الطلب سيواصل النمو، وكيف ستتحول الاستثمارات الضخمة في الحوسبة ومراكز البيانات إلى أرباح. ولذلك، قد تؤثر توقعات الشركات للأشهر المقبلة في الأسعار بقدر الأرقام المحققة، وربما أكثر. ويعني ذلك أن إعلان نتائج قوية قد لا يكفي لدعم السهم إذا ترافق مع توقعات أكثر تحفظاً، بينما يمكن لتوجيهات مطمئنة في شأن الطلب والأرباح أن تساعد في استعادة الثقة. الذهب يقلّص خسائره بعد هبوط حاد لامس الذهب الفوري مستوى 3,830 دولاراً للأونصة خلال الجلسة، وهو الأدنى منذ تشرين الأول (أكتوبر) 2025، قبل أن يقلّص خسائره إلى نحو 3,874.49 دولاراً، بانخفاض 0.1%. وبقي الدولار قريباً من أعلى مستوياته منذ نيسان (أبريل) 2025، فيما أشارت تسعيرات الأسواق إلى احتمال بنحو 91% لرفع معدلات الفائدة الأميركية ربع نقطة مئوية في كانون الأول (ديسمبر)، في مقابل احتمال أقل لزيادة أكبر. تفسّر هذه المعادلة لماذا لا يرتفع سعر الذهب تلقائياً مع القلق. تزيد معدلات الفائدة الأعلى جاذبية الأصول التي تمنح عائداً، بينما يرفع الدولار القوي تكلفة شراء المعدن لدى حائزي العملات الأخرى. وتبقى حركة الذهب مرتبطة بالتوازن بين هذه الضغوط والطلب عليه للتحوط. النفط بين تحسن الإمدادات ومخاطر الملاحة تراجعت عقود "برنت" إلى نحو 95.15 دولاراً للبرميل، وبلغ خام غرب تكساس الوسيط نحو 88.19 دولاراً. وضغطت توقعات تحسن الإمدادات وعودة فائض المعروض على الأسعار، مع بقاء مخاطر الملاحة في الشرق الأوسط حاضرة. وهكذا، تتحرك سوق النفط بين احتمال توافر كميات أكبر، والخشية من اضطرابات قد تعرقل وصولها. بالنسبة إلى الدول المستوردة، يوفر انخفاض أسعار النفط فرصة لتخفيف فاتورة الطاقة. لكن انتقال الأثر إلى المستهلك يعتمد أيضاً على أسعار الصرف والضرائب وتكاليف النقل، فلا تتحرك أسعار الوقود والسلع دائماً بالسرعة نفسها. أسبوع مزدحم بالاختبارات تتصدر الأجندة نتائج "إنفيديا" وبيانات مبيعات التجزئة الأميركية الثلاثاء، ثم محضر اجتماع مجلس الاحتياطي الفيدرالي الأربعاء. وستساعد هذه المحطات في توضيح قوة الاستهلاك واتجاه السياسة النقدية، بالتوازي مع اختبار الثقة في قطاع التكنولوجيا. ويبقى السؤال الذي يجمع حركة الأصول: هل تنمو الأرباح بما يكفي لتحمل تكلفة تمويل أعلى؟ وستساهم الإجابة في تحديد قدرة الأسهم على استعادة الزخم، وفرص الذهب في التعافي، ومدى استمرار قوة الدولار.

items.title: ASUP declares indefinite strike at Rivers polytechnic
items.author: Nwafor
items.preview: By Daniel Abia, P/Harcourt Academic activities at Kenule Beeson Saro-Wiwa Polytechnic, Bori, Rivers State, have been disrupted following the declaration of an indefinite strike by the Academic Staff Union of Polytechnics (ASUP), over the state government’s failure to implement ag
items.content: By Daniel Abia, P/Harcourt Academic activities at Kenule Beeson Saro-Wiwa Polytechnic, Bori, Rivers State, have been disrupted following the declaration of an indefinite strike by the Academic Staff Union of Polytechnics (ASUP), over the state government’s failure to implement agreed academic allowances. The ASUP Kenpoly Bori Chapter announced its participation in the industrial action on Monday, November 16, 2026, in compliance with a directive from the union’s national leadership ordering academic staff in affected state-owned polytechnics to withdraw their services. In a statement issued on Monday and signed by the chapter’s Chairman, Engr. Dr Bariakawaadoo Bere, the union said the strike was aimed at compelling the Rivers State Government to implement the Consolidated Academic Tools Allowance (CATA) and Earned Academic Allowance (EAA) for lecturers, instructors and technologists in the institution. ASUP recalled that the Federal Government and the union signed an agreement on April 8, 2026, providing for the implementation of CATA and EAA for academic staff in the polytechnic sector, effective January 2026. According to the union, the Federal Government approved the allowances as a template for academic staff across polytechnics nationwide, adding that the agreement had been fully implemented in federal government-owned institutions. It noted, however, that state governments were expected to extend the same benefits to academic staff in polytechnics and colleges of technology under their respective control. The union said its national leadership had made several efforts to secure the Rivers State Government’s compliance through two separate letters dated August 10 and September 21, 2026, addressed to the governor. In the letters, ASUP appealed to the governor to extend the approved allowances to academic staff of Kenule Beeson Saro-Wiwa Polytechnic and other affected state-owned institutions, arguing that their lecturers, instructors and technologists performed similar professional duties under comparable working conditions as their counterparts in federal institutions. The union, however, expressed disappointment over what it described as the low level of response from the state government. It also questioned what it considered unequal treatment of academic staff in the state’s tertiary institutions, noting that the same Rivers State Government had implemented the Federal Government-ASUU agreement for university lecturers in the state. ASUP argued that both categories of academic workers faced similar economic realities and should therefore receive comparable consideration. In a further attempt to resolve the disagreement, the union said its National Executive Council, at its 118th meeting held on October 22, 2026, directed the issuance of a 15-day ultimatum to the Rivers State Government. The ultimatum commenced on October 27 and expired on November 10, 2026. The union alleged that neither the state government nor any of its agencies contacted or invited its national or state leadership for discussions or negotiations throughout the period. Following the expiration of the ultimatum without a resolution, the national leadership of ASUP, on November 12, formally notified the Rivers State Governor of its decision to embark on industrial action beginning Monday, November 16. Consequently, the Kenpoly Bori chapter declared its full participation in the strike, insisting that the action was necessary to secure the implementation of the CATA and EAA provisions of the April 8 agreement. The development puts pressure on the Rivers State Government to address the demands of the polytechnic workers and engage the union to resolve the dispute. As of Monday, when the statement was issued, the union had commenced the industrial action, with no agreement announced to resolve the disagreement. The post ASUP declares indefinite strike at Rivers polytechnic appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.content: By Simon Jessop and Sarah McFarlane ANTALYA, Turkey, Nov 16 (Reuters) - Negotiators at COP31 talks in Turkey published a draft deal text on Monday to drive debate and try to narrow the gaps between countries over fossil fuels and climate financing ahead of an end-of-week deadline to forge a final agreement. The stakes are high after a year of global warming that has caused wildfires in Europe and a deadly glacier melt in Nepal, while political will for action is undermined by other crises, including wars and the rising cost of living.

items.title: أمر ملكي سعودي بتعيين رئيس الأركان قائداً للقوات المشتركة للتحالف خلفاً للسلمان
items.author: hamza alshahma
items.preview: أصدر الملك السعودي سلمان بن عبدالعزيز آل سعود أمراً ملكياً بتعيين رئيس هيئة الأركان العامة الفريق الأول الركن فياض بن حامد بن رقاد الرويلي قائداً للقوات المشتركة للتحالف، إضافة إلى مهامه الحالية، خلفاً للفريق الركن فهد بن حمد بن عبدالعزيز السلمان.
items.content: الرياض-سانا أصدر الملك السعودي سلمان بن عبدالعزيز آل سعود أمراً ملكياً بتعيين رئيس هيئة الأركان العامة الفريق الأول الركن فياض بن حامد بن رقاد الرويلي قائداً للقوات المشتركة للتحالف، إضافة إلى مهامه الحالية، خلفاً للفريق الركن فهد بن حمد بن عبدالعزيز السلمان. وذكرت وكالة الأنباء السعودية “واس” أن الأمر الملكي الصادر اليوم الإثنين نص على تعيين السلمان مستشاراً لوزير الدفاع للشؤون العسكرية. وكان السلمان تولى قيادة القوات المشتركة في الـ 29 من آب 2024، بموجب أمر ملكي قضى بترقيته إلى رتبة فريق ركن وتعيينه قائداً لها، خلفاً للفريق الأول الركن مطلق بن سالم الأزيمع، الذي أُحيل إلى التقاعد بموجب الأمر ذاته. أما الرويلي، فيشغل منصب رئيس هيئة الأركان العامة منذ شباط 2018، بعد أن كان قائداً للقوات الجوية الملكية السعودية، ونائباً لرئيس هيئة الأركان العامة. ويعد الرويلي من أبرز القيادات العسكرية السعودية، وتولى خلال مسيرته عدداً من المناصب القيادية في القوات المسلحة.

items.title: Plateau: People may forgive Tinubu, but won’t forget absence – Atiku
items.author: Nwafor
items.preview: Former Vice President Atiku Abubakar has criticised President Bola Tinubu over his recent appeal for forgiveness in Plateau State, saying the people may forgive him but will not forget his alleged failure to visit and stand with them during periods of killings and kidnappings. At
items.content: Former Vice President Atiku Abubakar has criticised President Bola Tinubu over his recent appeal for forgiveness in Plateau State, saying the people may forgive him but will not forget his alleged failure to visit and stand with them during periods of killings and kidnappings. Atiku, the presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), said no campaign visit or last-minute promise could erase what he described as the President’s absence when Plateau residents needed reassurance and protection. He spoke through a statement issued on Monday by his Director of Strategic Communication, ADC Presidential Campaign Council, Phrank Shaibu, who disclosed the position on his X platform. The statement was issued from Potiskum, Yobe State, where Atiku took his affordable-life campaign message on Sunday. According to the former Vice President, Plateau residents needed the President’s presence when their communities were under attack and families were grieving over the loss of loved ones. “The people of Plateau needed their President when they were grieving, when their communities were under attack and when families desperately needed reassurance. “President Tinubu promised to end the killings and protect them, but he failed to keep those promises. He did not visit to stand with them in their darkest hour,” Atiku said. He argued that Tinubu’s recent visit to the state to seek political support could not erase the concerns over his response to the security challenges confronting the people. “Now he has gone to Plateau to campaign and ask for forgiveness. The people may forgive him, but they will never forget the lives lost, the communities left in fear and the absence of their President when they needed him most,” he said. Atiku added that residents should not be treated as campaign instruments, insisting that their grief should not be used for political purposes. “President Tinubu cannot abandon Plateau in its hour of agony, then return when he needs its votes and expect a warm welcome. “The people are not props for his campaign, and their grief is not a slogan to be used when politically convenient. They may forgive him, but they will remember—and they will hold him accountable,” he added. The ADC presidential candidate also extended his criticism to the Tinubu administration’s handling of the economy, accusing the President of failing to address the cost-of-living crisis confronting Nigerians. He said the President had failed to meet the expectations of Nigerians who gave him the mandate in the 2023 general election. Atiku, however, presented the ADC’s Affordable Life campaign as an alternative, saying it was designed to address the country’s economic challenges and restore relief, dignity and hope to households. “Nigerians deserve leadership that stands with them in their moments of greatest hardship,” he said. The post Plateau: People may forgive Tinubu, but won’t forget absence – Atiku appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Obi demands arrest of attackers of Kwankwaso’s convoy in Kano
items.author: Nwafor
items.preview: Former Anambra State Governor and the presidential candidate of Nigeria Democratic Congress, NDC, Peter Obi, has called for an immediate investigation and arrest of those responsible for the attack on the convoy of former Kano State Governor, Senator Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, in Bich
items.content: Former Anambra State Governor and the presidential candidate of Nigeria Democratic Congress, NDC, Peter Obi, has called for an immediate investigation and arrest of those responsible for the attack on the convoy of former Kano State Governor, Senator Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, in Bichi Local Government Area of Kano State. Obi, who disclosed this in a statement posted on his X platform on Monday, said several members of Kwankwaso’s entourage sustained injuries, while about seven vehicles were vandalised during the incident. He condemned the attack, describing it as unacceptable and warning against the growing resort to violence during political activities. “I am deeply saddened by reports of the attack on the convoy of my brother and running mate, Senator Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, and members of his entourage in Bichi Local Government Area of Kano State. “I strongly condemn this unfortunate incident. Reports indicate that several members of the entourage sustained injuries, while about seven vehicles were vandalised. This is unacceptable and must not be allowed to become part of our political culture,” he said. Obi said political differences should not be used as justification for violence, intimidation or destruction of property, stressing that every Nigerian had the constitutional right to participate in the democratic process without fear of attack. “Democracy is not warfare. Political differences should never be a reason to resort to violence, intimidation or the destruction of property,” he stated. He urged Nigerians to embrace dialogue and respect divergent political opinions, warning that violence could undermine democratic participation. The former governor specifically called on the Nigeria Police Force and other security agencies to investigate the incident, identify those involved and prosecute anyone found culpable, including alleged sponsors of the attack. “I therefore call on the Nigeria Police Force and all relevant security agencies to immediately investigate this incident, identify those responsible, including anyone found to have sponsored the attack, and ensure that they are brought to justice. “No individual should be above the law, regardless of political position or influence,” he said. Obi also expressed solidarity with Kwankwaso, the Kano State leadership of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) and others affected by the incident, while wishing those injured a speedy recovery. He reaffirmed his commitment to peaceful political engagement, saying the quest for political change should be pursued through dialogue, persuasion, ideas and the ballot rather than violence. “Our commitment to building a new Nigeria remains unwavering. We believe that change must come through peaceful engagement, persuasion, ideas and the ballot, not violence,” he added. The post Obi demands arrest of attackers of Kwankwaso’s convoy in Kano appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Saudi-backed forces retreat from Bab al-Mandab as Houthis gain ground
items.author: MEE staff
items.preview: Saudi-backed forces retreat from Bab al-Mandab as Houthis gain ground Submitted by MEE staff on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 12:09 The Southern Armed Forces say the move is intended to reinforce Aden, while the Houthis claim they drove troops from positions overlooking the strategic waterwa
items.content: Saudi-backed forces retreat from Bab al-Mandab as Houthis gain ground Submitted by MEE staff on Mon, 11/16/2026 - 12:09 The Southern Armed Forces say the move is intended to reinforce Aden, while the Houthis claim they drove troops from positions overlooking the strategic waterway Supporters of Yemen’s Houthi authorities gather during a protest against Saudi intervention in Sanaa, 9 October 2026 (Mohammed Huwais/AFP) Off Saudi-backed forces in Yemen have withdrawn from positions overlooking the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait, leaving the Houthis with greater leverage over the southern entrance to the Red Sea after weeks of fighting. The Southern Armed Forces, who are backed by Saudi Arabia and fighting alongside the internationally recognised Yemeni government, said on Sunday they had "redeployed" troops from Dhubab airport and surrounding regions of Bab al-Mandab to strengthen defences around the interim capital Aden. “This step is taken based on the priority of securing the capital, Aden, and the neighbouring governorates, as well as strengthening the front lines and addressing existing threats,” the group said in a statement. The Houthis, officially known as Ansar Allah, offered a different account. A military source quoted by the Houthi-run Saba news agency said that they had forced Saudi-backed forces out of positions around Dhubab and Bab al-Mandab after severing their rear supply routes, forcing them to move towards Aden. The Houthi-run outlet also reported that the group's forces had carried out a flanking operation across more than 60km of the mountainous regions of Taiz and Lahij, forcing enemy troops to retreat from positions around Dhubab airport, the outskirts of Kahbub and areas around Bab al-Mandab. The latest developments give the Houthis more leverage over how Bab al-Mandab, one of the most critical points of waterway traffic in the world, is controlled. The strait sits on the maritime route between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, leading into the Suez Canal. Saudi-linked media reported that the withdrawal was a tactical decision to help defend Aden, strengthen lines in Lahij and provide the opportunity to relieve the siege on Taiz. Yemen, Bab al-Mandab and Saudi Arabia: Tehran’s strategic calculus in the balance Read More » A source in Yemen's presidency told Asharq Al-Awsat that troops had been moved to positions offering greater strategic advantages and that the withdrawal did not mean abandoning the coastal front. The government-aligned forces described the move as a redeployment rather than a loss, saying it would allow them to reinforce Aden and neighbouring areas while continuing operations to break the Houthi siege of Taiz. Yemen's government military spokesman, Colonel Majed al-Nuzaili, called on the international community to help restore government control over the strait. “The international community must assume its responsibilities by contributing to the liberation operation, given the strait’s vital importance to maritime security and international trade,” he said. The withdrawal marks a setback for the government and its Saudi ally, whose forces had launched a counteroffensive to retake territory seized by the Houthis along Yemen's Red Sea coast. Heavy fighting On Sunday, the Saudi Press Agency reported that the coalition had intercepted and destroyed two drones launched by the Houthis towards the Mecca region, a separate development from the fighting around Bab al-Mandab. The withdrawal follows a Houthi offensive that began in September, when the group seized territory along Yemen's western coast, including positions near the strategically located port city of Mokha. Houthi strikes mark the end of Saudi Arabia's Yemen 'containment strategy' Read More » Government forces launched a counteroffensive in October, backed by Saudi air power, and initially recaptured positions around Dhubab and the strait. But they failed to dislodge the Houthis from Mokha and other coastal areas. The Houthis have also advanced in highland areas north of Aden, raising the prospect of further fighting near the government's main base in the south. The redeployment comes as the Houthis maintain pressure on Taiz, Yemen's third-largest city, which has been surrounded by the group for more than a month. Aid supplies have been blocked from entering and civilians have faced restrictions on leaving, according to reports by Al Jazeera and Reuters. The United Nations refugee agency has warned that fighting has reached the Kharaz refugee camp in Lahij governorate, putting about 9,600 people at greater risk and further restricting humanitarian access. Nearly 330,000 people have been displaced in Yemen since the fighting escalated in August, according to an update by the UN refugee agency cited in the reporting. items.preview: من أغانٍ تحمل ذاكرة الأجيال إلى ألحان تعيد إحياء الموروث العربي بأسلوب معاصر، يقدّم كورال شرقيات تجربة موسيقية تجمع بين الأصالة والتجديد، مستنداً إلى تنوّع أعضائه واختلاف خلفياتهم، ليصنع لنفسه هوية فنية تتجاوز الغناء إلى الصورة والمحتوى الرقمي.وفي حديثه لـالنهار، كشف مؤسس الكورال
items.content: من أغانٍ تحمل ذاكرة الأجيال إلى ألحان تعيد إحياء الموروث العربي بأسلوب معاصر، يقدّم كورال شرقيات تجربة موسيقية تجمع بين الأصالة والتجديد، مستنداً إلى تنوّع أعضائه واختلاف خلفياتهم، ليصنع لنفسه هوية فنية تتجاوز الغناء إلى الصورة والمحتوى الرقمي. وفي حديثه لـ"النهار"، كشف مؤسس الكورال أحمد عفيفي، والمنسقة العامة، ومسؤول السوشال ميديا فواز عز الدين، عن جوانب من تجربة شرقيات، منذ تأسيسه وصولاً إلى حضوره عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، ورؤيتهم لإحياء التراث الغنائي العربي والوصول به إلى أجيال وجماهير جديدة. من فكرة إلى كورال يجمع الثقافات يوضح مؤسس كورال شرقيات أحمد عفيفي أن الكورال تأسس في أواخر عام 2022، بالشراكة مع شقيقه محمود، فيما بدأ حضوره عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي عام 2024. ويشير عفيفي إلى أن الهدف الأساسي من تأسيس الكورال كان إحياء الموروث العربي وتقديمه بصورة جميلة وقريبة من الجيل الجديد، لافتاً إلى أن ما يميز شرقيات هو تعدد جنسيات أعضائه واختلاف اختصاصاتهم، وهو تنوّع يرى أنه ما كان ليتحقق بهذه الصورة لولا وجودهم في دولة الإمارات التي تجمع ثقافات وخلفيات متعددة. وبين اختلاف التجارب والثقافات، يجتمع أعضاء الكورال على لغة الموسيقى، في محاولة لتقديم التراث العربي بصورة تحافظ على روحه وتفتح له أبواباً جديدة للوصول إلى الجمهور. هوية بصرية لافتة ترافق الموسيقى لا تقتصر هوية شرقيات على تنوّع الأصوات والأغاني، بل تمتد إلى الصورة البصرية التي ترافق ظهوره، من تنسيق الملابس والألوان إلى اختيار الأنماط التي تمنح كل عرض طابعاً خاصاً. وتوضح المنسقة العامة للكورال أن تنسيق الألوان والستايلات أصبح جزءاً لا يتجزأ من صورة شرقيات، إذ يشكّل الانسجام بين الملابس والألوان والموسيقى عنصراً أساسياً في هوية الفريق. وتلفت إلى أن الكورال لا يربط بالضرورة نوعية الأغاني بستايل محدد، إلا أن بعض التجارب تفرض توجهاً بصرياً وموسيقياً مختلفاً، كما حدث في تجربة ستايل الكاوبوي، التي رافقتها اختيارات غنائية ذات طابع غربي. وبحسب المنسقة العامة، يحرص الفريق على أن يحمل كل ظهور له بصمة مختلفة، بحيث تتكامل الصورة مع الموسيقى وتمنح الجمهور تجربة فنية متجددة. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Annahar Al Arabi (@annaharar) السوشال ميديا.. من إحياء التراث إلى صناعة المحتوى من جهته، يوضح مسؤول السوشال ميديا في كورال شرقيات فواز عز الدين أن رحلة الفريق على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي بدأت عام 2024، مع التركيز على إيصال التراث الغنائي العربي إلى الجيل الجديد، وتعريف الجمهور في مختلف البلدان بتراث بعضهم بعضاً. ويشير عز الدين إلى أن تجربة الكورال تطورت مع الوقت، فلم يعد المحتوى مقتصراً على الغناء أمام الكاميرا، بل بات يشمل مواكبة الترندات بأسلوب خاص، إلى جانب تقديم أفكار مبتكرة واسكتشات تحمل أحياناً رسائل تتجاوز الأداء الموسيقي. ويؤكد أن الهدف هو تقديم محتوى له فكرته وهويته، لا مجرد إعادة أداء الأغاني، بما يتيح للجمهور التفاعل معها واكتشافها من زاوية مختلفة. ويضيف أن ردود فعل الجمهور، وما يعبّر عنه المتابعون من سعادتهم بإعادة إحياء أغانٍ يحبونها وتحمل ذكرياتهم، يشكّل دافعاً للاستمرار والتوسع، مشيراً إلى أن طموح شرقيات يتمثل في الوصول إلى مختلف أنحاء الوطن العربي، ثم إلى جمهور أوسع حول العالم. التراث العربي بصوت جديد يرسم كورال شرقيات ملامح تجربة فنية تسعى إلى إبقاء الأغنية العربية حاضرة في ذاكرة الأجيال. فالموسيقى هنا ليست مجرد أداء جماعي، بل وسيلة لاستعادة أغانٍ ارتبطت بوجدان الناس، والتعريف بها لدى جمهور جديد، ضمن تجربة تجمع اختلاف الثقافات حول موروث مشترك. وبين أصالة اللحن وحداثة التقديم، يواصل شرقيات العمل على توسيع حضوره، واضعاً نصب عينيه أن يصل التراث العربي إلى جمهور أكبر، وأن تبقى الأغنية التي صنعت ذاكرة الأجيال قادرة على ملامسة قلوب أجيال جديدة.

items.title: مذكرة تفاهم بين المجلس الأعلى للتعليم التقاني ومؤسسة بنفسج لتعزيز قدرات الطلبة ‏
items.author: Bouthina Hassan
items.preview: ‏وقّع المجلس الأعلى للتعليم التقاني في وزارة التعليم العالي والبحث العلمي ومؤسسة بنفسج ‏للإغاثة والتنمية، مذكرة تفاهم للتعاون العلمي والأكاديمي والتقاني بهدف تطوير منظومة ‏التعليم التقاني وربط مخرجاتها باحتياجات التنمية وسوق العمل، وتعزيز قدرات الطلبة ‏والكوادر التدريسية والإداري
items.content: دمشق-سانا‏ ‏وقّع المجلس الأعلى للتعليم التقاني في وزارة التعليم العالي والبحث العلمي ومؤسسة بنفسج ‏للإغاثة والتنمية، مذكرة تفاهم للتعاون العلمي والأكاديمي والتقاني بهدف تطوير منظومة ‏التعليم التقاني وربط مخرجاتها باحتياجات التنمية وسوق العمل، وتعزيز قدرات الطلبة ‏والكوادر التدريسية والإدارية.‏ ‏ووقع المذكرة عن المجلس معاون وزير التعليم العالي والبحث العلمي لشؤون الطلاب عبد ‏الحميد الخالد وعن المؤسسة رئيسها التنفيذي علاء البكور، وذلك بحضور وزير التعليم ‏العالي والبحث ‏العلمي مروان الحلبي، أمس الأحد في مبنى الوزارة بدمشق.‏ وبموجب المذكرة يتعاون الطرفان في تمكين طلبة المعاهد التقانية عبر تصميم وتنفيذ ‏برامج تدريبية وورش عمل وأنشطة تستهدف تنمية المهارات الشخصية ومهارات التواصل ‏والعرض والإلقاء، والتخطيط للمسار المهني، وريادة الأعمال، والمهارات الرقمية، والتحول ‏الرقمي، والذكاء الاصطناعي، والعمل الجماعي، والمبادرات المجتمعية، ويستهدف هذا ‏المسار تدريب 500 طالب وطالبة من مختلف المعاهد التقنية.‏ كما تتضمن المذكرة بناء قدرات الكوادر التدريسية والإدارية من خلال تقييم الاحتياجات ‏التدريبية، وإعداد وتنفيذ برامج بناء القدرات، وتنفيذ برامج إعداد المدربين (‏TOT‏)، ‏وتطوير المهارات القيادية والإدارية، ودمج أدوات التكنولوجيا والذكاء الاصطناعي في ‏التعليم والتدريب، وتبادل الخبرات وأفضل الممارسات، وتستهدف تدريب 200 مدرس ‏وموظف إداري في المعاهد التقنية.‏ ‏وحسب المذكرة يتعاون الطرفان في مجال التطوير المؤسسي والربط بسوق العمل عبر ‏إعداد وتطوير دليل إجراءات تشغيلي (‏SOP‏) خاص بدمج الطلبة والخريجين في سوق ‏العمل، وتنظيم فعاليات ومنتديات ومؤتمرات تجمع المؤسسات التعليمية مع أصحاب ‏العمل، ودعم المبادرات التي تعزِّز فرص التدريب والتشغيل، وتشجيع الشراكات مع القطاع ‏الخاص والجهات الداعمة.‏ وتُعد منظمة بنفسج للإغاثة والتنمية منظمة إنسانية غير ربحية، بدأت نشاطها التطوعي ‏أواخر عام 2011، وأُسست بصفتها منظمة رسمية في نهاية عام 2013، وتعمل على ‏دعم المجتمعات المتضررة وتعزيز صمودها من خلال برامج ومشاريع تشمل قطاعات ‏الصحة والتعليم والأمن الغذائي وسبل العيش والمأوى والحماية والمياه، إضافة إلى بناء ‏قدرات الشباب وتمكين النساء.‏

items.content: Israeli authorities have issued demolition orders for two residential buildings and a villa in Hebron, claiming they are too close to a settler road, which Hebron’s mayor argues violates permissions granted by the Palestinian Authority. The demolition will affect dozens of families and is described by local officials as collective punishment. In response, the Hebron Municipality is pursuing legal action and seeking intervention from human rights organizations amid escalating tensions following a recent attack on Israeli soldiers.

items.title: Mysterious New B94 Nuclear Bomb Designation Emerges, First In Decades
items.author: Joseph Trevithick
items.preview: Could the B94 be the Nuclear Deterrent System-Air-delivered bunker buster, the only new nuclear bomb known to be in development? The post Mysterious New B94 Nuclear Bomb Designation Emerges, First In Decades appeared first on TWZ .
items.content: The Senate Appropriations Committee has revealed the first entirely new designation for an air-dropped nuclear gravity bomb in decades. What the B94 bomb is remains to be confirmed. The only weapon fitting this general description known to be in development now is the bunker-busting Nuclear Deterrent System-Air-delivered (NDS-A). The B94 designation appears in an explanatory statement that the Senate Appropriations Committee released last week. The document accompanied a draft bill covering proposed funding for the Department of Energy and certain other arms of the federal government in Fiscal Year 2027. Jeffery Lewis, currently the William J. Perry Lecturer at Stanford University’s Center for International Security and Cooperation (CISAC) and Distinguished Fellow at the Foreign Policy Research Institute (FPRI) think tank, was among the first to call attention to the designation in a post on X . He, in turn, credited Eliana Johns, a PhD student at the University of Maryland and a Research Advisor at the Federation of American Scientists (FAS) think tank, for having spotted it first. The section of the explanatory statement released by the Senate Appropriations Committee that mentions the B94 designation. Senate Appropriations Committee The draft spending bill released by the Senate Appropriations Committee adds $77.108 million for the B94, but offers no further details. At the time of writing, this appears to be the only public reference to this designation. TWZ has reached out to the National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), the entity within the Department of Energy responsible for nuclear weapons-related activities, and the Senate Appropriations Committee for more information. The U.S. government currently designates nuclear weapons in a common alphanumeric sequence. Air-dropped gravity bombs, including air-dropped depth charges (also called depth bombs) for use against submarines, are given designations with B prefixes. Warheads designed for use in ballistic and cruise missiles, including air-launched types, start with W prefixes. There are other prefixes in this designation system , but they are rarely, if ever, used. B94 would follow directly from the last known new U.S. nuclear weapon designation, W93, which is a new warhead in development for use on Trident II submarine-launched ballistic missiles . Before the B94, the last new nuclear ‘bomb’ known to have received a designation was the B90 . Also known as the Nuclear Depth/Strike Bomb (NDSB), this weapon was designed to be used as a depth bomb against submarines or against targets on land. It was developed as a replacement for the older B57 , which was similarly configurable for strikes on land or anti-submarine attacks. The B90 program was canceled in September 1991 as part of broader U.S. nuclear arms reductions amid the collapse of the Soviet Union. An inert B90 Nuclear Depth/Strike Bomb on display. US Military A B57 nuclear bomb, which the B90 was developed to replace. NNSA As mentioned, what specific weapon the B94 designation applies to remains unconfirmed. However, it seems likely that NDS-A, work on which traces back to at least 2022, is the bomb in question. “The Nuclear Deterrent System-Air-delivered will provide the President with additional nuclear options to defeat Hard and Deeply Buried Targets, ensuring that adversaries cannot place their most valued assets beyond the reach of America’s nuclear forces,” an NNSA spokesperson subsequently told TWZ earlier this year. “The program is moving aggressively, and further information will become publicly available when it is strategically beneficial to the United States.” We had reached out for more information about NDS-A after new details about the weapon and progress in its development were included in the Department of Energy 2027 Fiscal Year budget request. The U.S. military currently has one nuclear bomb specifically designed to address very deeply buried targets, the B61-11 . The maximum yield of that bomb is reported to be somewhere between 340 and 400 kilotons, depending on the source. There are also said to be fewer than 100 of them in the stockpile. A B-2 bomber drops an inert B61-11 bomb during a test. USAF There is also the B83-1 , which has a megaton-class maximum yield, making it far more powerful than any variant of the B61. Despite lacking the deep-penetrating features of the B61-11, the B83-1’s higher yield means it can also be used against deeply buried and other hardened facilities, as well as large-area targets. An inert B83-series nuclear bomb. US Military The U.S. military had previously pursued a new version of the B83 configured in a similar fashion to the B61-11, as well as a more direct successor to the latter bomb. The last of those efforts, by then dubbed the Robust Nuclear Earth Penetrator (RNEP), was publicly cancelled in 2005. A low-quality and now thoroughly dated briefing slide discussing the RNEP effort. USAF The U.S. military has already begun fielding a new, higher-yield -13 version of the B61 , but it does not have the same kind of deep-penetrating capabilities as the -11 variant. The B61-13 is directly based on the preceding B61-12 , which was the first bomb in that family to include a precision guidance package. Variants of the B61 have been in service longer than any other series of nuclear gravity bombs in the current U.S. stockpile. The first B61-13 production unit. NNSA NDS-A could now be intended to replace the B61-11 or the B83-1, or both bombs, but the exact plan has yet to be confirmed. We have yet to see the design even in the form of a rendering or model. The extent to which the new weapon may leverage work on previous projects like RNEP is unknown. NDS-A might also incorporate elements of other existing designs, such as the B83’s megaton class yield and/or the precision-guidance capabilities of the B61-12/13. As we have previously written: “What may be prompting the requirement for the NDS-A now is unknown. There are deeply-buried targets only a nuclear weapon can realistically destroy. The development of the B61-11 is understood to have been prompted heavily by one such facility in particular, Russia’s Kosvinsky Kamen bunker. Kosvinsky Kamen is a key node in the Russian nuclear command and control enterprise and was built under a mountain of the same name in the northern Urals. The nature of its location and design also means it could serve as a so-called ‘ continuity of government ’ site for senior leadership to operate from before or after a nuclear strike or in response to some other major emergency.” “However, the landscape of deeply-buried, hardened facilities that U.S. authorities would be interested in holding at risk has grown substantially in the past two decades since work, at least publicly, on RNEP came to an end.” “The Russian and Chinese governments have been expanding on their already significant arrays of subterranean facilities . In China, this includes the construction of vast fields of new intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) silos , as well as work on a new underground command center outside of the capital , Beijing, just in recent years.” A graphic detailing a previous US military assessment about the state of new ICBM silo fields in northern China. US military “Other, smaller countries, like North Korea and Iran , have been investing in new underground and other hardened facilities, as well. This has been driven in many cases by concerns about the prospect of conventional strikes carried out by the U.S. military and others .” The matter of nuclear bunker busting has just come up relatively recently in the context of Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain site , which presents immense conventional targeting challenges . At the same time, as TWZ has explored in detail , the prospect of a nuclear strike on that facility is exceedingly low for a host of reasons. There is a possibility that the B94 designation could apply to another entirely new nuclear gravity bomb beyond the NDS-A that is now in development, but has not been previously disclosed. However, this seems far less likely to be the case. All of this does come amid a larger ongoing push to modernize America’s entire nuclear triad. This includes the aforementioned W93 warhead. New air- and sea-launched nuclear-armed cruise missiles , as well as the LGM-35A Sentinel silo-based intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM), are in development. The B-21 Raider bomber and the Columbia class nuclear ballistic missile submarine programs, as well as extensive new command and control capabilities , are also part of these broader efforts. We now know that there is also the B94, the first nuclear bomb to receive a completely new designation since the very end of the Cold War. items.content: درعا-سانا بحثت غرفة تجارة وصناعة درعا اليوم الإثنين، مع مدير غرفة صناعة إربد نضال ‏الصدر، سبل تأسيس مركز للتدريب المهني في درعا، بدعم وتمويل من غرفة كولن ‏الحرفية الألمانية، بهدف تأهيل الكوادر الشابة وتطوير مهاراتها المهنية، وتعزيز قدرات ‏العاملين في القطاعين الصناعي والحرفي، بما يلبي احتياجات سوق العمل ويوفر فرصاً ‏جديدة للشباب.‏ وأوضح رئيس غرفة تجارة وصناعة درعا نشأت الرفاعي في تصريح لمراسل سانا، أن ‏زيارة الوفد الأردني تهدف إلى الاطلاع على المساحة التي خصصتها الغرفة في الطابق ‏الأخير من مبناها لإقامة المركز، والتي خضعت لتأهيل أولي لتكون مقراً لتدريب الشباب، ‏ولا سيما الخريجين الجدد والمنتسبين إلى الجمعيات، والراغبين في تطوير مهاراتهم ‏واكتساب الخبرات اللازمة لدخول سوق العمل.‏ وأوضح الرفاعي أن المركز يحتاج إلى توفير أجهزة الكمبيوتر والمقاعد وشاشات العرض ‏وغيرها من المستلزمات التقنية واللوجستية، مبيناً أن غرفة كولن الحرفية أبدت استعداداً ‏إيجابياً للتعاون خلال اجتماعين سابقين عُقدا عبر تقنية الاتصال المرئي.‏ تعاون سوري أردني لتطوير القدرات من جهته، قال مدير عام غرفة صناعة إربد نضال الصدر: إن التعاون يأتي في إطار ‏مذكرة التفاهم التي وقعتها غرفة صناعة إربد مع غرفة تجارة وصناعة درعا مطلع العام ‏الحالي، بهدف تعزيز التعاون المشترك وتبادل الخبرات وتطوير الخدمات المقدمة للقطاع ‏الصناعي، إضافة إلى تنفيذ برامج تدريبية وتقديم دعم فني ولوجستي للغرفة في درعا.‏ وتُعد غرفة كولن الحرفية الألمانية من المؤسسات المعنية بتنظيم ودعم قطاع الحرف ‏والمهن وتطوير منظومة التدريب والتأهيل المهني، وتعزيز مهارات العاملين وربط التدريب ‏بمتطلبات سوق العمل. ‏

items.title: Tinubu’s proximity won’t make me dictate Katsina politics – Masari
items.author: Nwafor
items.preview: By Ibrahim Hassan-Wuyo The Special Adviser to President Bola Tinubu on Political Affairs, Alhaji Ibrahim Kabir Masari, has dismissed suggestions that he is using his closeness to the President to influence or dictate the political direction of Katsina State. Masari, who spoke in
items.content: By Ibrahim Hassan-Wuyo The Special Adviser to President Bola Tinubu on Political Affairs, Alhaji Ibrahim Kabir Masari, has dismissed suggestions that he is using his closeness to the President to influence or dictate the political direction of Katsina State. Masari, who spoke in an interview with the BBC Hausa Service, also said he had no regrets supporting Dr Dikko Radda’s emergence as governor of Katsina State, despite reported political differences between them. His comments come amid speculations that the strained relationship between him and Radda could affect the All Progressives Congress (APC) in the state ahead of the 2027 general elections. The presidential aide said President Tinubu and Almighty Allah were witnesses to his contributions towards Radda’s emergence, lamenting what he described as unfair allegations against him. Asked to assess Radda’s performance in office over the past three years, Masari said even those opposed to the governor would acknowledge that he had made efforts to develop the state. “I have no regrets helping Dikko Radda to become the Governor of Katsina State,” he declared. Explaining the origin of the disagreement, Masari alleged that the crisis began when some youths associated with the governor started displaying campaign materials bearing Radda’s photograph without that of President Tinubu. He said he, alongside a minister and another prominent Katsina politician, Malam Jabiru Tsauri, had mobilised resources to promote the President and other political leaders in the state. According to him, they sponsored billboards, posters and banners across Katsina featuring photographs of Tinubu, Vice President Kashim Shettima, Governor Radda, former governors Aminu Masari and Ibrahim Shehu Shema, among other prominent political figures. Masari alleged that some of the billboards were subsequently destroyed at night by individuals he claimed were working with the governor’s aides. He further claimed that some suspects were arrested by the police in connection with the incident, adding that the development contributed to the misunderstanding between the two camps. “I don’t have any issue with the governor; perhaps he has one with me. But what I will disagree with is a situation where the President cannot be advertised in Katsina State,” he said. Masari also alleged that some individuals around the governor were uncomfortable with him and were responsible for creating tension between the two political camps. He maintained that Radda should not feel threatened by the political activities of Katsina indigenes residing in Abuja, insisting that he and other prominent politicians from the state had no personal or political problem with the governor. He urged APC stakeholders to ensure that the perceived divisions did not undermine the party’s unity and electoral fortunes in Katsina State ahead of the 2027 general elections. The post Tinubu’s proximity won’t make me dictate Katsina politics – Masari appeared first on Vanguard News .
