items.title: Franse politie verbiedt demonstraties bij middelbare scholen en universiteiten in Parijs
items.author: NOS Nieuws
items.preview: In Parijs mag deze week niet worden gedemonstreerd in de buurt van een aantal middelbare scholen en universiteiten. Dat heeft de politiechef van de Franse hoofdstad aangekondigd. Het verbod op demonstraties en bijeenkomsten geldt binnen een straal van 100 meter van de onderwijsin
items.content: In Parijs mag deze week niet worden gedemonstreerd in de buurt van een aantal middelbare scholen en universiteiten. Dat heeft de politiechef van de Franse hoofdstad aangekondigd. Het verbod op demonstraties en bijeenkomsten geldt binnen een straal van 100 meter van de onderwijsinstellingen. De maatregel wordt vaker ingesteld en is bedoeld om de blokkades van scholen en universiteiten, en het daarmee gepaard gaande geweld, onder controle te krijgen. De politiechef van Parijs zegt dat het verbod noodzakelijk is vanwege de "talrijke verstoringen en blokkades rond bepaalde middelbare scholen en instellingen voor hoger onderwijs" en "aanhoudend geweld". Volgens hem hebben die incidenten geleid tot schade aan de openbare ruimte, brandstichting en confrontaties met de politie. Klacht ingediend Het demonstratieverbod geldt tot en met vrijdag rond vijf grote universiteitscampussen, waaronder faculteiten van de Sorbonne-universiteit. Ook geldt het verbod voor tien van de ruim 150 middelbare scholen in Parijs. De landelijke studentenvakbond UNEF heeft een klacht ingediend bij de bestuursrechter. De vakbond noemt de maatregel een inbreuk op de bewegingsvrijheid. Ook vindt UNEF dat ze laat op de hoogte zijn gesteld van het verbod. De rechtbank behandelt de zaak vanmiddag. Geen toegang tot school De maatregel komt een dag voordat in heel Frankrijk nieuwe stakingen en demonstraties gepland staan. Naast de vakbondsacties van ambtenaren, onderwijspersoneel en vervoersmedewerkers worden ook demonstraties van scholieren, studenten en gele hesjes verwacht. Eerder hadden acht burgemeesters van verschillende arrondissementen in Parijs contact opgenomen met de lokale onderwijsautoriteiten. Zij hadden opgeroepen de in- en uitgangen van geblokkeerde scholen beter te beveiligen. Door de blokkades konden scholieren en studenten geen toegang krijgen tot hun onderwijsinstelling, waardoor lessen dagenlang werden geschrapt. Volgens de politiechef worden de blokkades "meestal uitgevoerd door een minderheid van studenten", maar belemmeren ze de bewegingsvrijheid en het recht op onderwijs van anderen. Ook wijst hij erop dat ouders van studenten woedend zijn over de blokkades. Vuurwerkmortieren Uit een brief aan onderwijsbestuurders en prefecten, waar Franse media over berichten, blijkt dat de regering harder wil optreden tegen leerlingen, studenten en medewerkers die deelnemen aan blokkades van onderwijsinstellingen. Wat die sancties inhouden, is niet meteen duidelijk. Gisteren heeft Frankrijk ook een verbod ingesteld op de verkoop en het gebruik van vuurwerkmortieren, een vorm van zwaar vuurwerk. Sommige demonstranten gebruiken dit tegen de politie en in de buurt van scholen. Vuurwerkmortieren "worden niet langer gebruikt om te vieren, ze worden gebruikt om schade mee te berokkenen", zou volgens de krant Le Parisien in het decreet staan. Volgens het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken is het verbod ingesteld om ernstige verstoringen van de openbare orde te voorkomen tijdens demonstraties en blokkades bij middelbare scholen en universiteiten. Het verbod blijft van kracht tot 27 november. Frankrijk heeft sinds medio september te maken met grootschalige protesten. De onrust begon bij scholieren die betere schoolgebouwen, voorzieningen en meer leraren eisten. Later sloten ook studenten en leraren zich aan. In brand gestoken De demonstraties zijn daarna uitgegroeid tot een bredere volksbeweging tegen de stijgende kosten van levensonderhoud, waarbij ook vakbonden en politici zich aansloten. Sommige protesten liepen uit op rellen, waarbij onder meer middelbare scholen in brand werden gestoken. De Franse regering is met maatregelen gekomen om het onderwijs te verbeteren: zo wordt 5 miljard euro geïnvesteerd en gaat het Franse toelatingssysteem Parcoursup tot het hoger onderwijs op de schop. Ook werd aangekondigd dat het minimumloon met 1,6 procent omhoog zou gaan. Maar vakbonden waren niet onder de indruk van de verhoging en spraken van "kruimels" en "aalmoezen". Afgelopen zaterdag gingen in Frankrijk opnieuw veel mensen de straat op. Volgens het ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken deden 106.000 mensen mee aan demonstraties, onder wie 24.000 in Parijs. Daarbij werden 219 mensen gearresteerd. Dat zijn aanzienlijk minder demonstranten dan een week eerder. Toen namen volgens de Franse autoriteiten 1,6 miljoen mensen deel aan de protesten door het hele land.

items.title: Patriots' season on the brink as Drake Maye's injury could keep him out for rest of year
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Drake Maye could miss the rest of the season after a lower-leg injury on an Aidan Hutchinson sack during the New England Patriots' loss in Munich.
items.content: The New England Patriots were in the Super Bowl merely nine months ago. On Monday morning, they find themselves on the brink of complete disaster. Drake Maye is expected to miss significant time due to a lower-leg injury he suffered in Sunday’s loss against the Detroit Lions in Munich, according to multiple reports. The NFL Network reported that Maye could possibly miss the remainder of the season. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! The injury occurred early in the Patriots’ 35-10 loss to the Detroit Lions. Maye was trying to avoid a sack when he ran into the arms of Lions defensive end Aidan Hutchinson. Maye went down and was seen limping off the field and into the locker room. Ironically, Hutchinson also suffered a significant knee injury when he leaped and pumped his fist to celebrate the sack. His knee buckled on the way down and he is feared to be out for the rest of the season. The Patriots put Tommy DeVito into the game. He was 12-of-24 for 81 yards with a touchdown pass and an interception. The New England offense sputtered and couldn’t really get anything going as Jared Goff threw for 303 yards, three touchdowns and two interceptions. New England head coach Mike Vrabel said Maye "couldn’t play, couldn’t run, couldn’t do whatever he needed to do to play quarterback, to protect himself, to execute, or function at that level." CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE The possibility of Hutchinson using a hip-drop tackle technique being the catalyst for Maye’s injury was also brought up during Vrabel’s postgame press conference. The FOX broadcast also mentioned the tackle when it came to Maye’s injury. Vrabel said he didn’t think the tackle was improper. "I'm not going to assume there was something there," Vrabel said. "However it happened, I don’t think it was anything intentional. I’m sure that it wasn’t. That’s part of the game." New England sat at 5-5 after the defeat. A Buffalo Bills win over the New York Jets increased the Patriots’ deficit in the AFC East. The Patriots are four games behind the Bills in the loss column. The Patriots will have a bye week in Week 11 before going on the road to face the Los Angeles Chargers.

items.title: Pompeii home buried by Mount Vesuvius yields personal treasures untouched for nearly 2,000 years
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: A woman's cabinet sealed since Mount Vesuvius erupted in A.D. 79 held a children's amulet necklace, perfume bottle, bronze coins and makeup tools, archaeologists found.
items.content: Archaeologists excavating a home in ancient Pompeii recently uncovered the remains of an ancient Roman cabinet — revealing intimate belongings buried for nearly 2,000 years. The discovery was announced by Pompeii Archaeological Park. Officials said in a press release in late October, which was translated from Italian, that the cabinet was discovered in house IX 11, 7, also known as the House of Cornelius Maximus, along the Via dell'Abbondanza. HIDDEN UNDERGROUND CHAMBER REVEALED BENEATH HOME OF LEGENDARY ROMAN EMPEROR The cabinet — which officials believe belonged to a woman — had apparently remained unopened since Mount Vesuvius erupted in 79 A.D. Using clues from the excavation, archaeologists were able to determine what the cabinet originally looked like and identify the belongings stored inside. Pictures released by officials show ancient pottery and other artifacts uncovered during the excavation. The cabinet contained tweezers, a tool for mixing makeup and a glass perfume bottle , as well as an incense burner, a bronze oil lamp and lead weights. SUNKEN ROYAL PALACE WITH CLEOPATRA LINK YIELDS RARE FIND TIED TO LONG-LOST WONDER OF ANCIENT WORLD Among the discoveries was a necklace made up of at least 24 miniature charms, including depictions of gods, hands, feet, pine cones and bunches of grapes. Such necklaces, known as crepundia, were given to Roman children as protective amulets . They also made noise as children moved, which allowed adults to hear them. Officials believe the owner may have retained the necklace as a childhood keepsake. "Adults sometimes kept these objects, often in small boxes or, as in this case, in cloth bags inside cabinets, evidently as reminders of a childhood of which little else sometimes remained," officials said. ANCIENT BURIAL REVEALS RARE JEWELRY FIND THAT ARCHAEOLOGISTS CALL 'HIGHLY UNUSUAL' Archaeologists also discovered a small hoard of 38 bronze coins , though the denominations were not specified, leaving their monetary value unclear. "The presence of the coins, in particular, suggests that the female owner or owners did not have time to retrieve their possessions of economic or sentimental value," officials said. The inhabitants of the residence may have fled during the eruption but never returned to recover their belongings, unlike others who apparently returned to dig for their possessions, according to evidence from recent excavations. "But perhaps they did not survive. ... These are questions destined to remain unanswered," the release added. CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR LIFESTYLE NEWSLETTER Gabriel Zuchtriegel, director of Pompeii Archaeological Park , said in a statement that the objects found at the excavation site "bring the human dimension of the past back to life." Said Zuchtriegel, "We cannot reconstruct with certainty the identity of those who lived in the house, but these fragments bring us closer to their everyday lives." The excavation also revealed elaborate wall paintings inside the home, suggesting its residents were relatively well-off. CLICK HERE FOR MORE LIFESTYLE NEWS Construction work was underway when Mount Vesuvius erupted, however, which may have disrupted daily life in the home. Archaeologists also found the skeletons of at least two young mice inside a storage vessel on a mezzanine level. The mice were likely wood mice, which commonly make their way into homes looking for food — a reminder that ancient Romans dealt with unwanted household pests, much like people today. TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ The find is one of many discoveries made at Pompeii in recent years. Earlier this year, archaeologists uncovered 2,000-year-old love notes etched into a wall, using advanced imaging technology to reveal inscriptions that had long gone unnoticed. Last year, archaeologists found the remains of at least four people, including a child, in a Pompeii home where residents had tried to shield themselves from the eruption by barricading a door with a bed.

items.content: The Third Russia-Africa Summit, recently held in Moscow, marked a significant milestone in strengthening the partnership between the Russian Federation and the nations of the African continent. The summit reaffirmed the tradition of regular high-level Russia-Africa meetings, which began in 2019 in Sochi, when Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi served as the co-chair on the African side. Cooperation between Russia and Egypt continues to play a major role in the ongoing development of the partnership with Africa.

items.title: "אצלנו אין בית שאין בו משאף" המתקפה החריפה של ראש מועצת מנשה, אילן שדה.
items.author: מערכת חדשות 90
items.preview: סערה סביבתית חדשה באזור השרון: ימים ספורים לאחר שהממשלה אישרה הסמכת יזמים להקמת שתי תחנות כוח גזיות חדשות – האחת בסמוך למועצה המקומית ג'ת והשנייה בתחום השיפוט של המועצה האזורית מנשה – יוצא ראש המועצה האזורית מנשה, אילן שדה, למתקפה חריפה. בראיון לתכנית "יומן 90" בהגשת יוסי הדר, וב
items.content: סערה סביבתית חדשה באזור השרון: ימים ספורים לאחר שהממשלה אישרה הסמכת יזמים להקמת שתי תחנות כוח גזיות חדשות – האחת בסמוך למועצה המקומית ג'ת והשנייה בתחום השיפוט של המועצה האזורית מנשה – יוצא ראש המועצה האזורית מנשה, אילן שדה, למתקפה חריפה. בראיון לתכנית "יומן 90" בהגשת יוסי הדר, ובהשתתפות הכתב איתמר רותם, תקף שדה את ההחלטה שאושרה חרף התנגדות ראשי הרשויות והזהיר מפני אסון בריאותי מתמשך לתושבי האזור. כפי שדיווח הכתב איתמר רותם, לפני ישיבת הממשלה פנו ראשי המועצות מנשה, גן רווה ומטה אשר למזכירות הממשלה ולשר האנרגיה בדרישה להסיר את הנושא מסדר היום, אך בקשתם נדחתה. האישור הממשלתי סולל כעת את הדרך להעברת שתי התחנות להליך תכנוני מזורז בוועדה לתשתיות לאומיות (הות"ל). זאת, כאשר מעבר לתחנות הקיימות "אורות רבין" ו-OPC 2 בחדרה, מקודמות בגזרה שבין עמק חפר למנשה חמש תחנות כוח נוספות ומתקן התפלה. במקביל, ביום חמישי הקרוב צפוי להתקיים דיון בבג"ץ בעתירה שהגישה המועצה יחד עם הקיבוצים מגל ולהבות חביבה נגד קידום תחנת הכוח "אורות יצחק" הסמוכה למאגר חביבה. "שערורייה! האזור שלנו, על פי משרד הגנת הסביבה, הוא האזור המזוהם ביותר בארץ כתוצאה מתחנת הכוח בחדרה, ועכשיו הולכים ומוסיפים פה תחנות אינסוף", אמר שדה בראיון והסביר כי היזמים בוחרים באזור בשל הקרבה לקווי הגז, הסולר ורשת החשמל. שדה שיתף בסיפור אישי של תושבת המועצה שנסעה עם ילדיה ליישוב בנגב, וכשאחד הילדים לקה בהתקף אסתמה לא נמצא ולו משאף אחד בכל היישוב הדרומי: "אצלנו אין בית שאין בו משאף בגלל הזיהום שקיים. זה שערורייה שמוסיפים פה עוד ועוד תחנות, צריך לפרוס את זה למקומות אחרים". ראש המועצה טען כי הרשויות ממודרות לחלוטין מתהליכי קבלת ההחלטות, וסיפר כי על אחת התחנות נודע לו רק בבוקר הישיבה, ועל השנייה חצי שעה לאחר מכן, בדומה למכרז קודם שגילו דרך מודעה בעיתון. "פשוט לא ייאמן, כאילו יש פה איזה פריץ שעושה מה בא לו", תקף שדה והזכיר כי על פי נתוני משרד הבריאות בעבר, כ-50 תושבים באזור מתים מדי שנה כתוצאה מהזיהום המתמשך. "כשיש מפולת בנפאל מדינת ישראל שולחת משלחות חילוץ, ופה כל שנה 50 איש מתים ומגבירים את הזיהום עם עוד תחנות. זה לא יעלה על הדעת". ממשרד האנרגיה נמסר בתגובה שהביא איתמר רותם כי הליך ההסמכה בממשלה הוא שלב מקדמי בלבד שנועד לאפשר את תחילת התכנון ואינו מהווה אישור סופי, וכי המהלך נדרש כדי לעמוד בביקוש הגובר לחשמל ולהבטיח את הביטחון האנרגטי של ישראל בהתאם להחלטת הממשלה מאוקטובר 2024. שדה דחה את הדברים על הסף וכינה אותם "התחמקות": "יש כבר יזמים בעסק הזה. זו ממשלת מעבר – מה אתם מקבלים החלטות אסטרטגיות בלי בחינה ובלי לשתף את התושבים והרשויות? ניערך גם הפעם בכל דרך אפשרית כדי שהאזור שלנו לא יזוהם". הפוסט "אצלנו אין בית שאין בו משאף" המתקפה החריפה של ראש מועצת מנשה, אילן שדה. הופיע לראשונה ב- 90FM .

items.title: Iraq orders nationwide ban on Telegram due to security concerns
items.author: Amr Salem
items.preview: Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraqi authorities ordered on Wednesday a nationwide ban on the Telegram messaging application due to security concerns, regulatory violations, and the platform’s failure to address unlawful content, […] The post Iraq orders nationwide ban on Telegram due
items.content: Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraqi authorities ordered on Wednesday a nationwide ban on the Telegram messaging application due to security concerns, regulatory violations, and the platform’s failure to address unlawful content, incitement, and extremism. According to the Iraqi Communications and Media Commission (CMC), the directive was issued by Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi, providing the platform with 30 days to comply with national laws. Reports mentioned that Telegram failed to comply with Iraqi laws and regulatory requirements. The CMC cited national security concerns, cybercrime, hate speech, extremism, and incitement to violence and unrest. The CMC gave Telegram’s operator 30 days to regularize its legal status and cooperate with Iraqi authorities on content moderation. Officials have not yet specified the exact technical steps required or whether the block will be lifted early if the company complies. The announcement comes on the same day Jordan banned Telegram over similar concerns regarding extremism and national security. In April 2026, Iraqi authorities suspended Telegram. On May 9, the CMC lifted the ban after Telegram’s management promised to abide by national laws and user safety requirements. The post Iraq orders nationwide ban on Telegram due to security concerns appeared first on Iraqi News .

items.title: Browns make NFL history as they storm back to pick up sixth win of season over Texans
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Deshaun Watson engineered another fourth-quarter comeback as the Cleveland Browns erased a 17-point deficit to stun C.J. Stroud's Texans 27-24.
items.content: Usually, when the Cleveland Browns and history are in the same sentence, it’s not good. But it appears the tables have turned through the first 10 weeks of the 2026 NFL season. Deshaun Watson led the offense on another game-winning fourth-quarter drive to put Cleveland up three points with 53 seconds left in the game. The Browns shut down Texans quarterback C.J. Stroud on his final drive and Cleveland overcame a 17-point deficit to stun Houston 27-24. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! The Browns moved to 6-4 on the season. Each of their six wins have come within one score. It’s the first time in NFL history a team has won its first six games by four points or fewer, according to ESPN Insights. Cleveland is also 4-0 at home for the first time since 1963. "I don’t have the end of the story," Browns head coach Todd Monken said when asked how the team keeps finding ways to win. "I just know if our guys keep fighting, keep battling, keep scratching and clawing, they always have a chance." In five of their six wins, the Browns had to dig themselves out of a hole. Cleveland was down 10 points against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers before picking up a win in Week 2. The Carolina Panthers were leading Cleveland 18-13 in the fourth quarter when Watson found a way to win the game in the closing two minutes. The Baltimore Ravens were up 10-0 in the first quarter before the Browns came back. The Tennessee Titans found themselves up 14-0 early before giving the game away. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE The Texans found themselves up 17-0 early in the game before the Browns’ defense turned things around and helped the offense get into position to strike. Watson even threw a fourth-quarter interception that might have sealed the game if the Texans didn’t go four-and-out on their next drive. "This is what I’ve been working on, working for, my whole career," Watson said, later adding, "People create stories and narratives. But my actions speak louder than my words." Cleveland will enter its bye week in the thick of the AFC North race. On Nov. 29, they will welcome the Las Vegas Raiders into town. The Associated Press contributed to this report.

items.title: في «يوم بغداد».. تكريم د. غادة العاملي تقديرا لدورها في صون الهوية البغدادية
items.author: pnne9562
items.preview: بغداد/المدى كرمت أمانة بغداد، مساء الأحد، الدكتورة غادة العاملي، المدير العام لمؤسسة المدى للإعلام والثقافة والفنون، تقديرا لدورها البارز في صون الهوية البغدادية وتوثيق الإرث الحضاري للعاصمة، وذلك خلال فعاليات مهرجان «يوم بغداد»، الذي أقيم في رحاب القصر العباسي التاريخي وسط بغداد
items.content: بغداد/المدى كرمت أمانة بغداد، مساء الأحد، الدكتورة غادة العاملي، المدير العام لمؤسسة المدى للإعلام والثقافة والفنون، تقديرا لدورها البارز في صون الهوية البغدادية وتوثيق الإرث الحضاري للعاصمة، وذلك خلال فعاليات مهرجان «يوم بغداد»، الذي أقيم في رحاب القصر العباسي التاريخي وسط بغداد، بحضور رئيس مجلس الوزراء وعدد من الوزراء والنواب وشخصيات ثقافية واجتماعية. وجاء التكريم تثميناً للمشاركة الفاعلة والإسهامات البارزة للدكتورة العاملي في الحفاظ على الهوية البغدادية العريقة وتوثيق موروثها الحضاري، فضلا عن جهودها في إبراز مكانة بغداد التاريخية والثقافية، وتعزيز حضورها في الذاكرة الجمعية. ويأتي مهرجان «يوم بغداد» ضمن سلسلة الفعاليات التي تنظمها أمانة بغداد بالتعاون مع اللجنة المنظمة، احتفاء بتاريخ العاصمة وإرثها العريق، وتسليطا للضوء على رمزيتها الحضارية والإنسانية ومكانتها الثقافية. items.title: Podcast De Dag: wel of niet thuiswerken?
items.author: NOS Nieuws
items.preview: Meer dan drie miljoen Nederlanders zitten elke dag niet op kantoor, maar thuis aan het bureau, aan de eettafel of op de bank. Tijdens de coronapandemie nam thuiswerken een vlucht en voor veel mensen met een kantoorbaan is het nog steeds de standaard. Maar steeds meer bedrijven kr
items.content: Meer dan drie miljoen Nederlanders zitten elke dag niet op kantoor, maar thuis aan het bureau, aan de eettafel of op de bank. Tijdens de coronapandemie nam thuiswerken een vlucht en voor veel mensen met een kantoorbaan is het nog steeds de standaard. Maar steeds meer bedrijven krabbelen terug: ze willen werknemers terug op kantoor. Luister hier: Deze aflevering van De Dag luister je via NPO Luister en alle andere podcastapps . Bevalt het? Vergeet je dan niet te abonneren. Verslaggever voor Nieuwsuur Yvonne Roerdink dook deze week in het thuiswerken. Is op kantoor werken beter dan thuiswerken? Werknemers vinden het fijn om minder te reizen en privé en werk makkelijker te kunnen combineren. Maar werkgevers wantrouwen thuiswerken soms, vinden het fijn dat er ook sociaal contact is op het kantoor en zien dat jongeren moeilijker inwerken als iedereen thuis zit. Wat zegt de wetenschap over thuiswerken? Wat is de ideale verdeling? Reageren? Mail naar dedag@nos.nl Presentatie & montage: Marco Geijtenbeek Redactie: Judith van de Hulsbeek Eindredactie: Rosanne Sies

items.preview: TEHRAN – Iran’s cement production rose seven percent in the first seven months of the current Iranian year (late March to late September), reaching 40.4 million tons, while exports to Afghanistan and through northern routes increased by about 15 percent, partly offsetting a sharp
items.content: TEHRAN – Iran’s cement production rose seven percent in the first seven months of the current Iranian year (late March to late September), reaching 40.4 million tons, while exports to Afghanistan and through northern routes increased by about 15 percent, partly offsetting a sharp decline in shipments from southern border crossings, the secretary of the Cement Industry Association said.

items.title: دستگیری اراذل و اوباش سابقه‌دار تحت تعقیب در تهران
items.author: info@yjc.ir
items.preview: عاملان قدرت‌نمایی و نزاع در تهران پس از شناسایی، توسط پلیس دستگیری، شدند. متهم حین عملیات قصد درگیری و فرار داشت که با شلیک دقیق مأموران و اصابت گلوله به پای وی، زمین‌گیر و دستگیر شد. در عملیات دستگیری این افراد چند نفر از اراذل و اوباش بخاطر مقاومت و درگیری با پلیس، مورد هدف گلو
items.content: عاملان قدرت‌نمایی و نزاع در تهران پس از شناسایی، توسط پلیس دستگیری، شدند. متهم حین عملیات قصد درگیری و فرار داشت که با شلیک دقیق مأموران و اصابت گلوله به پای وی، زمین‌گیر و دستگیر شد. در عملیات دستگیری این افراد چند نفر از اراذل و اوباش بخاطر مقاومت و درگیری با پلیس، مورد هدف گلوله پلیس قرار گرفته‌اند. سر کرده این باند در پرونده‌هایی از جمله شرارت و درگیری، اخلال در نظم عمومی، تخریب و تیراندازی دارای سابقه بودند و به باند مرغی‌ها معروف بودند. سرهنگ سعید راستی، معاون مبارزه با شرارت پلیس امنیت عمومی فراجا با اشاره به سوابق متهمان در زمینه درگیری، اخلال در نظم عمومی، تخریب و تیراندازی خاطرنشان کرد: پس از تشکیل پرونده، متهمان برای طی مراحل قانونی به مرجع قضایی معرفی شدند.

items.title: NVWA ziet ernstige veiligheidsrisico's bij speelgoed van webshops buiten EU
items.author: NOS Nieuws
items.preview: Bij speelgoed verkocht door webshops buiten de Europse Unie ziet de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) ernstige veiligheidsrisico's. De autoriteit onderzocht dertig speelgoedartikelen bedoeld voor kinderen onder de 3 jaar. Bijna twee derde van het speelgoed bleek onve
items.content: Bij speelgoed verkocht door webshops buiten de Europse Unie ziet de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) ernstige veiligheidsrisico's. De autoriteit onderzocht dertig speelgoedartikelen bedoeld voor kinderen onder de 3 jaar. Bijna twee derde van het speelgoed bleek onveilig. De NVWA kocht speelgoed bij Chinese platforms Temu, AliExpress en Shein en het Amerikaanse Wish. Bij negentien van de onderzochte stukken kwamen bij veiligheidstests risico's naar voren. Er werd onder meer gekeken naar speelgoedkeukens, een magnetisch visspel met schepnet, een interactieve speelgoedbal en pluchen dieren. Ook houten speelgoed zoals een dierentrein, een doosje met speelgoedeieren, poppetjes en puzzels werd onderzocht. Bij verschillende artikelen kwamen kleine onderdelen los, waren koordjes te lang of waren kleine figuurtjes of balletjes aanwezig. Daardoor ontstaat verstikkingsgevaar. Het is verboden om deze producten in de EU te verkopen. Bij twaalf producten was de waarschuwing 'niet geschikt voor kinderen onder de 3 jaar' aangebracht, terwijl het speelgoed wel bedoeld was voor jonge kinderen. "Mogelijk willen ze zo voorkomen dat ze aanvullende testen moeten doen. Die zijn verplicht bij speelgoed voor kinderen onder de 3 jaar", schrijft de NVWA. Ook werden er bij drie producten te sterke magneten gevonden, die kunnen ernstig letsel veroorzaken als ze worden ingeslikt. 'Handhaven lastig' De NVWA heeft de resultaten gedeeld met de webshops en wil dat het speelgoed offline wordt gehaald. Ook zijn vertegenwoordigers van de bedrijven in de EU geïnformeerd. De autoriteit zegt dat het handhaven bij webshops als Temu, AliExpress, Wish en Shein lastig is omdat ze buiten de EU gevestigd zijn. Ook is het platform een tussenpersoon en is de echte verkoper vaak lastig te traceren. De resultaten van het onderzoek zijn ook gedeeld met de Europese Commissie, die onderzoek doet naar deze platforms met veel klanten binnen de EU. De NVWA waarschuwt consumenten voor het winkelen bij deze webshops. Vaker risico's Het is niet de eerste keer dat de autoriteit veiligheidsrisico's ziet bij speelgoed dat via deze platforms wordt verkocht. In 2024 voldeed meer dan de helft van het geteste speelgoed niet aan de veiligheidsnormen . Naast verstikkingsgevaar door kleine onderdelen, werden ook te sterke magneten gevonden en vloeistof in speelgoed die besmet was met bacteriën of schimmels. Ook de Consumentenbond heeft vaker gewaarschuwd voor producten van webshops buiten de EU. In 2020 vonden ze bij ruim de helft van de onderzochte producten artikelen die brandgevaarlijk, kankerverwekkend of defect waren. Vorig jaar kwam uit onderzoek van de Consumentenbond naar voren dat 70 procent van de onderzochte producten verkocht bij Shein en Temu niet voldeed aan de EU-veiligheidsnormen. Een kwart was zelfs ronduit gevaarlijk. Afgelopen juli kreeg AliExpress een boete van 550 miljoen van de Europese Commissie voor de verkoop van illegale producten.

items.title: Dem eyeing Homeland Security committee's oversight subcommittee gavel aims 'to dismantle DHS from the inside'
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: A Democrat seeking the chairmanship of the House Homeland Security Committee's Oversight, Investigations and Accountability Subcommittee, wants "to dismantle DHS from the inside."
items.content: A Democrat, who noted that she is seeking the House Homeland Security Committee's Oversight, Investigations and Accountability Subcommittee chair, said that she aims "to dismantle" the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) "from the inside." "I introduced a bill to dismantle DHS, and I intend to dismantle DHS from the inside. Every investigation we do — whether it’s about detention, who is profiting at the expense of children who are literally in cages, or the expansion of these 287(g) agreements where local police [work] with federal agents to hunt down people — is critical to provide the evidence necessary to be able to bring the most justice," she said Tuesday to Mother Jones, which noted that the discussion with the lawmaker had been edited for the sake of length and clarity. Ramirez reportedly said that "there’s no other agency that has consolidated the amount of power that DHS has with the amount of money that DHS has in order to terrorize the American people and literally rob us from our civil rights, while at the same time saying that they’re doing it under the guise of protecting us from terrorism. There is no democracy if DHS continues to operate the way it does." 'SQUAD' DEMOCRAT FORMALLY INTRODUCES BILL TO ABOLISH ICE, BORDER PATROL AND DISMANTLE DHS "For me, investigations must lead into reimagining something new, where we protect cybersecurity infrastructure, where we protect FEMA, where we protect TSA, where we protect the customs functions at the border, and where we abolish ICE and CBP and reinvest funds towards healthcare, community safety and first responders," she said, according to the report. Ramirez, who has served in the House since early 2023, just won re-election during the 2026 midterms. Democrats will have the majorities in both chambers of Congress next year, and the congresswoman noted to Mother Jones that she is "pursuing the Homeland Security Oversight Subcommittee gavel." 'SQUAD' DEMOCRAT SLAMMED BY TRUMP ADMIN FOR MOST 'RADICAL' PLAN TARGETING ICE YET She asserted that "there is no affordability without accountability. Point-blank. If you want to actually talk about why people are living and experiencing the challenges they are right now, whether it’s that they can’t afford to buy groceries, they can’t afford to drive to work or pick up their kids, or they can’t afford the rent or buy their home, or why they’re living in the shadows and their businesses are shutting down, there has to be accountability to the actors that have made that happen. And it also means accountability to those that have terrorized them," she told the outlet. "Yes, we should be passing Medicare for All. Yes, we need to pass a bill that increases wages in this country. Yes, we should abolish super PACs and tax the rich. But we also have to understand that, as we fight for an affordable country, we have to hold every fascist in this administration accountable," Ramirez added. DEMS PIVOT FROM 'AFFORDABILITY' PITCH TO DHS PROBE THREATS AFTER MIDTERM WINS The White House , DHS and Ramirez's office did not immediately respond to Fox News Digital's requests for comment.

items.title: SBP says inflation to ease to 5-7pc target range during FY2027
items.author: none@none.com (Reuters, News Desk)
items.preview: The State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) said on Monday that consumer price inflation was expected to gradually ease towards the medium-term target range of five to seven per cent during financial year 2027. Real GDP growth would remain in the range of 3.5-4.5pc, the bank said in a yearl
items.content: The State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) said on Monday that consumer price inflation was expected to gradually ease towards the medium-term target range of five to seven per cent during financial year 2027. Real GDP growth would remain in the range of 3.5-4.5pc, the bank said in a yearly report, which added the country’s current account deficit was likely to be in the range of 0-1pc of GDP in the financial year. It projected the fiscal deficit to range between 3-4pc of GDP. In its Annual Report on the State of Pakistan’s Economy for FY26, the central bank said Pakistan’s economy demonstrated resilience against domestic and global shocks, with improvements across key macroeconomic indicators during the outgoing fiscal year. According to a statement, the report attributed the gains to a prudent monetary policy stance, continued fiscal consolidation and economic reforms under the International Monetary Fund (IMF) programme, which helped preserve macroeconomic stability despite external and domestic challenges, including shifting US trade tariff policies, monsoon flooding and the outbreak of conflict in the Middle East in February 2026. The statement said real GDP growth increased during FY26, with a major impetus coming from a rebound in large-scale manufacturing. It said the recovery in economic activity led to an increase in imports, while unfavourable global economic trends constrained exports. However, strong growth in workers’ remittances kept the current account deficit at 0.1pc of GDP in FY26. Foreign exchange purchases by the SBP, a reduction in forward liabilities and sustained official inflows also contributed to an improvement in the central bank’s foreign exchange reserves, it added. The statement said continued fiscal consolidation and a substantial decline in interest payments contributed to improved fiscal outcomes during FY26. Prudent monetary and fiscal policies also helped keep average national consumer price inflation close to the upper limit of the medium-term target range of 5-7pc, despite an energy price shock that pushed year-on-year inflation into double digits from April 2026 onwards. However, the statement stressed that deep-rooted structural reforms were necessary to place the economy on a sustainable high-growth path and create employment opportunities for the expanding working-age population. A chapter in the report, titled ‘Structural Challenges to Job Creation in Pakistan’, identified weak and volatile economic growth, slow structural transformation and signs of premature deindustrialisation as major obstacles to employment generation. Low female labour force participation, high youth unemployment and widespread informal employment further compound these challenges, the statement said. It added that the report also highlighted emerging pressures from technological developments, the green transition and geoeconomic fragmentation. It called for measures to encourage private sector investment, address infrastructure gaps, improve technology and skills development, rationalise taxes and simplify tax administration. Reducing economic policy uncertainty through rules-based fiscal and regulatory frameworks is also identified as essential for sustained growth. On the macroeconomic outlook, the SBP said Pakistan entered FY27 on a relatively stronger footing, with improvements in key economic indicators also contributing to upgrades in the country’s sovereign credit ratings. A gradual recovery in domestic demand and recent fiscal measures were expected to support economic activity. While worsening El Niño conditions posed risks to the agricultural outlook, preliminary information indicated higher output of key kharif crops , including sugarcane, rice and maize, compared to last year, it said. The report expected economic expansion, tariff rationalisation and higher global commodity prices to drive import growth, while exports were projected to recover moderately on the back of policy incentives and a slight increase in global demand. Continued growth in workers’ remittances was expected to keep the current account deficit within 0-1pc of GDP in FY27. Meanwhile, foreign exchange purchases, official inflows and $3 billion raised through Eurobond issuance in September 2026 were expected to support further reserve accumulation towards four months of import cover. The impact of the global energy price shock was expected to put upward pressure on inflation, which was projected to gradually ease towards the medium-term target range of 5-7pc during FY27.

items.title: Britain's definition of 'anti-Muslim hostility' protects the state, not those being targeted
items.author: Karsen Trull
items.preview: Britain's definition of 'anti-Muslim hostility' protects the state, not those being targeted Submitted by Karsen Trull on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 14:09 New report from Cage International shows how UK policy leaves the central mechanism of post-9/11 Islamophobia untouched - and lends it
items.content: Britain's definition of 'anti-Muslim hostility' protects the state, not those being targeted Submitted by Karsen Trull on Thu, 11/12/2026 - 14:09 New report from Cage International shows how UK policy leaves the central mechanism of post-9/11 Islamophobia untouched - and lends it official cover Britain's definition of anti-Muslim hostility 'is not a failed attempt to protect Muslims. It is a successful attempt to protect the state' (Reuters) Off This year marked a quarter of a century since the beginning of the “war on terror”, and in that time, the British state has built one of the most extensive counter-extremism systems in the world. Also this year, Britain produced - for the first time - an official definition of what it calls “anti-Muslim hostility” . It would be easy to treat these as separate stories, one about security and the other about community relations - but a new report from Cage International argues that they are not. The definition has been shaped so precisely around the security state that, read closely, it functions less as a protection for Muslims than as a protection for the institutions that have spent two decades treating them as suspects. The key, as the report sets out, lies in a single word that runs through every part of the definition: intent. Anti-Muslim hostility, as the government defines it, means intentionally engaging in criminal acts against Muslims, or stereotyping them “with the intention of encouraging hatred.” It means discrimination where the conduct “is intended to disadvantage Muslims in public and economic life”. Discrimination rarely announces itself this way. The Islamophobia Response Unit, a charity that handles discrimination casework, has warned that the threshold excludes most of the cases it sees: bias, institutional barriers, and recruitment processes that quietly filter out applicants with Muslim names. Professor Nasar Meer of the University of Glasgow has identified the omission of the systemic and structural as the definition’s central weakness. Amina Easat-Daas, a politics lecturer at De Montfort University in Leicester, has warned that it creates a hierarchy of racism. The intent requirement does more than leave victims of everyday discrimination without recourse; it draws a line around the state itself. Institutions acting under statutory duties do not, in the language of the definition, intend to encourage hatred. They are following policy, and that is exactly where the most consequential Islamophobia in Britain lives. Dominant logic To understand why, the report returns to how anti-Muslim prejudice changed after 2001. Before 9/11, the dominant logic in the West tolerated Islam in principle while treating certain Muslims, the “fundamentalist” or the insufficiently integrated, as the problem. Author Mahmood Mamdani captured this in Good Muslim, Bad Muslim , showing how dividing Muslims into moderates and extremists fed suspicion of all of them. After 9/11, the target moved. Islam itself came to be treated as the threat, an ideology that could be “hijacked” and weaponised. In a political culture where hostility towards Islam as a belief system has been the main vehicle for hostility towards Muslims for 25 years, that separation does not protect anyone In this view, the devout, practising and politically engaged Muslim was suspect not for anything they had done, but for what they believed. Research on this period has shown how even apparently positive portrayals of Islam as a corruptible faith served to legitimise the policing of Muslim-presenting people. The report finds that the new definition fits this logic with remarkable precision. It insists on protecting individuals rather than the religion, and explicitly safeguards the right to ridicule and insult Islam and to portray it in ways its adherents find disrespectful. In a political culture where hostility towards Islam as a belief system has been the main vehicle for hostility towards Muslims for 25 years, that separation does not protect anyone. It leaves the central mechanism of post-9/11 Islamophobia untouched, and lends it official cover. We see this logic become law clearly with Prevent . Since 2015, teachers, doctors and even nursery staff have been under a statutory duty to watch for signs of “radicalisation”. The Cage report highlights that before the Home Office stopped breaking down referrals by religion, 39 percent of children referred were Muslim, in a population where Muslims make up a fraction of that share. The UN special rapporteur on counterterrorism found that Prevent had a discriminatory effect on Muslim communities and was inconsistent with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. Not one Prevent referral made in line with the duty can be captured by a definition that demands proof of intent to stir up hatred. Embedded racism The wider context in which the UK’s definition was published confirms the direction of travel Cage has long documented. The “ Protecting What Matters ” strategy embedded the 2024 extremism definition across government, naming Islamism as a predominant threat. It introduced new surveillance of campuses and speaker events, proposed an annual “State of Extremism” report, and gave the Charity Commission new powers to shut down organisations and remove trustees. A critique from the Ayaan Institute concluded that the government’s strategy embeds Islamophobia in state policy, rather than protecting Muslims from it. These powers follow a familiar pattern. They are justified by exploiting public fears and prejudices about Muslims - and once in place, their reach extends to students, protesters, charities, and civil society as a whole. What is built for one community becomes available for use against everyone. The normalising of Islamophobia in UK public life is fuelling hate and violence Read More » This is also the context in which to understand the long-awaited appointment of a special representative on anti-Muslim hostility. Ministers graciously promised select Muslim individuals at Downing Street in late October that a name would come within the week, and none has yet appeared . Yet the identity of the appointee matters less than the function of the role. The government has maintained a policy of disengagement from the Muslim Council of Britain (MCB) since 2009. It barred the MCB from the consultation that produced this definition, and the council declined to endorse the result. A government-appointed representative tasked with implementing a definition the community did not build is not a channel for Muslim concerns. It is a way of supplying the legitimacy that the community itself has withheld. For that reason, the Cage report calls for the role to be abandoned altogether, and for the government to engage instead with organisations that have long records of serving their communities. Seen in this light, the definition is not a failed attempt to protect Muslims. It is a successful attempt to protect the state. It gives the government something to point to whenever anti-Muslim hatred makes headlines, while ensuring that the policies most responsible for institutionalising Islamophobia remain beyond its reach. A serious response would begin where the definition refuses to look, with the counterterrorism architecture itself. Prevent and the powers built alongside it must be abolished. Until then, any definition written by the state will describe the problem in a way that leaves the state out of it. The views expressed in this article belong to the author and do not necessarily reflect the editorial policy of Middle East Eye. items.title: Mamdani guts elite NYPD tactical unit, backs 'civilian-led approach' to responding to protests
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Zohran Mamdani disbands the NYPD Strategic Response Group and unveils a civilian-led dialogue team to handle New York City protest response.
items.content: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced the disbanding of the NYPD's Strategic Response Group (SRG) on Monday, saying the city will now pursue a "civilian-led approach" to responding to protests . Mamdani made the announcement alongside Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch, stating that the SRG's counterterrorism functions will be folded into an existing command, while a brand-new organization will now lead protest response, the Community Dialogue and De-escalation Division (CDDD). The CDDD, which will lie within the Mayor's Office of Community Safety, will work to "improve the NYPD's protest response" via a specialized "dialogue team," known as the First Amendment Support Team (FAST), they said. "The CDDD will not have weapons or arrest powers. FAST will consist of 30 uniformed officers trained in communication and de-escalation. The NYPD will also establish a new Patrol Support Division (PSD), a unit within the NYPD’s Patrol Services Bureau, with vetted officers who will spend most of their time on patrol-related duties and receive specialized crowd management training to support responses to demonstrations," the mayor's office said in a statement. NYC MAYOR ZOHRAN MAMDANI SAYS HE WON'T FIRE NYPD COMMISSIONER JESSICA TISCH DESPITE SOCIALIST PRESSURE "During our campaign, I promised New Yorkers that we would disband the Strategic Response Group and separate counterterrorism from protest response, and today we are delivering on that promise," Mamdani said in a statement. MINNEAPOLIS PROGRESSIVES TURN ON GEORGE FLOYD-ERA PUBLIC SAFETY OVERHAUL, PUSH TO DISMANTLE OFFICE "New Yorkers exercising their constitutional right to protest should not be met with the same police response as a terrorism threat . We are establishing a new, civilian-led approach that prioritizes dialogue, engagement and de-escalation," he added. The reforms also impose new restrictions on the tools police are allowed to use when responding to protests, including codified bans on kettling, long guns and tear gas. Pepper spray will also not be used as a crowd management tool, and "long-range acoustic devices" will be limited to 90 decibels. MAMDANI, NYPD GIVE SECURITY UPDATE AHEAD OF JEWISH HIGH HOLY DAYS, 9/11 25TH ANNIVERSARY Under the previous structure, the NYPD said the SRG responded to citywide mobilizations, civil disorders and major events and was a "critical asset" during parades, protests and the papal visit. SRG personnel were "also deployed to areas requiring an increased police presence due to increased crime or other conditions" and "mobilizes for shootings, bank robberies, missing persons, demonstrations, or other significant incidents," according to the department. Tisch noted at a March budget hearing that the SRG did not typically deal with peaceful protests, but was deployed for protests that involved criminal activity. She also noted that in 2025, the NYPD facilitated 4,255 protests and the SRG was available at 245 of them, or roughly 6%.

items.title: Leave ‘no seat’ for Russia at Ukraine peace talks – Estonian lawmaker
items.author: RT
items.preview: Russia should have “no seat” at Ukraine peace talks, according to senior Estonian MP Marko Mihkelson Read Full Article at RT.com
items.content: The foreign affairs committee chief issued the demand after European backers of Kiev were sidelined at trilateral talks in the UAE A senior Estonian lawmaker has insisted Russia should have no place at negotiations on how to end the Ukraine conflict. Marko Mihkelson, who chairs the foreign affairs committee of Estonia’s parliament, the Riigikogu, outlined his preferred approach to talks aimed at ending “the war in Europe” in a post on X on Sunday, calling for negotiations that would exclude one of the principal belligerents. Concerns that European interests could be sidelined in peace negotiations have intensified since US President Donald Trump returned to office last year and began pushing for a compromise. Moscow has accused European backers of Kiev of thwarting that effort. Mihkelson envisioned talks “that genuinely contribute to achieving a just and lasting peace,” adding that “Russia, as the country that started and continues this war, must have no seat at the negotiating table.” Instead, the leaders of “the United States and Europe, including Ukraine, must decide on the strategy and tactics,” Mihkelson argued. Negotiations to end the war in Europe are necessary. But they must be negotiations that genuinely contribute to achieving a just and lasting peace. Russia, as the country that started and continues this war, must have no seat at the negotiating table. The leaders of the United States and Europe, including Ukraine, must decide on the strategy and tactics needed to bring the war to a genuine end, and on how to ensure that the Euro-Atlantic security architecture, with NATO at its core, is strengthened - with Ukraine as part of it - to secure lasting peace across the continent. — Marko Mihkelson 🇪🇪🇺🇦🇪🇺 (@markomihkelson) November 15, 2026 The proposal largely reflects the broader Western position on the Ukraine conflict, which maintains that Russia should have no say over Kiev’s aspirations to join NATO and must accommodate Ukrainian demands before hostilities can be fully resolved. Moscow considers this approach detached from reality, arguing that it gives Ukrainians false hope of achieving objectives that would effectively require Russia’s military defeat. Read more US and Europe worlds apart on Ukraine peace talks – Lavrov The idea of excluding Russia from peace negotiations is not shared by some of Kiev’s most vocal European backers. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, who has reportedly threatened to block the EU’s next joint budget unless it includes funding for Ukraine, has said Russia must “naturally” be present at peace talks alongside Ukraine, the US, and European nations. Statements in favor of diplomatic engagement with Moscow have also come from European Council President Antonio Costa, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas, none of whom are sympathetic to Russia. Mihkelson doubled down on his position on Monday, dismissing commenters who questioned how his proposal could work as “trolls” and boasting that he had “hit a nerve.” A series of trilateral talks involving Russia, Ukraine, and the US, including the latest round last week, has failed to produce a breakthrough. European officials traveled to Abu Dhabi for consultations with American and Ukrainian envoys during the latest meeting READ MORE: Fantasy vs. reality: The confusion of the willing and Ukraine peace talks The EU, which became Kiev’s primary financial backer after Trump curtailed most American assistance, faces growing internal divisions as some member states refuse to continue financing the Ukrainian war effort. The disagreements have also complicated efforts to select a single European representative for negotiations with Russia, and the issue remains unresolved despite discussions dating back to at least last year. Moscow argues that Eastern European nations motivated by historical grievances against Russia have hijacked the EU’s internal debate and are pushing for an indefinite proxy war through Ukraine.

items.title: EU sanctions Russian trolls, hackers
items.author: Sam Clark
items.preview: A Moscow-based firm that carries out “large scale information manipulation and interference projects” is in the EU’s crosshairs.
items.content: European Union member countries on Monday issued sanctions against a Russian company running disinformation campaigns and one of Russia’s most well-known hacking groups. The Council of the EU said it had sanctioned the Social Design Agency, a Moscow-based firm that carries out “large scale information manipulation and interference projects,” as well as 24 of its staff members. The Social Design Agency is “funded, directed and supervised” by the Russian government and has organized disinformation campaigns targeting EU countries, EU institutions and European support for Ukraine, Council said. The group has been connected in the past to a vast online disinformation network known as Doppelganger. It targeted the 2024 European elections and carried out “dedicated operations against EU member states such as Germany and France,” countries said. EU capitals also agreed to levy sanctions against notorious Russian hacking group NoName057(16), which has targeted government bodies and critical infrastructure as well as private firms in the EU, Ukraine and the United States. The group is known to hit targets with so-called distributed denial-of-service attacks to shut down websites. A European law enforcement operation targeted the group last year. The EU also levied sanctions including travel bans and asset freezes against Russian propagandists. The bloc has issued multiple sanctions packages for Russian disinformation since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

items.title: فایننشال تایمز: جنگ با ایران و افزایش تورم، قدرت خرید شهروندان کشورهای خلیج فارس را کاهش داد
items.author: پایگاه خبری جماران | اخبار روز ایران و جهان
items.preview: روزنامه انگلیسی «فایننشال تایمز» در گزارشی اقتصادی به بررسی پیامدهای جنگ با ایران بر قدرت خرید خانوارها، صنعت خرده‌فروشی و گردشگری کشورهای حاشیه خلیج فارس پرداخته و گزارش داده است که افزایش هزینه واردات، اختلال در زنجیره تأمین کالا و کاهش اعتماد مصرف‌کنندگان، به افت فروش و سودآور
items.content: روزنامه انگلیسی «فایننشال تایمز» در گزارشی اقتصادی به بررسی پیامدهای جنگ با ایران بر قدرت خرید خانوارها، صنعت خرده‌فروشی و گردشگری کشورهای حاشیه خلیج فارس پرداخته و گزارش داده است که افزایش هزینه واردات، اختلال در زنجیره تأمین کالا و کاهش اعتماد مصرف‌کنندگان، به افت فروش و سودآوری شماری از بزرگ‌ترین شرکت‌های منطقه منجر شده است. براساس این گزارش، سود شرکت «لولو ریتیل» ۲۸ درصد، درآمد بخش خرده‌فروشی «ماجد الفطیم» ۶ درصد و درآمد «دبی دیوتی‌فری» ۲۵.۳ درصد کاهش یافته است. فایننشال تایمز همچنین با اشاره به تعدیل صدها نیروی کار، کاهش حضور گردشگران ثروتمند و گرایش خانوارها به کالاها و برندهای ارزان‌تر هشدار می‌دهد که تداوم جنگ و تورم می‌تواند الگوی اقتصادی مبتنی بر گردشگری و مصرف در کشورهای خلیج فارس را با چالش‌های بلندمدت مواجه کند.

items.title: Israel and Taiwan threaten Somalia’s existence – president
items.author: RT
items.preview: Somalia’s president has accused Israel and Taiwan of threatening his country’s existence amid their growing ties with Somaliland Read Full Article at RT.com
items.content: Mogadishu has rejected West Jerusalem’s recognition of Somaliland and the appointment of an ambassador to the region Somalia has accused Israel and Taiwan of posing a threat to its existence through their ties with the breakaway region of Somaliland. Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud made the claim on Sunday while launching construction of a National Defense University in the capital, Mogadishu. China is supporting the project, according to the Somali presidency, which said he also launched the reconstruction of the Somali National Army Hospital. “Today, Taiwan is among the things that threaten Somalia’s existence and its sovereignty... Israel is also a threat,” he said, according to local outlet Garowe Online. The president described China as one of Somalia’s closest allies. He said Beijing has supported the country since the 1960s and linked their partnership to the principles of “One China and One Somalia.” His remarks followed Somalia’s condemnation earlier this month of Israel’s accreditation of an ambassador to Somaliland and the laying of a cornerstone for a planned embassy in Hargeisa. Mogadishu said the steps were taken without its consent and violated its sovereignty and territorial integrity. READ MORE: Muslim nations condemn Somaliland embassy in Israel Israel recognized Somaliland last December, becoming the first and only UN member state to recognize the territory since it declared independence from Somalia in 1991. Israeli Ambassador Michael Lotem presented his credentials to Somaliland’s president, Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi, late last month. Somaliland has operated its own institutions, security forces and currency for more than three decades. Somalia rejects its claim to independence and maintains that the northern territory remains an integral part of the country. Somaliland’s authorities, who have long sought international recognition of the territory’s independence, welcomed Israel’s recognition and outlined plans for cooperation in security, trade, investment, and technology. Read more The Horn gambit: Has Israel just put a bold new map on the table? Taiwan, a self-governing island that China claims as part of its territory, and Somaliland established reciprocal representative offices in 2020. The Taiwanese Foreign Ministry said in May 2026 that cooperation with Somaliland covers healthcare, agriculture, technology, energy, minerals, and infrastructure. Regional authorities have warned against actions undermining Somalia’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. In April, the African Union Commission condemned Israel’s decision to appoint an envoy, saying unilateral recognition could undermine regional stability. The AU reaffirmed that Somaliland remains part of Somalia. The East African regional organization Intergovernmental Authority on Development also rejected West Jerusalem’s move, declaring that it ran contrary to the UN Charter and the AU’s founding principles. © RT / RT

items.title: Europese Commissie keurt overname Duitse Commerzbank door Italiaanse Unicredit goed
items.author: NOS Nieuws
items.preview: De Europese Commissie heeft de overname van de Duitse Commerzbank door het Italiaanse Unicredit goedgekeurd. De overname zit al langere tijd in de pijpleiding. Met het oordeel van de Commissie lijkt nu niets meer in de weg te staan van de overname. Als de overname helemaal rondko
items.content: De Europese Commissie heeft de overname van de Duitse Commerzbank door het Italiaanse Unicredit goedgekeurd. De overname zit al langere tijd in de pijpleiding. Met het oordeel van de Commissie lijkt nu niets meer in de weg te staan van de overname. Als de overname helemaal rondkomt, is het voor het eerst in lange tijd dat er zo'n grote Europese bankovername plaatsvindt. De Commissie concludeert dat ondanks de omvang van de samengevoegde banken er nog genoeg concurrentie overblijft op de Europese markt. Al langere tijd probeerde de Italiaanse bank de Duitse Commerzbank in handen te krijgen. Afgelopen maart deed Unicredit een bod van 35 miljard euro dat werd afgewezen. De Duitsers hebben zich maanden verzet tegen de overname maar gooiden van de zomer de handdoek in de ring. In de tussentijd had Unicredit al bijna 50 procent van de aandelen in handen gekregen door deze te kopen van aandeelhouders die ze vrijwillig verkochten. Ook Duitse politici mengden zich in de zaak. Ze maakten zich zorgen dat de bank te groot zou worden en daarmee misbruik zou kunnen maken van hun positie. De Commissie zegt vandaag die zorgen niet te delen omdat Unicredit maar een klein deel van de Duitse bankenmarkt in handen krijgt. De Europese Centrale Bank gaf vorige maand ook al toestemming voor de overname.

items.author: אושרי אלקסלסי
items.preview: רק לפני שלושה חודשים סיפרנו לכם כאן על סטארטאפ חדש ומעניין בשם Corma שמפתח מודל בסיס לתעשיית הסייבר, המיועד למגינים ולאו דווקא לתוקפים. היום (ב'), אחרי סבב סיד חריג, הוא חושף סבב גיוס ענק נוסף, שמביא אותו היישר למועדון חדי הקרן. כל עדכוני ההייטק, בלי שטויות: ערוץ העדכונים השקט של
items.content: הצוות של קורמה | צילום: אבישג שאר ישוב רק לפני שלושה חודשים סיפרנו לכם כאן על סטארטאפ חדש ומעניין בשם Corma שמפתח מודל בסיס לתעשיית הסייבר, המיועד למגינים ולאו דווקא לתוקפים. היום (ב'), אחרי סבב סיד חריג, הוא חושף סבב גיוס ענק נוסף, שמביא אותו היישר למועדון חדי הקרן. כל עדכוני ההייטק, בלי שטויות: ערוץ העדכונים השקט של גיקטיים יוצאי גוגל, DeepMind ו-8200 בדרך ל"גביע הקדוש" "היכולות של מודלי בסיס של מעבדות כמו OpenAI ו-Anthropic בסייבר התקפי התקדמו אקספוננציאלית, אבל היכולות שלהם בסייבר הגנתי נותרו מאחור", הסביר לנו רק לפני מספר חודשים אלון פלודה, מייסד ומנכ"ל Corma. לדבריו, הפער מאפשר לתוקפים לבצע תקיפות מקצה לקצה במהירות ובמורכבות חסרות תקדים, בעוד המגינים נשרכים מאחור. הוא הוסיף כי "המשימה של קורמה היא לסגור את הפער הזה ולוודא שהמגינים נשארים מנצחים". בקורמה פיתחו מודל בסיס (כלומר Foundation Model) שהוא, לטענתם, הראשון בעולם שמוקדש כולו להגנה. "המודלים הכלליים נבנו כדי להיות מודלי שפה וקוד חזקים. סייבר התקפי מבוסס בדיוק על זה – הבנת קוד, מציאת באגים ושימוש בכלים", מסביר פלודה. לעומת זאת, סייבר הגנתי דורש ניתוח לוגים, טלמטריה וזרימות רשת, לצד היכולת למצוא מחט בערימת שחת, עקביות לאורך תהליכים ויכולות היסק שהמודלים הכלליים אינם מותאמים להן. "כל אלה דורשים דאטה מתאים ותהליכי pre-training ו-post-training שנבנו במיוחד". פלודה הוסיף כי הוא לא חושש שהמעבדות הגדולות ייתרו את המוצר שלהם עם מודלים משלהן כי הן מתמקדות בסייבר התקפי ובחולשות. הוא הוסיף כי קורמה היא המעבדה הראשונה בעולם שמאמנת מודלי בסיס לסייבר הגנתי, "המודלים של קורמה כבר היום טובים בסדר גודל במשימות סייבר הגנתי מהמודלים הגנריים, ויותר מזה – ככל שהמודלים הכלליים יהפכו לחזקים יותר, ככה היכולות שלהם בסייבר התקפי ימשיכו להשתפר אקספוננציאלית ומודלי הבסיס של קורמה רק יהיו יותר ויותר נחוצים". לדבריו, המודל שעליו הם עובדים הוא הבסיס למה שהוא מכנה "'הגביע הקדוש' של התחום". הוא מוסיף כי "יכולת שעד לא מזמן נראתה כמו מדע בדיוני וכיום היא כבר בת-השגה: SuperIntelligence לסייבר הגנתי, שפועלת לצד צוותי האבטחה ומאפשרת להם להתמודד עם האיומים בקצב ובהיקף הנדרשים. לשם כך נדרשים מודלי בסיס ייעודיים, ואלה בדיוק המודלים שקורמה מפתחת – מודלי בסיס שנבנו מהיסוד כדי להעניק למגינים יכולות-על שעולות על אלו שמודלים כמו Mythos מעניקים לתוקפים". "חייבים לנוע מהר ככל האפשר" קורמה נוסדה בשנת 2025 על ידי אלון פלודה, מנכ"ל החברה, בוגר תוכנית פסגות ויוצא 8200. החברה מעסיקה כ-25 עובדים ומרכזי הפעילות שלה נמצאים בתל אביב ובסן פרנסיסקו. צוות החברה כולל חוקרים יוצאי גוגל ו-DeepMind, לצד מומחי סייבר יוצאי יחידת 8200. היום חושף הסטארטאפ הצעיר גיוס של 125 מיליון דולר בסבב A לפי שווי של מיליארד דולר. הגיוס הובל על ידי קרן NEA, והשתתפו בו המשקיעים הקיימים Sequoia Capital, Khosla Ventures ו-Coatue. שאלנו את פלודה מה הוביל אותם לגייס כל כך מהר שוב, ולדבריו החברה קיבלה הצעות לסבב נוסף, והחליטה לקחת אותן, "אנחנו חייבים לנוע מהר ככל האפשר. התוקפים מתקדמים בקצב אקספוננציאלי, והיכולות של המודלים הכלליים, בקוד ובשפה, משרתות בדיוק את מה שהם צריכים. המגינים, לעומת זאת, מתקשים להדביק אותם, והמודלים האלה כמעט לא מצליחים לעזור להם לסגור את הפער". לדבריו, כל יום בחודשים האחרונים הם ראו עוד ועוד עדויות לכך שאיומי הסייבר מחריפים, ושהמרוץ לשימוש ב-AI בין התוקפים למגינים הולך ומתעצם. "המשקיעים החדשים וכל המשקיעים הקיימים (כולל סקויה, קושלה, וקוטו) ממשיכים לעשות double down על קורמה, כיוון שהם מאמינים שקורמה תנצח במרוץ הזה ומבינים את גודל ההזדמנות ואת הפער הענק שלנו מול השוק: צוות יחיד במינו, הוכחות בשטח, לקוחות מהחברות המובילות בעולם וטכנולוגיה שמדהימה את המשתמשים ביכולותיה כל יום. הם מאמינים שלקורמה יש פוטנציאל אמיתי להפוך לאחת החברות החשובות בעולם". The post 3 חודשים אחרי הגיוס הראשון, הסטארטאפ הזה כבר הפך לחד קרן appeared first on גיקטיים .

items.title: New religious freedom rankings reveal surprising state divide as legal expert warns of costly burdens
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Michigan scored just 34% in the 2026 Faith and Freedom Index, ranking last for religious freedom protections affecting faith-based nonprofits.
items.content: FIRST ON FOX : Michigan has been ranked last in the nation for legal protections affecting faith-based nonprofits, while Alabama took the top spot in Napa Legal Institute's 2026 Faith and Freedom Index, according to a new report obtained by Fox News Digital that highlights unexpected differences between Republican- and Democratic-led states. The 2026 Faith and Freedom Index, released Monday by Napa Legal Institute, evaluates laws in all 50 states and Washington, D.C., that affect religious organizations , including churches, religious schools, pregnancy resource centers and homeless shelters. The findings, shared with Fox News Digital, show Michigan receiving an overall score of just 34%, followed by Washington at 38% and Massachusetts at 41%. SUPREME COURT OFFERS SUPPORT FOR CATHOLIC PRESCHOOLS CHALLENGING STATE FUNDING REQUIREMENTS Napa Legal senior counsel Frank DeVito told Fox News Digital that Michigan's low score reflects what he described as burdensome nondiscrimination requirements, inadequate religious exemptions and regulatory obstacles affecting faith-based organizations. DeVito said Michigan law can create conflicts for Catholic schools and other religious institutions seeking to make hiring and admissions decisions consistent with their beliefs. He also pointed to financial reporting requirements that he said can impose significant costs on religious nonprofits, potentially diverting resources away from education, charitable services and assistance to vulnerable communities. At the opposite end of the rankings, Alabama led the nation with 80%, followed by Kansas at 76%, Indiana at 75% and Texas at 71%. WASHINGTON FOSTER PARENTS SCORE LEGAL VICTORY AFTER STATE DEMANDED THEY USE CHILDREN'S PREFERRED PRONOUNS But some of the report's most striking findings defy traditional political expectations. New York, a Democratic-led state, scored higher overall than Republican-led North Dakota, South Carolina and Tennessee, while some traditionally conservative states trailed Democratic-led states in certain categories of legal protections. DeVito said New York has stronger exemptions from "nondiscrimination" laws in employment and public programming than Tennessee and that a New York state court ruling found the state's constitution provides greater protections for the free exercise of religion than the federal First Amendment. CATHOLIC NUNS SUE NEW YORK, SAY ASSISTED SUICIDE LAW FORCES THEM TO VIOLATE THEIR FAITH The findings underscore how state laws, not just Supreme Court decisions or congressional legislation, can shape the ability of religious organizations to operate, according to Napa Legal. According to Napa Legal Institute, several states have strengthened protections for faith-based nonprofits in recent years. ONE OF NATION'S LARGEST CHRISTIAN FOSTER AGENCIES WILL NOT ALLOW LGBTQ COUPLES TO ADOPT CHILDREN In Florida, lawmakers updated the state's nonprofit corporation laws to clarify that directors of religious organizations can seek guidance from faith leaders, including priests, ministers and rabbis, when making decisions involving religious matters. Meanwhile, Massachusetts and Rhode Island eased certain financial reporting requirements for nonprofits. Massachusetts increased the annual revenue threshold that triggers a mandatory independent audit for nonprofits raising funds in the state from $200,000 to $500,000 , while Rhode Island doubled its audit threshold from $500,000 to $1 million , according to the institute. DeVito stressed the importance of lawmakers establishing lasting legal protections for religious organizations, arguing that churches and faith-based nonprofits provide essential services. VERMONT PAYS $566K IN DAMAGES, LEGAL FEES TO CHRISTIAN SCHOOL IT BANNED FROM ALL SPORTS COMPETITIONS FOR YEARS "For policymakers and government leaders, it's really important to put these laws on the books because the church, the religious organizations do needed work," DeVito said. "They educate children often in poor and disadvantaged circumstances. They feed the hungry, they help the most vulnerable people in society. They do something with the level of love and attention that the government never can." "We need religious organizations to thrive," he continued. "If we are not attentive to the laws being such that these organizations can just do their work rather than spend their time and their money and their resources on administrative burdens that I think are frankly not necessary or fighting lawsuits over, you know, religious liberty issues that they shouldn't have to fight." DeVito warned that burdensome regulations and costly legal battles can divert time and resources away from religious organizations' missions, ultimately hurting society as a whole. He urged lawmakers in both parties to prioritize stronger religious liberty protections, including exemptions from certain nondiscrimination laws and tax requirements, even when doing so presents political or budgetary challenges. Fox News Digital reached out to Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer for comment on the report but did not immediately receive a response.

items.title: Woman’s kratom addiction spiraled from 4 capsules to 100 a day: ‘Zombie shell of myself’
items.author: Latest & Breaking News on Fox News
items.preview: Hilary Tesluck shares how kratom capsules led to a spiraling addiction, with her daily intake climbing to 100 capsules before she sought help.
items.content: Kratom-related reports to U.S. poison centers rose about 1,200% from 2015 to 2025, reaching a record high of 3,434 last year, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. For Hilary Tesluck, a 30-year-old woman in Michigan, the potential for addiction began well before those numbers emerged. Tesluck, who now works to raise awareness of kratom addiction and support others in recovery, said she first tried kratom capsules in 2017 at age 21. KRATOM INDUSTRY WARNS SYNTHETIC OPIOIDS SHOULD NOT BE CALLED 'KRATOM' Her initial use involved leaf kratom rather than concentrated 7-OH products , she shared. The American Kratom Association argues that 7-OH should be distinguished from natural leaf kratom, while acknowledging that kratom itself can cause dependence. "It was introduced to me by a friend who knew that I was someone who suffered from anxiety and took prescription medication for it," Tesluck told Fox News Digital. "I wanted to be more holistic and natural in what I was consuming." She noted that she doesn’t recall any dosing recommendations on the label. "I didn’t know how much to take, but my friend told me to take four capsules." WHAT IS KRATOM? RISKS OF POPULAR SUBSTANCE REVEALED AFTER COLLEGE STUDENTS' DEATHS At first, Tesluck – an undergraduate student at the time, who was also conducting research and tutoring – noticed the substance gave her a boost in energy, confidence and productivity. Tesluck's daily intake climbed gradually. "Very slowly, over time, I had to take just one more capsule or just one more dose, and then went all the way up to 100," she said. Her day-to-day functioning began to suffer, she shared. "I was not doing very well at work. I was getting … written up for performance." Physically, she had lost nearly 40 pounds and struggled to even stand in the shower "because my body was so wasted away." Tesluck’s belief that kratom was natural and legal made her growing dependence difficult to accept, she said. "About a year and a half into my kratom addiction from just the leaf … I finally realized I needed to do something, and I needed help." When she first sought treatment in 2020, Tesluck described feeling dismissed, saying that the facility’s urine test did not detect her use and that she had to explain what kratom was to the staff. "They were confused why I was there," she said. "So I left after just a few days because I felt kind of humiliated, and I went right back to my use." Tesluck found more help in 2021, when she attended an online recovery meeting. "I had nothing to lose," she said. "It changed everything for me to hear other people telling my story for the first time." After years of feeling alone in her addiction , she said, she finally felt surrounded by people who understood. In 2023, Tesluck relapsed following her grandmother’s death. "I was just grief-stricken. She was really close to me," she said. "So I went to the smoke shop just to get a little bit of kratom, just one time." She later experienced a separate relapse involving 7-OH , which she said followed the death of her cat and the end of a relationship on the same night. MEN AND WOMEN WHO SMOKE MARIJUANA MAY EXPERIENCE DIFFERENT EFFECTS, STUDY SUGGESTS 7-OH, short for 7-hydroxymitragynine, occurs naturally in trace amounts in kratom. Concentrated 7-OH products contain much higher levels than the leaf itself. The body converts some of kratom’s main active compound, mitragynine, into 7-OH, research shows. Both compounds act on opioid receptors and can contribute to dependence, according to the FDA. "The 7-OH was very strong," Tesluck said. "I stayed on that for just a few months because of how intense it was." She returned to her recovery group for support. "I had to take a leave of absence, and I got clean from 7-OH again with their help," she said. Having struggled with both leaf kratom and 7-OH, Tesluck views them as closely connected. "It’s one problem at two strengths," she said. ‘SUPER-DRUG’ 10 TIMES STRONGER THAN FENTANYL LINKED TO DEATHS ACROSS MULTIPLE STATES Mac Haddow, senior fellow on public policy for the American Kratom Association, disputed this characterization of leaf kratom and concentrated 7-OH. In comments to Fox News Digital, he argued that the body’s conversion of mitragynine into 7-OH does not produce equivalent exposure to concentrated products. Haddow also raised the possibility that the capsules Tesluck initially consumed may have contained ingredients beyond natural leaf kratom. Kratom rules vary widely across the country, with states taking different approaches to age restrictions, product standards and bans. "It’s really been a patchwork," Tesluck said. "It’s different from state to state. Some states ban it, some states regulate it." Florida, for example, prohibits selling or providing kratom products to anyone under 21. Washington’s health department says unscheduled kratom products remain largely unregulated there, without age restrictions, labeling standards or ingredient-testing requirements. Texas law requires kratom product labels to include directions and a recommended serving size. Haddow also emphasized the need for consumer warnings, adding, "The American Kratom Association supports accurate labeling to warn consumers that kratom can cause dependence." "We support stronger enforcement across the board, and excise taxes on kratom products to fund that enforcement." CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR HEALTH NEWSLETTER In an October interview with Fox News Digital, Haddow also backed age restrictions. "Twenty-one and up should be the only people who have access to these products," he said. Tesluck also raised concerns about how the products are marketed, describing social media ads as looking "very harmless" or "very cool," potentially drawing consumers’ interest. "It’s something that you might want to try just based on the marketing itself and the packaging," she warned. Tesluck said her work regularly brings her into contact with parents grieving children whose deaths they attribute to kratom products, including in states with Kratom Consumer Protection Acts. The FDA says no kratom drugs are approved by the agency, and that kratom cannot legally be marketed as a dietary supplement or added to conventional foods. In December 2025, federal authorities seized approximately 73,000 concentrated 7-OH products valued at roughly $1 million from three Missouri firms, according to the FDA. People taking kratom should pay attention to whether their use is beginning to dictate their daily routines, including planning around obtaining it or worrying about running out, Tesluck urged. CLICK HERE FOR MORE HEALTH STORIES "Like making sure when the smoke shop closes that you have enough time to get there," she said. Diminished appetite, weight loss and hair loss were among the effects Tesluck experienced. Other signs of problematic kratom use may include cravings, higher consumption than intended, unsuccessful attempts to stop and continued use despite problems at work or home, according to the National Institute on Drug Abuse. Feeling unable to miss a dose was another concern for Tesluck. "If I took less than what I was taking, I would feel even worse and sicker," she recalled. "So I was kind of stuck at that baseline with kratom." Haddow acknowledged that consumers can develop dependence or addiction. "Kratom can cause physical dependence, and some consumers have reported they develop addiction to kratom," he told Fox News Digital. Feelings of sedation, numbness or irritability may also occur, Tesluck said. "I was kind of like a zombie shell of myself overall," she said. "I wasn’t really the same person, personality-wise. I was irritable. I was mean." TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ Today, Tesluck describes herself as a "person in long-term recovery from both kratom and 7-OH addiction." She serves as executive director of End Kratom Addiction, a Virginia-based nonprofit that aims to raise awareness of kratom-related risks and advocates for stronger regulation. "My advocacy looks a lot like meeting one-on-one with families … and coordinating resources for those who are still in addiction," she said.
